tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos rje rin po che bla ma dam pa'i rnam thar thog mtha' bar gsum du dge ba bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa chos kyi rje rin po che chos kyi rgyal srid mtha' yas pa la dbang bsgyur ba'i chos kyi rgyal po chos kyi dbang phyug chos kyi rgyal mtshan chos kyi spyan mnga' ba'i zhabs kyi pad mo dri ma med pa la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /bsod nams ye shes rgya chen dpag yas skye rabs rnams su rab rdzogs pas/ /rgyal mtshan rtser mchod yid bzhin nor bzhin phun sum tshogs pa mtha' yas pa'i/ /dpal ldan rigs rus cho 'brang chen po'i skye ba bzang po bzung mdzad nas/ /bstan pa rgyas shing gdul bya smin mdzad mtshungs med chos rje'i zhabs la 'dud/ /de la bdag cag rnams kyi bla ma de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las mtha' dag gcig tu 'dus pa'i bdag nyid khams gsum pa'i zhabs kyi pad mo la phyag byas pa khams gsum gyi 'khor los bsgyur ba gcig pu a wa dhu ti pa chen po bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na grags pa'i de'i rnam par thar pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dpe zla dang bral bas blo'i spyod yul dang tshig gi brjod pa las 'das pa'i phyir/ tshur rol mthong ba'i skye bos rtogs shing brjod par ga la nus/ de ltar na'ang dpal ldan bla ma'i yon tan gyi cha shas tsam mthong ba dang thos pa dang dran pa tsam gyis kyang bsod nams ma yin pa rnams spong zhing / bsod nams mngon par 'phel bar gsungs pas/ de'i phyir rang nyid kyis kyang mthong zhing / chos rje nyid kyi zhabs drung du yun ring du nye bar gnas pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi gsung las cung zad thos par gyur pa rnams bri bar bya'o/ /de la chos rje rin po che 'di sngon bskal pa dpag tu med pa nas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgya chen po bskrun pas/

sku tshe 'dir dpal sa skya pa'i gdung rgyud dri ma med par skye ba bzung bar mdzad nas/ bstan pa rin po che phyogs mtha' dag tu rgyas pa dang gdul bya dpag tu med pa smin grol la bkod par mdzad do/ /de ltar 'di'i rigs rus cho 'brang phun sum tshogs pa'i tshul ni/ chos rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i lam 'bras kyi rnam thar dang / gzhan rnams kyis kyang mdzad pa'i 'khon gyi gdung rabs rnams su blta bar bya'o/ /des na 'dir dang por lhums su zhugs shing bltams pa'i tshul dang / skyed bsrings te gsan sbyong mdzad nas bstan pa rgyas shing gdul bya smin grol la bkod ba'i tshul dang / rig pa'i gnas lnga mthar phyin zhing / phar phyin drug gi yon tan ji ltar mnga' ba'i tshul dang / mthar yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po bstan pa'i tshul dang bzhis rigs par bya'o/ /dang po la skyes bu chen po 'di lhums su zhugs shing bltams pa'i gnas ni/ ma ga dha rdo rje'i gdan las byang phyogs su dpag tshad brgyar bgrod pa na/ klu'i rgyal po gtsug na rin chen gyi pho brang gnas shing / bkra shis dang dge mtshan du mas spras pa'i sa'i thig le/ zas dang skom dang gos dang rgyan dang bzhon pa dang bzhad gad dang glu gar dang rol mo dang gser dang dngul dang mu tig dang shel dang bai ḍūrya la sogs pa mngon par 'dod pa'i nor dang yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab cing / blo gsal zhing yid gzhung pa dang / ngang tshul bzang zhing bden par smra ba dang gya noms pa dang nges pa'i sgo nas 'jig rten gyi lugs dang rtsis dang bzo dang gso ba la sogs pa rig pa sna tshogs la mkhas pa'i skye bo'i tshogs grangs med pas gang ba'i grong khyer/ sgra dang snyan ngag dang zlos gar dang tshig gi sdeb sbyor dang ming gi mngon brjod dang rgyan gyi bstan bcos dang rig pa'i gzhung lugs la sogs pa rtog ge'i gtsug lag rnams la mkhas par sbyang shing rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son la/

bslab pa gsum gyi nor gyi rgyud phyug pas 'chad pa dang rtsod pa dang rtsom pa dang thos pa dang bsam pa dang sgom pa'i sgo nas/ bstan pa rin po che phyogs mtha' dag tu rgyas par mdzad pa'i bla ma dang slob dpon dge ba'i bshes gnyen dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i tshogs kyi bsten pa'i gdan sa chen po thun mong dang mchog gi grub pa brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po rnams kyi bsti gnas phul du byung ba/ ma ga dha rdo rje'i gdan dang tshul mtshungs pa/ mdor na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyi 'byung khungs su gyur pa dpal ldan sa skya zhes bya ba ste/ de'i nang tshan rin chen sgang gi gnas kyi khyad par zha lu khang gsar zhes grags pa'i khang bzang chen po de yin no/ /'di'i yab ni bod kha ba can gyi bdag po bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa la lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i thugs mnga' ba'i bla ma bdag nyid chen po bzang po'i dpal zhes grags pa phyis rab tu byung ba'i mtshan a mo gha dhwa dza shri pha la zhes pa'o/ /yum ni rigs rus cho 'brang phun sum tshogs pa zha lu sku zhang mgon po dpal gyi sras mo jo jo lug skyes zhes bya ba/ phyis rab tu byung ba'i ming ma gcig gzhon nu 'bum zhes btags pa ste/ de yang las rgyu 'bras la yid ches shing dkon mchog la rtse gcig tu dad pas dkon mchog gsum gyi zhabs tog la brtson zhing / khyad par du rje btsun ma sgrol ma la yid dam du byed pas rang nyid kyis kyang bsnyen pa dang kha 'don byed/ gzhan la yang 'don du 'jug la/ de'i srol gyi bo dong e'i dkar phungs su lo re bzhin sgrol ma'i phyag 'tshal nyer gcig 'bum ther yum rgyas pa brgya tshar la sogs brgya tshar stong tshar khri tshar 'bum ther la sogs dge ba rgyun chags su 'byung bar mdzad pa la sogs pa yon tan du ma dang ldan pa'o/ /yab kyi dgung lo lnga bcu dang yum gyi nyer bdun bzhes pa'i dus su sems dpa' chen po 'di yum gyi lhums su zhugs so/

/de'i tshe yum gyi rmi lam du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltor zhugs pa dang / g.yas ru gtsang po 'thung pa dang / gtsang po sngar bas cher song 'dug pa la mi mang po brgal 'gro zhing 'dug pas shir dogs nas snying rje khyad par can skyes pa la sogs pa ya mtshan gyi rmi ltas mang po dang / sku lus mtho yang mi bde ba med la mchog tu zo mdog bde bar gyur cing / sku mched snga ma gnyis la'ang 'di lta bus ltas ma byung bas 'di ci zhig yin snyam du the tshom du gyur te/ bla ma 'jam dbyangs 'khon ston la thabs kyis zhur btang bas/ de'i gsung gis 'di la tshul gnyis te/ bstan 'dzin chen po zhig gam/ yang na gzhan gang gis kyang mi thub pa gcig 'ong / gang ltar yang yum grib la 'dzems zhing dkar gsum bsten par gyis zhes so/ /yum yang de ltar byed cing / dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur la sogs pa rim 'gro rgya chen la 'bad do/ /de nas yongs 'dzin zhes pa chu pho byi ba'i lo'i dpyid zla tha chung gi tshes brgyad kyi skar ma rgyal la bab pa'i snga dro'i dus su sa g.yo ba dang 'od chen po dang mkha' 'ja' tshon kha dog sna tshogs pa 'khrigs pa la sogs pa ngo mtshar zhing smad du byung ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te/ khyi'u gzugs bzang zhing mdzes pa lta na sdug pa yan lag dang nying lag thams cad yongs su tshang ba shangs kyi gzengs mtho ba/ dpral ba'i dbyes che ba/ smin tshugs ring ba la sogs pa mtshan thams cad dang ldan pa zhig bltams par gyur to/ /de'i tshe 'khon gyi gdung rgyud rnams ni chu khams pa yin pa'i phyir/ kha'u gtsang po zhes pa'i dpal ldan sa skya'i gzhung chu de gangs chu ba'am char babs pa la sogs pa'i rkyen gang yang med bzhin du shin tu rgyas so/ /de la kha cig na re gdung rgyud pa'i yum jo jo'i sras 'khrungs pa yin nam/ de lta na ni a la la re dga' zhes zer/ gzhan dag na re gdung rgyud pa khong rang ngam/ gzhan dge bshes grags pa 'dra la 'das grong yong ba yin nam/

'di ci'i ltas yin zhes zer ba byung ngo / /sku 'khrungs pa de'i dus su 'jam dbyangs 'khon ston spyan drangs nas dri bzang gi chu gsang sngags kyis bsngags pas sku 'khrus gsol/ tshogs chen por dro'i bsnyen bkur dang / gzhan yang btsas ston rgya cher byas/ tshe dpag tu med pa'i sgrub mchod brgya rtsa dang / rnam rgyal 'bum ther dang / rnam 'joms stong 'khrus la sogs pa'i bum chog gtsug ste/ chos rje nyid bde bar gshegs ma zin bar du lo re bzhin bo dong e'i dkar phubs su ma chag par bsgrubs so/ /yum gyi rmi ltas la dpes nas mtshan nyi ma bde ba'i blo gros zhes btags so/ /de nas gso ba'i ma ma kun dga' skyid ces pa la gtad do/ /'o ma dang zho dang mar dang dkar ra dang bu ram dang sbrang rtsi la sogs pa dkar gsum dang mngar gsum gyis bsnyod cing bskyed bsrings nas rdzing na gnas pa'i padma bzhin du myur du skyed che bar gyur to/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar rim gyis bskyed bsrings te/ mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i bla ma rnams bsten nas gsan sbyong mdzad de/ de yang thog mar sdom brtson dam pa mdo sde rgyud sde 'dzin pa chen po 'jam dbyangs 'khon ston las tshe dpag med 'chi med rnga sgra nas bshad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba dze ta ri'i lugs kyi dbang nod do/ /gzhan yang bla ma de la snga phyir chos gsan pa la/ sgrol ma phyag rdor 'khon chen la sogs pa'i dbang bka' dang sgrub dkyil cha lag dang bcas pa mang du gsan no/ /rigs kyi sras 'di 'khrungs nas zla ba gsum tsam song ba na skye 'chi la dbang thob cing mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po nyan chen pa bsod nams brtan pa la bde mchog dril bu pa'i dbang nod cing / gzhan yang bla ma de la snga phyir chos gsan pa la/ kyai rdo rje dbang / chos skyong gi rjes gnang / lam 'bras kyi chos skor 'ga' zhus so/ /de yang dus phyis bla ma bdag nyid chen po/

bla ma chen po kun dga' blo gros dang bcas pas lam skor 'ga' zhus pa'i dus su/ bla ma nyan chen pas 'di'i skabs su bla ma gong ma 'di gsung / dka' ba'i gnas yin gsung ba na rtse gcig tu zin bris lta bu re'ang mdzad pas/ bla ma'i gsung gis gcung po 'di la chos skor 'di'i bdag po gcig yod par 'dug pa la/ 'di sku nar ma byon par mi rgan 'byon/ khyed bla chen pas thugs kyi dgongs pa mdzad nas gsung bar zhu'o zhes gsungs so/ /zhes kha cig gleng ngo / /dgung lo phyed dang gsum tsam 'gro ba na/ mkhas grub chen po rong pa sher seng la gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang zhus/ de nas bla ma bsam lding pa byang chub shes rab la snga phyir tshe dpag med/ bde mchog lhan skyes/ gzhon nu grub nas brgyud pa'i gcod bskor/ ne gu'i chos bskor rnams kyi dbang byin rlabs/ khrid man ngag rnams gsan/ dgung lo bzhi la nye ba nas bla ma rin chen dpal bzang po'i drung du bsnyen te/ klog yig la sogs pa nas brtsams te/ sa skya pa'i chos skor rnams la rim gyis gsan sbyong mdzad de/ de yang skyes bu dam pa 'di ni dang po nyid las byis pa'i spyod pa las 'das te/ kun tu spyod pa gtsang zhing zhi ba dang dul ba dang / snyan cing ran pa dang 'dzem par smra ba dang blo gsal zhing yid gzhung pa dang bla ma dang rgan rim dang yon tan can rnams la bkur sti dang rim 'gro che zhing dbang po mi rgod pa dang / sngon gyi sbyangs pa dang yon tan la ched cher mdzad pas gzhan gyi bskul ba la mi ltos par rang gi ngang gis 'jug cing / klog yig la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi rig pa rnams kyang lan re zung re mthong ba dang thos pa dang brda sprad pa tsam gyis thogs med du mkhyen pas 'jig rten pa kun ngo mtshar du gyur cing kun gyis bsngags so/ /blo brtan zhing snying stobs che bas gzhan gyis sdigs pa dang co 'dri ba la sogs pas glags rnyed par ma gyur pas/

bla ma bzang po ba na re/ rigs kyi sras 'di ni nan tan la gzhan gyi btsun ma dgos/ dgos pa gcig byung na 'chun pa gcig byung dogs mi 'dug gsungs/ yum gyi nye 'khor rnams na re'ang / drung 'di pa lo lnga drug tsam gyi dus su na bza' jus ngur kha cig gsol nas bros byung pas chu zangs gcig gi rgyab tu byon 'dug pa na/ bla ma bzang po pa byon nas phyag la 'jus te khrid song bas nged rnams yid mi dga' ba gcig byung / de ma gtogs slob gnyer tsam zhig mdzad pa'i ring la brdung ba'am 'thab pa la sogs byed pa ma mthong / de la ltos na gcen gnyis po kun la lan mang du mthong zhes gleng ngo / /de'i tshe skabs zhig tu bla ma bzang po pa las sa lugs kyi 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na'i dbang nod de/ bla ma pa nyid dang yum gyis kyang bsnyen pa'i grogs byas nas gzhan yang bsnyen pa'i grogs mang po dang lhan cig bo dong e'i dkar phubs su sku mtshams bcad de zla ba gsum tsam du bsgrubs pas/ thugs rab kyis rtsal thogs pa med par gyur te/ dus phyis rtsom pa thams cad kyi mgor 'jam dbyangs la mchod brjod mdzad pa'i don yang de yin gsungs/ de nas dpal kyai rdo rje'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa la gsan sbyong mdzad pas shin tu mkhas par gyur te/ dgung lo brgyad pa la ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po ba dang lhan cig bshad don rgya chen po dang bcas pas rin chen sgang du gdan sa chen po'i phal mo che 'dus pa la rgyud kyi don/ phyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa la grags pa dang sbyar ba/ nang sngags kyi bskyed rim la sbyar ba/ rang byin rlabs la sbyar ba/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo la sbyar ba/ 'bras bu sku bzhi la sbyar ba la sogs pa dang / rgya gar gyi rgyud 'grel so so'i bshad srol tshul mi 'dra ba rnams dang / bod kyi bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bzhed tshul gyi rnam bzhag mang du gsungs pas/

sde snod 'dzin pa chen po rnams kyang ya mtshan du gyur te/ slob dpon chen po 'di ni sku tshe dpag tu med pa nas lam 'di la sbyangs pa gcig 'dug ces kun gyis bstod par gyur to/ /bla ma bzang po pa'i gsung gis/ nged kyi nang du tshul 'di lta bu dris pa'ang med/ mang po'i nang du nges pa dang bcas nas gsung ba la mthu thogs pa med pa gcig 'dug tshogs su gsung pa'i don ma go ba rnams nang du zhus pa'i tshe'ang rgyu mtshan dang bcas nas lan ston pa gcig 'dug ces bla ma bdag nyid chen po pa la zhus pa dang / khong pa shin tu thugs zab pas/ khong pa'i gsung gis/ bu chung da lta blo gsal ring la yon tan slob dgos khyed rnams kha zug par gyis zhes gsungs so/ /gzhan yang bla ma bzang po pa la snga phyir chos gsan pa ni/ kyai rdo rje/ bde mchog dril bu pa kha che lugs dang pu hrangs lugs/ sgrol ma lha bcu bdun ma bcu gsum ma lus dkyil sa lugs kyi 'jigs byed/ rdor dbyings kun rig rnams kyi dbang la sogs pa dbang bka' mang po dang / chos skyong che chung rnams kyi rjes gnang dang / kyai rdo rje'i phyag len dang bde mchog rim lnga la sogs pa sa skya pa'i yab mes kyis chos dpag tu med pa mthar phyin par mdzad cing / thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid la sogs pa man ngag gzhan mang po'ang gsan nas thugs su chud par mdzad do/ /sbyor drug gi khrid kyang sngon ma rang du bla ma 'di la zhus shing / bla ma khong rang gis kyang bsgom grogs mdzad de/ dpon slob rnams pas stabs su bsgom pas nyams myong bzang po skyes shing rnam pa kun ldan gyi stong pa 'ga' re mthong / khyad par du 'jam pa'i dbyangs longs sku'i rnam par byas pa'i stong gzugs gsal po byung / nyin gcig bsgom khang du bla mchod nam she gsal po gcig byung pa na/ de'i phyi skad bla mchod nam she sleb byung bas de'i rnam 'gyur du 'dug gsung zhing /

mdor na bla ma 'dis byis pa'i dus su rtsed mo'i zhor la'ang lag len gyi cha mang po bslabs pas shin tu sku drin che zhes dus phyis kyang gsungs so/ /de dag gi bar skabs snga phyi rnams su dge ba'i bshes gnyen grub rgyal las brtag gnyis dang de'i 'grel pa 'ga' dang / 'dod rgyal gyi bskor la sogs chos kyi rnam grangs mang rab dang / dbyangs la sogs pa sa skya pa'i phyag len rnams legs par bslabs te spyis phyin par mdzad do/ /bla ma gzhon nu dpal bzang po la'ang brtag gnyis kyi rgyud dang / kyai rdor lus dkyil/ sgrol ma/ kun rig la sogs kyi dbang bka' dang / brag kha bas mdzad pa'i sbyor drug ngo sprod la sogs pa man ngag dang lung phran tshegs du ma gsan no/ /bla ma bdag nyid chen po la kyai rdo rje/ bde mchog dril bu pa/ sgrol ma lha bcu bdun ma rnams kyi dbang bka' dang / chos skyong gi rjes gnang / sems bskyed sogs mang du gsan no/ /gcen ta dben kun dga' nyi ma la'ang sems bskyed gsan to/ /skyes bu chen po 'di dgung lo bcu gcig bzhes pa'i dus su bla ma chen po ti shri kun dga' blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa bod du bsnyen rdzogs la byon pa'i tshe/ khyim pa'i tshul gyis bstan pa la phan chung bar dgongs nas khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung bar zhus na'ang gong ma la zhus gsungs te/ yab dang gcen gnyis kas ma gnang nas/ bla chen pa la dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa nod de/ mtshan kun dga' dpal bzang por btags shing / de'i lo bla ma bdag nyid chen po pa zhi bar gshegs nas/ de'i tshe bla chen pa rang gi phyag rdzas dang bla brang so so nas dngos po bton cing / khyad par du rin chen sgang dang shing khang nas dngos po mtshan chen po bton pa dang bcas pas bla ma bdag nyid chen po pa'i chos 'khor mdzad pa'i dus su/ dbus gtsang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen phal cher tshogs pa kun la so sos chos gang zhus pa'i chos gsungs pas thams cad ngo mtshar bar gyur to/

/de ltar bla chen pa la snga phyir chos gsan pa la/ kyai rdor lus dkyil/ bde mchog dril bu pa/ sgrol ma lus dkyil/ 'khor chen/ kun rig la sogs pa'i dbang bka' dang / chos skyong che chung tshogs bdag dkar mo nyi zla la sogs pa'i rjes gnang dang / dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed/ spyod 'jug thub pa dgongs gsal la sogs pa mang du zhus so/ /de nas bla chen pa la rab byung byed du mi gnang na chags phyir 'gro zhus nas tshong 'dus mgur mo'i bar du 'chags phyir 'brang pas/ bla chen pa'i gsung gis da re btsun pa byed pa dang / nga'i phyis la 'gro ba gnyis ka mi yong / gong ma la zhus la lon byed/ de bar la slob gnyer mthar phyin par gyis gsungs nas/ sku mched gnyis la nye gnas re bkos nas bzhag go /de ltar skyes mchog 'di sku phra ba'i dus de tsam nas snyan grags chen po byung bas/ de'i gdung rgyud 'phel na bstan pa'i rgyun la phan nam dgongs te/ gong nas ti shri grags pa 'od zer gyi dbon mo dge 'dun 'bum khab tu gyis la gdung rgyud spel zhes pa'i lung dang / gser dngul dang gos phyi nang la sogs pa dang bcas pa'i gnang sbyin byung nas/ khab bya bar gsol zhing gser yig pa nam mkha' dpal la sogs pas nan gyis zhus kyang gnang ba ma byung pas/ yum dang dge bshes nye gnas la sogs pa skor thams cad skrag nas gser yig pa'i mdun du khas blangs te re zhig dbon mo dang gnang sbyin blangs su zin kyang 'jig rten gyi gtam spyod lam gang yang ma byung bar/ yum la ci nas kyang rab tu 'byung bar gsol zhing / res 'ga' mkhan slob thams cad bsags kyang / yum gyi thugs dgongs la 'di'i mdzad pa 'dis sras tsha byung dogs mi 'dug ste 'on kyang / gong ma'i lung bcag na khrims kyi chad pa 'ong snyam pas skrag nas ma gnang ngo / /der thugs skyo bar gyur te skabs zhig na/ chos rje 'di 'khor dang gsol zas dang rdzas ci yang med par sus kyang ma tshor ba mdzad de/

rang nyid gcig pu sa skya'i rin sgang nas phyir byon pa na/ yum gyi thog drangs pa'i nye 'khor thams cad tab tab por gyur te/ phyogs kun tu rgyugs khang pa dang sa phug dang grog po mtha' dag myul kyang / zhag gnyis su 'gro la khad kyi nyin mo'i bar du ma rnyed/ de'i nyin mo dpon po ri'i byang gi ri sul gyi grog po gcig nas rnyed de/ sa skyar bar 'byon zhus pas rab tu 'byung na de ltar rang yang phyin pas chog rab tu 'byung du mi ster na sa skya pa'i mnga' ris su mi bsdod gsung / der nye gnas rnams kyis rang re gcig pu la gdung rgyud spel ba'i lung byung tshul/ rab tu byung na rgyal po chen po'i chad pa yong tshul thabs kyis zhus nas/ gdan drongs na sla snyam ste/ gang dgongs pa las 'os med 'byon par zhus pas/ nga 'gro dgos na khyed rang rnams ma gcig pa dang dpon chen gyis rab tu 'byung du ster ba'i yi ge khyer shog de bar nga 'dir 'dug pa yin/ de ma byung na rgyal po'i chad pa las/ ga ra dbang phyug gi dpung bzhi pa'i dmag gis da lta rang bsad dam/ rabs da lta chad dam/ khams gsum gser gyis bkang yang mi 'gro/ khyim thab mi byed na nga dbang che mod/ nga med na kha smras su dang byed gsung nas 'byon ma gsan pas de'i nub mo dpal lung du byon/ phyis nyin dpon chen 'od zer seng ge dang yum gyis/ gong ma'i chad pa las 'jigs bzhin du khas blangs nas yi ge byas te phul ba phyag tu phyin pa dang / dpal ldan sa skyar chags phebs so/ /dus phyis kyang chos rje nyid kyi gsung nas/ rab tu byung ba byed pa'i phyogs la khong rnams nyan du ma 'dod par ngas gcu gal chen po rang bya dgos pa byung zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar na sdom brtson chen po 'di ni sngon gyi goms pa'i stobs kyis/ dang po nyid nas khyim na gnas pa'i skyon dang rab tu byung ba'i yon tan yang dag par mkhyen pas skyon rnams spong zhing yon tan la ched cher mdzad do/

/de yang dgung lo bcu gcig pa nas bcu drug bcu bdun gyi bar du gtso cher sa skya dang bo dong gis byang chub lung dang sgro mon can la sogs par bzhugs nas/ sngar brjod pa ltar bla ma bzang po dang slob dpon don grub rgyal la sogs pa la'ang gsan sbyong mdzad cing / khyad par tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi gzigs rtog dang / mkhyen brtse'i mnga' bdag bla ma dpal ldan pa la gsan sbyong mdzad/ de'i tshe lhag pa'i lha 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis brgyud byin gyi brlabs pa la brten nas/ gzhung dang ṭīkka thugs la 'dzin pa dang / bgro gleng mdzad pa dang rigs grwar lan 'debs pa la sogs pa la ring por ma thogs pa med par gyur to/ /bla ma 'di ni shin tu yun ring du bsten cing snga phyir lan mang du gsan sbyong mdzad pas chos kyi rnam grangs ches shin tu mang bar gsan te/ de rnams mdor bsdus pa'i sgo nas phyogs gcig tu brjod na/ bla ma gong ma'i yig cha'i steng nas rgyud gsum gyi bshad pa/ gsung ngag gi gzhung bshad/ de rnams dang 'brel ba'i dbang byin rlabs rjes gnang sgrub dkyil las tshogs dang bcas pa/ rdo rje phreng ba/ kyai rdor ne gling ma/ bde mchog lha lnga/ lo hi pa/ sdom 'byung / rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ phag mo mngon 'byung / ma hā ma yā/ rdo rje gdan bzhi/ gshed dmar bcu gsum ma/ ur rgyan sgrol ma/ sgrol ma ral gcig ma/ rwa lugs kyi 'jigs byed/ dgra nag 'gro bzang snying po'i lugs kyi phyag rdor/ 'khor chen/ mi g.yo bla med/ khro bo reg tshig sangs rgyas thod pa lha nyer lnga ma/ gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs/ jo bo lugs/ kun rig gtsug dgu rdo rje 'byung ba/ dpal mchog rdor sems/ rtse mo rigs bsdus/ 'jam dpal gsang ldan la sogs pa'i dbang bka' dang / mai tri mkha' spyod/ phag mo las bcu/ phag mo kurma pa ti/ phag mo gzhung drug ral gcig ma dmar mo/ shin tu spros med/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal/

rigs kyi 'jig rten mgon po/ rigs gsum spyi gtad la sogs pa'i byin rlabs rjes gnang ste/ mdor na bla ma de nyid la mnga' ba'i dbang byin rlabs rjes gnang la sogs pa nyis brgya lhag tsam dang / de rnams kyi sgrub dkyil las kha tshar dang bcas pa dang / gzhan yang rnal 'byor bla med dang rnal 'byor gyi rgyud bod du ji snyed 'gyur ba/ de rnams kyi rgya 'grel bod kyi yig cha grags che ji snyed yod pa dang bcas pa bum pa gang byo'i tshul du thams cad gsan nas thugs su chud par mdzad do/ /ti shri kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la sems bskyed sogs chos 'ga' re gsan/ bla ma mkhas btsun chen po nam mkha' legs pa la chos skyong che chung gi rjes gnang dang sems bskyed la sogs pa gsan/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs bla ma don yod pa chen po la tshad ma rnam 'grel dang / sems bskyed la sogs pa chos mang du gsan no/ /de nas dgung lo bcu bdun bzhes pa'i dus su mkhan po sdom brtson chen po rin po che bsod nams grags pa/ slob dpon mkhas mchog chen po bla ma dpal ldan seng ge grib tshod pa dpal ldan bla ma rin chen dpal bzang po rnams las/ dge tshul gyi sdom pa yang dag par nod de/ mtshan bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes gsol to/ /de nas kyang sa skya dang byang chub lung sogs par bzhugs nas tshad ma'i skor la gzigs rtog mdzad cing / de yang lo gcig rnam 'grel nyid la dril nas thugs sbyong mdzad de/ de'i tshe sku khams gzi ba'i rnam pa cung zad byung yang skad cig kyang g.yel ba mi mnga' bar lhag par brtson 'grus che bar mdzad de/ rigs pa'i dbang phyug tu gyur to/ /de nas dgung lo nyi shu bzhes pa na/ mkhan po gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin par byang chub sems dpa' chen po mkhan chen rin chen bsod nams grags/ las kyi slob dpon mdo sde rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa dpal ldan seng ge

gsang ste ston pa'i slob dpon lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa bla ma rin chen dpal bzang po/ grib tshod pa sde snod 'dzin pa chen po don yod dpal/ grogs byed pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen grub rgyal/ dad pa'i dge 'dun shes rab rgyal grub la sogs pa dge slong bcu bdun gyi dbus su/ grogs 'jam pa'i dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang lhan cig gnas bo dong bya rgod bshongs zhes pa'i gtsug lag khang phun sum tshogs par skyes bdag ces pa lcags mo lug gi lo dbyar gyi dus/ bya lo'i zla ba'i yar tshes brgyad kyi nyi ma bzhi cha shar ba'i dus su/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la zhugs la yongs su rdzogs pa bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad do/ /dus de nas bzung ste/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du sha chang dang phyi dro'i kha zas la sogs pa zhal du mi reg ste mang du brjod pas ci zhig bya/ mdor na bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba phra ba nas spang blang ches cher mdzad na rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho bas gos pa'i skabs ga la srid/ des na lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa yongs su rdzogs pas sdom brtson chen por gyur par phyir bslab pa'i gzhi nod pa thams cad kyi gnas dam par gyur pa yin no/ /de nas mkhan chen rin po che bsod nams grags pa la snga phyir chos gsan pa la/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa me tog 'phreng brgyud gnyis kyi bshad pa/ 'dul ba'i cha lag dang lag len gyi rim pa mang po dang / dbu ma pa dang sems tsam lugs su grags pa'i smon 'jug gi sems bskyed kyi cho ga gnyis dang / dbu ma chen po/ blo sbyong / skyes bu gsum rnams kyi khrid/ skyer sgang pa dang dpal mo'i chos bzhi'i skor/ mngon rtogs rgyan rtsa 'grel/ sman bla/ sgrol ma dkar mo/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po la sogs pa'i rjes gnang dang / sron pa'i lugs kyi srog rtsol la sogs pa'i gdams ngag u rgyan bsnyen bsgrub la sogs pa gsan nas thugs su chud par mdzad do/

/sdom brtson dam la mkhan chen bsod nams bzang po pa la/ 'dul ba lung sde bzhi/ 'od ldan kā ri ka las brgya rtsa gcig pa/ mngon pa mdzod rang 'grel dang bcas pa/ yum rgyas pa/ brgyad stong pa/ nyi khri snang ba/ brgyad stong 'grel chen/ yang dgon pa'i ri chos skor gsum/ khro phu ba'i man ngag brgya rtsa la sogs pa mang du gsan nas thugs su chud par mdzad do/ /bslab pa rin po che gsum spyan gyi 'bras bu ltar gcig tu gces par 'dzin zhing mtha' yas pa'i shes bya ma lus par gzigs pa'i mkhyen pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal gyis mngon par mtho bas mkhas pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyi gtsug rgyan dam par gyur pa/ thub pa'i rgyal tshab 'gro ba ma lus pa'i 'dren pa dam pa chos kyi rje dpal ldan blo gros bstan pa la chos gsan pa ni/ dgung lo bcu dgu pa la dpal ldan sa skya'i seng ge sgang gi mdun gyi khab ces khang bzang chen po der/ drung don yod pas chen po'i zhor la mngon pa kun las btus kyi bshad pa/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i rnam thar mi rtog par bstod pa/ don dam par bstod pa/ dpe med par bstod pa/ sems kyi rdo rjer bstod pa/ bstod pa las 'das par bstod pa/ 'jig rten las 'das par bstod pa/ chos dbyings bstod pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab par bstod pa/ sku gsum la bstod pa/ tsand+ra go ma'i gshegs bstod/ ma ti tsitta dang / phyogs glang gi dad pa la sogs pa bskyed pa'i bstod pa/ spel mar bstod par grags pa/ ma ti tsitta'i bsngags 'os sngags bstod/ yon tan mtha' yas par bstod pa rtsa 'grel/ man ngag snye chen rnams gsan/ dgung lo nyir gcig bzhes pa na/ rin chen sgang du dbu ma'i rtsa ba 'grel pa tshig gsal dang bcas pa/ dbu ma 'jug pa'i rang 'grel/ de'i 'grel bshad 'jug ṭīka chen mo/ bzhi brgya pa rtsa 'grel/ sher spring gi 'grel pa blo gros chen pos mdzad pa/ dbu ma rin chen phreng ba/ dbu ma bsgom rim/

rtsod pa bzlog pa/ stong nyid bdun cu pa'i 'grel pa/ rig pa drug cu pa'i 'grel pa zla grags kyis mdzad pa/ dbu ma bden gnyis rtsa 'grel/ dbu ma rgyan rtsa 'grel/ dbu ma snang ba/ sher snying gi 'grel pa dri med bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ sdom pa nyi shu pa'i 'grel pa zhi 'tshos mdzad pa/ byang chub gzhung lam/ spyod 'jug gi 'grel chen gyi bsam le yan chad dang / sher le'i 'grel pa dā na shī las mdzad pa/ dril bu pa'i bde mchog lha lnga'i sgrub thabs/ ma ti tsitta'i bde mchog bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje drwa ba'i 'grel pa/ a mo gha badzra'i 'jigs byed kyi sbyin sreg la li ta badzra'i gshin rje gshed 'byung ba'i dkyil chog dpal 'dzin gyi dgra nag gi rgyud kyi bka' 'grel/ la ba pa'i bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa/ lha'i ris kyi gur 'grel/ ta thā ga ta rakṣi ta'i phreng 'dzin/ sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa gsan/ dgung lo nyer gnyis bzhes pa na bo dong er sa'i dngos gzhi/ mngon pa kun las btus kyi 'grel pa rgyal sras ma/ rgyud bla rtsa 'grel/ mdo sde rgyan rtsa 'grel/ dbus mtha' rtsa 'grel/ chos chos nyid rtsa 'grel/ nyi shu pa rtsa 'grel/ sum cu pa rtsa 'grel/ rnam bshad rig pa las sgrub pa/ rten 'brel mdo 'grel rnams gsan/ dgung lo nyer gsum pa'i dus su/ bo dong gi byang chub lung du mngon pa kun las btus kyi bshad pa'i dbu btsugs nas/ dpal ldan sa skya'i chos rje lo tsā ba de nyid kyi gzim khang du/ de'i 'phro dang thub pa dgongs rgyan gyi bshad pa/ bslab pa kun las btus/ klu sgrub mdo kun las btus/ jo bo'i chos 'byung brgya rtsa/ ba rī ba'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa/ lo grags kyi sgrub thabs rgya mtsho rnams gsan/ dgung lo nyer bzhi pa'i dus su/ bo dong er tshad ma kun las btus kyi rang 'grel/ rig thigs/ gtan tshigs thigs pas/

'brel pa brtag pa/ rtsod pa'i rig pa/ rgyud gzhan sgrub pa rtsa 'grel/ rdo rje snying 'grel rnams gsan nas thugs su chud par mdzad do/ /de nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i mchan mdzad par bskul te/ de'i rgyud 'grel gyi bshad pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i dus su khyed kyi rgyud 'grel 'di ci nas kyang legs par mkhyen par mdzod cig ces do dam cher mdzad nas gsungs so/ /chos rje nyid kyi gsung nas kyang de gong du dus 'khor la 'dun pa cher med na'ang chos rje lo tsā ba nyid kyi gsung nan cher byon pa las/ de'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i ched du 'bad rtsol cher byas pas/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel chen po'i tshig don la blo kha phyogs tsam byung pa 'di de nyid kyi sku drin yin gsungs/ spyir yang bla ma rnams kyi nang nas 'di nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa mnga' ste/ 'bel gtam mdzad pa'i gnas skabs kun tu/ bla ma 'di nyid dang por slob gnyer mdzad dus kyi dka' spyad/ las rgyu 'bras la 'dzems pa'i rgyu mtshan/ gsung sgros la sogs mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan rnams dges tshor dang bcas nas yang yang gsungs zhing / bka' drin lhag par che ba'i bla ma lnga'i gcig 'di pa yin no/ /'di dag gi gnas skabs 'ga' zhig tu rin chen sgang na bzhugs dus/ dpon chen 'od zer seng ges 'jam dbyangs kyi thang sku gcig la rab gnas zhus nas/ drung don yod pa dang sku mched gnyis gas bkra shis mdzad pa'i tshe/ thang skus 'jam dbyangs chos 'chad mdzad pa'i phyag gi bar du/ nas 'bru gcig sprin gyi sbyar ba ltar/ nyin rang du 'byar 'dug pas thams cad ngo mtshar bar gyur to/ /gzhan yang 'di'i ngo mtshar ba'i rnam par thar pa ni/ sku zhang kun dga' don grub kyi bstan 'gyur bzhengs pa'i rab gnas la byon nas/ rab gnas kyi dngos gzhi'i skabs su me tog gi char chen po babs/ de'i tshe 'bul ba rgya chen po byung ba la gzhi mdzad de/

chos rje nyid kyis kyang bstan 'gyur bzhengs nas rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe'ang / sa g.yo ba dang me tog gi char babs pa la sogs pa ltas khyad par can byung ngo / /de bzhin du 'di rnams kyi bar skabs snga phyi kun tu bla ma brag kha ba chen po la sogs pa rnams la yang gsan sbyong mdzad do/ /de yang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bsnyen pa sbyin sreg mthar phyin zhing rdzogs rim la brtan pa thob pa'i mkhas grub chen po brag kha ba grags pa seng ge la/ dgung lo bcu bdun pa nas brtsams te/ dus 'khor thugs dkyil rgyas pa dang lha dgu ma'i dbang / dmar khrid gcod kyi skor cha lag dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang gegs sel/ nad gdon/ dka' thub/ bcud len gyi skor la sogs mang du gsan nas thugs su chud par mdzad do/ /gsung ngag rin po che'i rgyud 'dzin dam par gyur cing sku tshe 'di nyid la grub pa brnyes pa'i chos rje brag phug pa bsod nams dpal la/ kyai rdo rje dang bdag med ma gnyis kyi rdul tshon dang lus dkyil gyi dbang dka' dang / lam 'bras kyi gzhung khrid rdzogs par nyams khrid du mdzad cing / de'i skabs su rten 'brel bsgrig pa'i phyir bla ma nyid kyi gzims mal du thugs dam mdzad par zhus te/ nyams khrid mdzad pa na ting nge 'dzin gsum skyon med khyad par can 'khrungs pas/ bla ma'i gsung gis rang re tshos lo zla bar sgom pa bas drung pa 'di pas zhag re bsgoms pa ting nge 'dzin gyi skye tshul bzang bar 'dug 'di tha mal par mi 'dug gsung nas shin tu ngo mtshar bar gyur to/ /lam 'bras dang 'brel ba'i dbang byin brlabs rjes gnang man ngag dang / de rnams kyi bla ma gong ma'i yig cha dang phyag len mtha' dag mthar phyin par mdzad de/ de ltar dbang gi chu bo ma nub/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma chad/ gdams ngag gi sarka ma log mos gus kyi bsam pa tshim par nus pa ste/ snyan brgyud bzhis byin gyis brlabs shing gdams so/

/gzhan yang lo nag dril gsum/ ma hā mā ya/ sgrol ma lha bcu bdun ma/ gshed dmar lha bcu gsum ma/ 'jigs byed rwa lugs/ rnam 'joms bir lugs la sogs pa'i dbang bka' dang / sa skya pa'i rnal 'byor ma gsum/ bde mchog rim lnga/ rigs gsum spyi gtad/ 'jam rdor blo gros 'phel ba/ chos skyong che chung / zhi byed do/ /bse gdong can la sogs pa'i byin rlabs dang rjes gnang mang po dang / rjes btsun gong ma'i yig cha 'ga' dang / chos rje khu dbon gyi bka' 'bum phal che ba dang / gzhan yang sa skya pa'i lugs kyi gegs sel 'khrul 'khor rlung sbyor dang bcas pa thams cad dmar khrid du mdzad de/ mdor na chos rje nyid kyi gsung gis bla ma 'di ni rje sa skya pa nas rgyud pa'i chos skor rnams la byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa rgyun ma chad cing dam tshig gi sel ma zhugs pas byin rlabs kyi bka' babs pa'i sgo nas skyed rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can thugs la 'khrungs shing / bla ma gong ma'i rdor dril 'dzin tshul tshun chad kyi phyag len rnams kyang gcig kyang ma 'dres par skyong ba'i brgyud pa rnam par dag par 'dug pas/ ngas sngar gzhan du thos pa'i sa skya pa'i chos mang po'ang bskyar nas zhus zhes gsungs zhing / khyad par du bla ma de'i drung du/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma'i khrid bskyangs pa'i skabs/ gtum mo'i dmigs pa skyong pa'i dus su/ 'bad rtsol cher ma dgos par lus thams cad mer 'bar ba snyam byed pa'i nyams snang bzang po skyes shing / ding sang yang skabs la lar 'ong zhing 'dug gsungs/ gzhan yang bla ma 'dis sa skya pa la byung tshul la sogs dang 'byung 'gyur 'ga' re bstan/ khyad par du drung pa la'ang khyed la hor gyi gdan 'dren yong bar 'dug der byon na'ang 'gro don chen po 'ong / 'on kyang sku tshe thung par 'dug 'byon mi 'byon khyad rang la dbang 'ong bar 'dug cing /

spyir bstan pa la phan pa rgya chen po yong bar 'dug khyad par gsung ngag rin po che 'di'i rgyud 'dzin chen por 'gyur bar gda' bas chos bdag po la 'phrod pa legs pas/ gsung ngag dar rgyas su mdzad par zhu zhes lung bstan/ khong pa sku gshegs khar da rung lo gcig gnyis 'dug na'ang nga rang la dbang yod tsam yin te/ 'on kyang da rang dus skal ci rigs pa las mi yong bar 'dug pas 'gro gsungs nas zhi bar gshegs pa yin gsungs so/ /rtsa rlung gi yon tan phul du byung ba las bde drod kyi nyams rtogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba'i bla ma sron pa chos dpal bzang po la/ sbyor drug gi khrid/ btsan thabs kyi nyams khrid la sogs pa de nyid kyi srog rtsol thun mong ma yin pa rnams bskyar nas zhus shing / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang dang / gshin rje gshed kyi skor gyi man ngag bskyed rdzogs dang 'brel pa mang du gsan to/ /'di dag gis gnas skabs snga phyir ngo mtshar ba'i mnal lam byung ba'i tshul ni/ dgung lo nyi shu rtsa drug pa bzhes pa'i skor tsam na/ chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta yin zer ba'i sku gzugs ring po byas pa na bza' ther phyam dur kha gsol ba gcig la chos gsan pa zhig rmis/ gzhan de'i tshe rnam gzhag gsal po 'ga' re byung ste da mi dran 'dug chos rje pa na bza' ser po rang e bsnabs snyam du the tshom zos pa na/ dus phyis dpe khang na chos rje pa'i na bza' ther phyam dur kha da lta'i mi gzugs ring po min pas mi rdzogs pa gcig byung ba na sngar gyi mnal lam dran gsungs/ yang skabs zhig na paṇa chen shākya shrī yin zer ba'i dge sbyong gzugs ring po hrags pa byas pa la sha byin gyis cung phra ba/ ras rdo tshos kyi phyar bu bsnabs pa phrag phyung mdzad pa/ dbyibs mkhan chen dharma shrī pa 'dra ba gcig dang mjal nas chos gsan pa'i mnal lam byung / 'di la'ang gzhan gsal po mang po yod kyang mi dran par 'dug gsungs/

yang re shig na ding ri glang 'khor yin nam snyam pa zhig na pha dam pa yin zer ba'i rnal 'byor pa sha rgyas po byas pa'i a tsa ra gzi brjid can gcig dang mjal nas chos gsan pa rmis/ de dus phyis mkhan chen dus ston pa la zhi byed kyi skor rnams ched du gnyer nas zhu bsam pa med na'ang / nyin gcig mkhan chen pa'i gsung gis/ ngas zhi byed kyi skor rnams nga rang gi a khu ba la thob gsungs pa la brten nas/ zhu ba'i 'dun pa byung ste zhus pa'i rten 'brel yin pa 'dra gsungs/ sngar gyi rmi lam de 'dra phyis kyang rten 'brel la lta ba 'ga' byung na'ang 'dun la ma bzung bas brjed 'dug gsungs/ yang dus gzhan zhig na bla ma 'phags pa dang mjal ba rmis te/ khyad par rnams brjed 'dug gsungs/ gzhan yang mtshan lam khyad par can dpag tu med pa yod pa ni skabs su babs pa dang brjod par bya'o/ /sdom brtson dam pa mkhan chen gzhon nu mgon po la/ bla ma gong ma rnams la ma gsan pa'i dbang byin rlabs rjes gnang mang po dang / bod du ji snyed 'gyur ba'i bya spyod kyi rgyud dang gdams ngag mang po dang / mdo sil bu du ma dang / phal po che'i phyed tsam rnams gsan to/ /de ltar dgung lo rtsa drug yan chod du/ sa skya dang bo dong e dang byang chub lung dang / sgro mon can dang / tsha mo rong gi byang chub rdzong dang / brag kha dang na bza' brag phug rnams su gtso cher bzhugs nas/ sngar brjod pa'i bla ma rnams la chos kyi rnam grangs mang du gsan pa dang / rang nyid kyang rim gnyis kyi thugs dam zab mo la mnyam par 'jog pa dang / mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams kyi gzigs rtog don tu gnyer ba rnams la 'chad pa dang / rtsod pa dang rtsom pas skad cig kyang g.yel ba mi mnga' bar nyin mtshan dus 'da' bar mdzad do/ /de ltar na skyes bu dam pa 'di nyid la sku che ba'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba la brten nas snyan pa'i grags pas phyogs thams cad du khyab pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/

dgung lo nyer bdun pa la lo gcig gi khongs su/ gong ma'i gdan 'dren lan gsum byung ste/ de yang dang por gser yig pa rgyal bu dharma tha tshe dang / rdo rje jams thong tshen gnyis sleb nas dbang med du gdan drangs te/ de dus zhabs bsnyung po yod na'ang rta khrid mdzad de byon pa'i lam du gtsang phyogs kyi sde dgon so sos spyan drangs te thugs bskyed zhus shing gsung pa'i dus su me tog gi char babs pas/ gser yig pa dang skyes bu kun ngo mtshar bar gyur cing so sos rdzong ba 'bul nod byas pa rnams ma bzhes par so sor gnang ngo / /de nas zhabs bsnyun gso ba'i phyir kha reg thod bur thog gcig bzhugs chis mdzad nas sku mtshams la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ slar yang gdan 'dren gyi gser yig pa chos dbang du dbyen shwa dang / zam pa ho hu shrī gnyis glo bur du slebs te/ dbang med du bug sgo bshig nas do le la gdan drangs te/ lha sar phebs nas/ jo bo rin po che la gser chab gsol/ mchod pa rgya chen po dang rgyan thams cad tshang ba'i bstod pa mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog ces pa phul du byung ba mdzad de bstod cing gsol btab pas/ me tog gi char dang / nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon la sogs pa ltas khyad par can byung ngo / /zhes grags so/ de nas gung thang du gdan drangs te/ yos lo zla ba dang po la phebs nas zla ba drug gi bar du bzhugs/ de'i tshe zhabs kyi bsnyung gzhi de rnag mang po byung zhing drung na gnas pa rnams kyis blta mi bzod pa tsam gyi bsnyung ba drag po yun ring po byung du zin na'ang sku tshe snga ma rnams nas gnod pa la ji mi snyam pa'i bzod pa dang sdug bsngal gyis mi 'khrugs pa'i brtson 'grus mthar phyin pas thugs mi bde ba cung zad kyang mi mnga' bar mchog tu thugs dam gyi rim pa la brtson pa na/ zhabs drung na gnas pa rnams kyis 'di ltar mdzad na sku khams kyi mi lcogs pa'i rgyu mtshan zhus na'ang ma gsan cing /

khyad par du sa skya pa'i yab mes kyis chos yang dag phur pa la sogs pa rnying ma'i bskor mang po dang gur rig bsdus kyi dbang bka' nub la nye ba rnams gan pa la yod pa zhu bar dgongs te/ phyi nang gi yon tan du ma mnga' ba'i rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po gan pa rin chen rgyal mtshan gdan drangs nas yang dag me dgu ma dang phur ba'i dbang bka'/ phur pa drag po'i rjes gnang la sogs pa rnying ma'i chos bskor mang po dang / gur rigs bsdus 'khor chen/ phyag rdor bde khros/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor/ dgra nag gdong drug mai ṭi'i lugs kyi bde mchog bcu gsum ma/ bde mchog nam mkha' mnyam pa/ ma hā mā ya rnams kyi dbang dang / gdan bzhi'i yum bka'/ tshe dpag med grub rgyal ma bla med lugs/ rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi dbang dang / a ra pa tsa na dang pu tra'i rjes gnang / ra hu la'i bka' bsgo la sogs pa byin rlabs dang rjes gnang du ma dang / 'khor chen gyi rtsa rgyud gsang 'dus kyi rgyud kyang / ma hā ma yā'i rgyud rnams kyi bshad pa dang / 'brel pa ston pa dang / dran pa gnyis pa la sogs pa chos bka' mang du gsan nas thugs su chud par mdzad do/ /de'i dus su bstan pa'i rtsa ba dge slong gi dge 'dun gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i rten 'brel bsgrig pa'i phyir/ bsam yas nas mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho'i dbu thod gdan drangs te/ gzungs dang rten khyad par can mang po'i nang rdzong mdzad nas mchod pa rgya chen po dang bstod pa khyad du 'phags pa mdzad pa'i tshe'ang me tog gi char la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma byung bas/ gser yig pa rnams kyang dad par gyur cing / 'od zer can gyi sgrub pa la sogs pa thabs sna tshogs mdzad pas gdan 'dren gyi 'jigs pa las rim gyis grol lo/ /de nas zla ba bdun pa la do le mdzad nas lam byang gi snyi mo ru mtshams phyogs la mdzad de sa skyar byon no/ /de'i dus su zhabs kyi bsnyung gzhi la lha rje rnams kyis sman spyad ci byas kyang ma phan par chos rje pa rang nyid kyis chab tshan dang dmigs pa dang rten 'brel la sogs pa thabs sna tshogs mdzad pas dngas par gyur to/

/de nas tsha mo rong gi byang chub rdzong du dben pa mdzad de thugs dam la brtson par zhugs pa'i skabs su/ chos rje dpang lo chen po rta lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu gsum la zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan nas bo dong er byon te/ sku mched gnyis kas gsol 'debs kyi cho ga dang sku gdung zhugs la bzhen pa'i phyag len mdzad nas gsol ba btab pas/ 'ja' 'od la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma byung zhing / khyad par du sku gdung zhal phye dus me tog gi char babs/ sku gdung la ring bsrel mang po dang / rje btsun ma sgrol ma dang rnal 'byor ma la sogs pa'i sku gsal po byon/ gshegs rdzong gi do dam phun sum tshogs pa mdzad do/ /slar yang tsha mo rong du byon te thugs dam la bzhugs pa'i tshe/ sa skyar nang gi kha mchus dmag 'khrugs chen po byung ba thugs kyis ma bzod par bar mtshams la byon nas phyogs phyogs zhu ba mdzad de/ drung don yod pa khu dbon lcam sring rnams dbus la byon du bcug nyid kyis gzhir bzhugs nas mdun khrigs mdzad cing dmag rnams so sor gyes te/ byang chub lung du byon nas sku mtshams mdzad de gzigs rtog dang thugs dam gyi rim pa la gcig brtson par gyur to/ /de nas sprel lo la drung don yod pa gdan sar sa skya bka' gros pas gdan drangs te bzhugs pa'i skabs su/ drung don yod pa bsnyung nas drung 'di pa gdan drangs te byon/ de yang gcen yin pa'i zhen pa tsam du ma zad/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dbyangs dngos yin dgongs pa'i mos pa tshad med pa mnga' bas/ zhag mang por nyin mtshan rgyun ma chad par mnal dang gsol la sogs pa yid la mi byed par rtse gcig tu bsnyung g.yog la brtson zhing gsol sman dang sku rim rgya chen po mdzad na'ang sku gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa'i sku gdung gi zhabs tog zhugs la zhen pa gsal 'debs rnams/ drung pa nyid kyi phyag len mdzad cing / de'i tshe me tog kha dog sna tshogs pa'i char dang /

'ja' kha dog sna tshogs pa'i gur dang / bde bar gshegs pa nyid dngos su seng ge la chibs nas nam mkha' la gshegs pa rnams skye bo kun gyis mthun snang du grub pa'i ltas khyad par can byung bas thams cad ngo mtshar bar gyur cing / de'i tshe gcen zhi bar gshegs nas zhag tsam ma lon pa na/ drung pa 'di pa'i mtshan lam du gcen byon te/ bar do 'di sbyang dka' ba gcig 'dug pas/ khyod kyang 'bad par gyis zhes gsungs pa gcig byung gsungs/ thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i phyir du gshegs rdzong la/ dge 'dun khri tsho gcig lhag tsam la 'bul ba gser zho re'i 'gyed dang bcas pa dang / gtsang gi lha sde gzhung dang / chu zhal gyi stong skor brgyad kyis gtso byas dgon sde thams cad du mang ja 'bul ba gral 'gyed dang bcas pa dang / dbus phyogs kyi dgon sde thams cad du ja dang bu ram gyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen bsgrubs shing / nang rten 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku ngo mtshar gyi gzi 'od 'bar ba bzhengs/ gzhan yang zla dus lo dus kyi mchod pa la sogs pa rgya cher bsgrubs/ rgyun du lo re bzhin sa skya'i tshogs chen por dro dang zla ja dang sgrub mchod rnams chos rje nyid zhi bar ma gshegs kyi bar du ma chags par mdzad do/ /nang rten gyi rab gnas la mkhan chen rin po che bu ston pa gdan drangs nas/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs te/ rab gnas dga' ston rgya chen po dang bcas pa mdzad/ dkyil 'khor de la brten nas rdo rje dbyings kyi cho ga zhus shing / de'i thigs khang du dpal mchog rigs bsdus kyi cho ga zhus so/ /de nas shing khang bla brang du bzhugs te/ dan gyi bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen phal che dang phyogs kyi dge 'dun dpag tu med pa la gsung ngag rin po che'i gzhung bshad khrid dbang byin rlabs cha lag dang bcas pa rgyas shing rdzogs par gnang / de nas rgyal po chen pos bzhi thog tu bzhugs zhes pa'i ljags sa dang shel dam bzhi/

gser dngul gos dar gyi gnang sbyin dang bcas pa gnang ba/ si stu dar ma rgyal mtshan gyis khyer yong ste/ gdan sa chen po'i bzhi thog tu bzhugs par gsol ba btab nas bstan pa'i mnga' bdag chen por mnga' bskur ro/ /de'i dus su brtag pa gnyis pa la sogs pa nang gi rgyud sde mang po dang / byams chos la sogs pa lung dang tshad ma rnam 'grel la sogs pa rigs pa'i gzhung lugs rnams tshogs chos su gsung shing / gsung ngag rin po che'i gzhung bshad dang khrid la sogs pa rdzogs rim zab mo mang po dang phyi nang gi dbang bskur mang po rnams kyis gdul bya rnams kyi re 'dod yid bzhin du bkong ba dang / rang nyid kyang rim gnyis zab mo'i thugs dam rnams kyis nyin mtshan dus 'da' bar mdzad do/ /bstan pa rin po che cher gsal bar mdzad do/ /de nas bya lo'i dpyid/ 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sprul pa'i sku bdag gzhan brje bar nus pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rgyal ba'i sras po dpal ldan thogs med bzang po'i dpal bzhi thog tu spyan drangs nas/ mdo sde rgyan/ dbus mtha'/ chos chos nyid rnam 'byed dang / sa lugs kyi rdo rje 'byung ba rnams kyi bshad pa/ nyi khri lnga stong pa dang / sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi sdud 'grel gnyis kyi lung la sogs pa du ma gsan cing thugs su chud par mdzad do/ /de dag gi gnas skabs su mnga' bdag bkra shis sde pa dang / bdag mo kun dga' 'bum ma 'cham pas mnga' ris su mi bde ba cher byung ba la drung nas zhal lta byon te bo dong du bsogs nas 'khrigs mdzad de/ mnga' ris pa rnams lo mang po'i bar du bde ba la bkod cing / mnga' bdag shin tu dad pas 'bul bskyel rim par btang ste/ gdan drangs na'ang stabs gshis kyis byon pa ma grub/ de nas khyi lo'i dpyid/ mtha' yas pa'i shes bya la dbang 'byor pas bstan pa rin po che'i mig gcig pu 'gran zla ma mchis pa'i gang zag dam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yon tan mnga' ba thams cad mkhyen pa gnyis pa rin po che bu ston pa bzhi thog tu spyan drangs nas/

chos kyi rnam grangs gsan pa la dmar chos rgyal gyi ṭīkka'i steng nas bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi bshad pa/ gdan bzhi'i dbang brgyud/ bha wa bha tras mdzad pa'i rgyud 'grel dran pa'i rgyu mtshan/ dge ba'i go chas mdzad pa'i sbyor gdan yan chad kyi sdud 'grel/ rgyud ṭīka a saṃ kīrti ma/ ārma de wa'i dkyil chog sgrub thabs/ sbyin sreg ye shes dbang phyug ma'i sgrub thabs/ sgrub thabs bha wa bha tra dang rnam rgyal dbang pos mdzad pa gdan bzhi'i 'khrul 'khor gyi cho ga rnam snang bsrung bas mdzad pa'i lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs/ klu sgrub kyi mchan khung sbyor ba/ arya de wa'i shing gcig gi dka' 'grel/ mchod rten bum pa'i man ngag ba lang rmig pa'i phyi nang gsal ba'i skor cha lag dang bcas pa/ dze ta ri'i de kho na nyid bzhi'i rab byed/ ma hā mā ya'i dbang rngog lugs dang jo bo lugs gnyis/ 'gar gyi ṭīkka'i steng nas mā ya'i rgyud kyi bshad pa/ 'grel pa rgyan pas mdzad pa/ ku ku ri pa'i dkyil chog sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus gsum/ de kho na rtsa 'grel/ gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / rgyud le'u bcu dgu pa/ birwa pa'i lha lnga dang lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs/ gtor chog 'khrul 'khor yang 'khrul 'khor byang bzang ma/ na lend+rar bkod pa'i las tshogs kyi man ngag mchod chog bdud rtsi lnga'i byin brlabs birwa pa'i gzhung dang bcas pa/ lha lnga'i byin brlabs man ngag dang bcas pa/ 'khor lo'i de nyid gsal ba/ dā na shrī la'i sgrub thabs/ 'khrul 'khor gyi man ngag dpal 'dzin gyi gshed dmar bcu gsum ma'i dkyil chog sgrub thabs/ rnal 'byor bzhi'i de kho na nyid kyi man ngag gi byin rlabs gzhung / 'pho ba'i byin brlabs dang man ngag ting nge 'dzin gyi bcud len/ ting nge 'dzin gyi cho ga me lha mchod pa/ srung 'khor gyi byin rlabs dang man ngag 'od 'dzin ma'i byin rlabs/ 'od 'chang ma'i sgrub thabs/ dmar nag gi mchod chog

maṇḍal gyi cho ga blo bzang gi bskor/ shes rab skyong gi sgrub thabs so bdun pa/ 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtog pa gcig pa/ la li ta badzra'i sgrub thabs/ dzñā na kā rā'i sgrub thabs/ 'jigs byed kyi sgrub thabs dang las bya ba'i cho ga zhi drag gi las bdun gnyis/ a mo gha badzra'i dkyil chog ratna a ka ra'i tshogs 'khor sbyin sreg slob dpon 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs/ bstod pa mi thung nag po/ dgra nag gzhung lugs la/ la li ta'i mchod rten sgrub pa dang / zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs/ srung 'khor gyi sgrub thabs/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang jo bo lugs kyi dbang / sgron gsal/ dkyil chog zung 'jug gsal ba/ cho ga nyi shu pa/ sgrub thabs mdor byas mdo bsreg rdor sems kyi sgrub thabs/ rnam bzhag rim pa/ rim pa khongs su bsdu ba/ spyod bsdus sgron ma/ rim lnga/ sems kyi sgrib sbyong / bdag byin brlabs/ mngon par 'byung ba/ lam gyi rim pa nag po pas mdzad pa'i dkyil chog dang gtor chog rgyud phyi ma'i 'grel pa nā ro pas mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal grags pa'i chos dbyings gsung dbang dang / sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i gsang ldan che chung gnyis dang / 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi nam mkha' dri med chung ba'i dbang / 'jam dpal grags pa'i mtshan brjod 'grel chen/ dkyil chog snying po rgyan/ rtsa ltung gi 'grel chen/ 'grel pa bar ba/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje'i sngags don rnam gzigs/ sgrub thabs gsang ldan gyi dkyil chog sbyin sreg mtshan brjod klags pa'i sgom khog rnams byang chub mchog gis mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi 'grel chung dang / dkyil chog gi thog drangs pa'i gzhung thams cad dang / yang dge bsnyen ma grags pa sbyin ma dang / snyan grags dge mes byas pa'i 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs/ smri ti'i spyan dbye/ thig gi rtsa 'grel/ rtse mo rigs bsdus dang /

kun rig dang gtsug dgu'i dbang / rdo rje 'byung ba'i bshad bka'/ sems pa 'byung chung / de nyid snang chen bstod dum/ de nyid snang ba'i bar man chad la 'grel pa ko sa la'i rgyan dang / sangs gsang ba'i 'grel pa a wa ta ra/ dpal mchog sher dum 'grel chung / kun rig gi rab gnas chen mo/ pra dhi'i thig rtsa rtsa 'grel/ kun snying dang pra dzñā wa li gnyis kyi spyan dbye/ rab 'byor bskyangs kyi sbyin sreg kun snying gi gtsug dgu'i dkyil chog mi 'khrugs pa bya spyod lugs kyi rjes gnang / rnam 'joms ba ri pa'i rig gtad gnyis/ des mdzad pa'i 'grel pa sgrub thabs dkyil chog sogs rgya gzhung mang po dang / don zhags kyi rjes gnang / rgyud chung / cho ga zhib mo'i le'u/ rdor sems mchod chog rab gnas nges don snye ma la sogs pa mang du gsan zhing thugs su chud par mdzad do/ /chos bka' 'di rnams drung gi zhor la bdag gis kyang zhus so/ /de nas phag lo la ta'i si stu byang chub rgyal mtshan pa dpon chen rgyal bzang pas gdan drangs pa la brten nas dbus su 'khrugs pa chen po byung ba'i dus su/ gdan 'dren byung pa dang khyad par ta'i si stu pa rang gi phyag bris kyi yi ge shangs nas byung ba phyag tu 'phrod pas thugs ches nas/ chags phyir slob dpon chen po chos kyi rgyal mtshan pa dang / khang gsar ba bde lags rgyal mtshan pa dang / bla ma mngon dga' ba mkhan po nam ye ba khrid de/ zla ba drug pa la dbus phyogs la 'chags bteg nas/ nang pa kun dga' 'bum gyis thab ka bzung ste/ lam na gnas pa rnams la gnod pa ci yang med pa'i khrims bsdams nas byon/ ya 'brog gha 'dar 'tshogs 'du mdzad de/ ta'i si stu ba dpang lag tu gtong dgos pa'i zhal lta mdzad pas dpon chen pa glo bur du bros pa/ chos rje pa sku 'khor bdun gyi rjes su rgyugs pas yar srib nas zin/ der zhal lta mdzad pas si stu ba dpang lag tu gtong ba'i yi ge lon te phyir byon nas 'khrigs mdzad cing /

de nas yar lung skyi phu la lam mdzad de sne sdong du gdan drangs nas zhabs tog dang 'bul nod bsgrubs/ de nas phag mo grur spyan snga rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan pas gdan drangs nas thugs bskyed zhus/ bsnyen bkur dang 'bul nod rgya chen po mdzad/ de nas bsam yas su byon te gtsug lag khang gi bzhig gso rnams gzigs nas/ slob dpon shes rab dpal la phyag rdzas kyi dngos po tshan chen bzhag ste bzhig gsos la bskos nas/ jo bo byang chub chen po la gser gyi khri rgyab yol/ rgya phibs steng 'og gnyis kyi bar lcam gyi drwa bas sbrel nas bya'i gnod pa las skyob pa/ steng khang gi zhal ba dang ri mo/ khams gsum/ bu tshal dge rgyas rnams kyi 'chos dgos dang ri mo/ chos rje sa skya pa'i chos khri la g.yu thog la sogs 'chos dgos snga ma rnams kyi zhal lta mdzad nas rgod dkar la la byon te/ dpon smon lam pa'i gshegs rdzong gser chab kyi gral dbu la gdan drangs/ de nas lha sar jo bo'i drung mjal gser chab gsol/ dkar me mang po phul/ de'i dus su dbus kyi khri skor sde dgon thams cad kyi mjal 'phrad byas te/ zhabs tog bsnyen bkur 'bul nod rgya chen po bsgrubs/ de nas gnam gyi phyogs la lam mdzad de gtsang gi byang 'khris la byon/ rta nag ri khung du phebs/ ta'i si stu ba bo dong nas bsu pa byon te/ mjal phrad mdzad nas thugs bskyed zhus/ de nas bo dong du byon te ta'i si stu ba dbus la 'byon pa'i rdzong ba mdzad nas gdan sa chen por gzhis pa rnams kyi bkur sti'i bsu ba phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas te phebs nas bzhugs dus/ gong ma'i gdan 'dren gyi gser yig pa no ga tshe dben dang / a khro nam mkha' rgya mtsho dang / dpon chen dbang brtson gyis dpon chen gyi las kha blangs te/ 'bul skyel gyi gser yig pa mang po dang bcas pas slebs te/ gdan 'dren gyi mja' sa bsgrags/

gnang sbyin gyi gser dngul gos dar mang po dang / gser yig pa gnyis pos gser bre re res thog drangs pa'i 'bul ba dang / gong du lo gsar 'bul du btang ba'i khams pa rgyal mtshan dpal gyis/ gong ma yon mchod chen po'i gnang sbyin gser bres thog drangs pa'i dar khang gi gos dar yug nyis brgya lhag dang / gzhan yang rgyal rgyud dpon mo mi dpon bod kyi pag shi so sos bskur ba'i 'bul ba gser dngul gos dar tshan chen po dang bcas pa phul bas gdan thog gcig tu zho khri tsho lhag tsam phyag tu byung ngo / /de nas byi lo zla ba dang po la gdan sa'i bla ma rnams dang / swo na wi swi pa stong skor so so'i mkhan po rnams tshogs te/ sngar srol bzhin zhu 'bul byas pas/ zhal lta la gong du zhu ba gtong zhing / de'i lan ma sleb bar du mdo khams bar 'byon pas/ lha sde mi sde rnams la khal rta za zi la sogs kyis gnod 'tshe mi yong ba'i khag khur dgos gsungs nas zhal gyis bzhes/ dpon chen gyis zhal ta bzhin bsgrubs par byas so/ /de nas zla ba gsum pa la drung don yod pa'i dus mchod la dmigs nas/ gdan sa'i lag len shes tshad gdan drangs pa la lnga brgya lhag tsam byung bas bzhi thog gi tshoms chen mor kun rig gi sgrub mchod zhag bdun mdzad pa'i phyag len thams cad kyang snga mo nyid nas bsgrigs pa lta bur khrigs gcig tu byung bas ngo mtshar du gyur cing / dbus phyogs nas byung ba'i phyam rnams dang gre rta rnams so sor 'bul ba rgya chen po mdzad/ cho ga ba phyogs gcig tshogs pa la de res rang mang bar grags so/ /der rjes gser yig pas gur rigs bsdus kyi cho ga zhus dus/ gur nas gsung pa'i gar rgyas pa dang bcas te cho ga mdzad pas ngo mtshar bar gyur cing / dkyil 'khor de nyid la slob dpon chen po blo gros rgyal mtshan pa dang / bla ma kun dpang pas gtso mdzad pa'i bshes gnyen mang rags kyis kyang cho ga zhus so/

/de nas zla ba bzhi pa la phyi phyag la dmigs te/ tshogs chen por gos dar gyi 'gyed phun sum dang / dkar phubs su'ang bla ma rnams kyis gtso mdzad brgya tsho so so'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen grags btus gser yig pa dang bcas pa dkar phubs kheng pa la 'bul ba rnams bzhag gos dar gyi 'gyed phun sum tshogs pa mdzad cing / dus phyis kyi de dus rang sa skya dar zhing longs spyod che bar grags so/ /de nas brag kha dang brag phug la sogs nyid kyi bla ma rnams kyi gdan sar byon nas 'bul ba gnang sbyin gos dar gyi 'gyed dang bcas pa phul du phyin pa mdzad do/ /de nas gong du zhu ba dang snga 'phang la tsha 'phrang dbon po bsod nams 'od zer dang gsol ja ba rgya mtsho mngags te zla ba lnga pa la/ gdan sa chen po'i bla ma dang dge 'dun skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la thugs bskyed gsungs/ de'i tshe nam mkha' la lha'i me tog gi char chen po bab pas thams cad rtse gcig tu lhag par dad par gyur to/ /de nas dbon blo gros rgya mtshan pa la shel dam gyis mgo byas pa'i gnang sbyin rgya cher mdzad nas/ tshogs chos ma chag par gsung ba la sogs pa chos 'jig rten gyi zhal ta gnang nas nyid kyi gdan sar bzhi thog tu bskos/ de nas sems can rnam la gnod pa spang ba'i phyir rta la chibs pa spangs nas zhabs thang mdzad/ sku 'khor kun gyis kyang za ma dang 'u lag la sogs pa gnod pa ci yang med par mdzad de byon pa'i tshe/ gdan sa chen po'i bla ma dang dge 'dun skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pas skyel thung mdzad pa'i dus su/ thams cad yid mi dga' bar gyur te mig mchi mas brlan zhing smre bsngags 'don la dung yang skad med par song / sa skya'i mdangs kyang shor nas mog mog por gyur/ de nub sron du bzhugs 'bul ba dang gnang sbyin gya nom pa mdzad de/ tsha mo rong du byon nas chab tshan la bzhugs so/ /der chos rje rgyal sras pa gdan drangs nas khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi dbang bka' zhus/

de nas rim gyis lam gyi sde dgon so sos spyan drangs nas thugs bskyed zhus pa'i tshe/ me tog gi char kun gyis mthun snang du grub pa babs pas ngo mtshar bar gyur cing / skyes bu dam pa 'di nyid mi bzhugs pas sa'i bcud nyams 'gro bar 'dug ces yid gdung bar gyur cing / de'i tshe bsnyen bkur dang 'bul ba rgya chen po byas pa rnams so sor gnang nas ma bzhes so/ /de nas nub gnas gsar du mkhan chen rin po che bu ston pa gdan drangs nas zla ba gnyis kyi bar du chos gsan pa la/ dus 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi dbang / rgyud 'grel gyi bshad pa/ bde dges kyi bstod 'grel/ 'grel chung padma can/ dbang mdor bstan rtsa 'grel/ don dam bsnyen pa/ a tsa la'i bshad sbyar/ dbang rab byed/ de'i 'grel pa dā ri kā pas mdzad pa/ swā dhu pu tra dang dus zhabs pa'i sgrub dkyil la sogs pa dus 'khor gyi sgrub dkyil cha lag dang bcas pa'i rgya gzhung thams cad dang / rgya bod kyi sbyor drug bod na ji snyed yod pa rnams te/ mdor na dus 'khor cha lag dang bcas pa dang / bde chen ral gcig gi dbang dang de'i skor thams cad dang / 'jigs byed skyo lugs kyi dbang / drag po dbang bdun gyi rjes gnang / rgyud rtog bdun rtog gsum/ de'i 'bru 'grel/ gtam rgyud kyi rtog pa rtsa 'grel/ 'jigs byed lha dgu ma dang lha zhe dgu ma'i mngon rtogs 'dzims pa rin shes sbyar ba/ seng ldeng phur pa'i gdam pa/ yi ge bcu pa dang spel ma dang mi ro bam pa la bsten pa gnyis/ sgrub thabs drag po phyogs gcig pa zhi ba ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ de nyid lnga pa'i bstod pa/ don yod rdo rje'i sgrub dkyil dgra nag zhang lugs kyi dbang dang / zhang lugs kyi rgya bod kyi yig cha rnams dang / phar phyin gyi bshad pa/ nyi khri snang ba la sogs pa mang du gsan/ de nas chos lung du byon te/ mkhan chen rin po che bsod nams grags pa la mjal phrad mdzad cing /

de nyid bsnyung gzhi drag pos zhal lkugs pa la chos rje bas bdag med ma'i rdul tshon gyi dbang bka' mdzad pa tsam gyis/ bsnyun pa dwangs pas shin tu dngas cing ngo mtshar bar gyur/ der bzhugs pa'i mkhan slob dge 'dun rnams la 'bul ba dang / gral 'gyed gnang sbyin dang bcas pa mdzad/ de nas bu ston rin po che pa dang dpon slob rnams pas 'bras yul du byon nas zla ba gnyis kyi bar du bzhugs te yang chos bka' gsan pa la/ bde mchog lo hi pa jo bo lugs dang / paṇa chen shākya shrī'i lugs dang / la ba pa'i lugs dang / lo chung lugs rnams kyi dbang dka' dang / de rnams kyi rgya bod kyi yig cha mang po dang / bde mchog bcu gsum ma khro phu ba dang / mai tri ba dang la ba pa rnams kyi dbang / sgrub dkyil cha lag mang po dang / bde mchog sdom 'byung gi dbang rgyud/ ratna rakṣi tas mdzad pa'i 'grel pa'i bshad bka'/ bde mchog lha lnga dang / phag mo mngon 'byung gi dbang sgrub dkyil dang bcas pa/ rje btsun ma rin chen rgyan gyi byin rlabs dang / de'i chos skor grub pa sde bdun la sogs pa rgya bod kyi yig cha mang po dang / phag mo dmar chung gi skor rnams u rgyan sgrol ma/ mchog gi sgrol ma/ sgrol ma lha mangs kyi dbang la sogs pa/ sgrol ma'i skor mang po dang / gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs dang jo bo lugs kyi dbang dang sgrub dkyil la sogs skor mang po dang / phyag rdor 'gro bzang lugs kyi dbang byin rlabs rjes gnang rigs gtad/ de'i chos skor gyi rgya bod kyi gzhung mang po dang / mi 'khrug pa jo bo lugs kyi dbang / de'i skor dze ta ris mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil sogs rgya gzhung tshan chen po dang / phag mo gzhung drug gi byin brlabs la sogs pa dpyal pa'i yig cha phal che ba dang / rta mgrin sho na bzhi skor gyi sgrub thabs sogs de'i skor mang po dang / ku ru kulle'i rjes gnang sogs de'i skor gyi rgya bod gzhung mang po dang /

mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang sogs de'i skor gyi rgya bod kyi gzhung mang po dang / phyag chen grub snying la sogs pa dang / snying po'i skor do hā la sogs phyag chen gyi skor thams cad dang / zhi byed rgyud phyi ma'i skor thams cad dang / nā ro chos drug gi skor thams cad dang / kha rag rin spungs lo rgyus dang bcas pa dang / nam mkha' go 'byed kyi byin rlabs dang gcod skor thams cad/ zangs dgar lugs kyi rnam sras skor dang / dzaṃ bha la'i khro phu ba'i lugs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rnam par gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba/ 'brel brtag rang 'grel dang bcas pa/ rigs thigs kyi 'grel pa dul lhas mdzad pa la sogs pa ste/ mdor na bla ma de nyid kyi gsan yig la yod pa'i sngags phyogs phal mo che gsan cing / de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rtsom pa phal che ba gcig gis zhu ba po'ang mdzad de/ de rnams kyi bka' lung bshad pa khrid la sogs pa yongs su rdzogs par gsan nas thugs su chud par mdzad do/ /de dus mkhan chen rin po che'i gsung gis 'dam gyi bar las 'byon mi dgos pa 'dug cing phyis kyang zhal mjal bar gda' yi gsungs nas lung bstan to/ /bdag cag la'ang chos rje pa nyid 'di'i res gdan sa nas phyag 'degs dus chen po grags pa dpal gyi brang khang du gdan drangs nas zhag gcig bzhugs 'dug pa'i tshe zhal ta gnang ba la/ sngar gyi 'phro'i chos bka' 'ga' zhu dgos yod pas phyag phyir 'gro dgos gsung zhing rang kyang 'dod chos 'dra zhu dgos yod pas 'gro chas byas na'ang / khams zi nas de res mthon/ rjes su'ang zhal lta bskyar ma byung bas 'bras yul du phyag phyi zin/ de nas zla ba dgu pa'i zhugs tsam la phyag bteg ste/ gnam phyogs la mdzad nas 'phan yul mthong smon du phebs/ de dus dpon chen dbang brtson pas dbus gtsang gi dmag chen bsdus nas yar lung du 'dren chas byas pa'i tshe/ mthong smon du swo na swi pa rnams dang sgom pa kun rig la sogs pa tshogs 'du cher byung dus dpon chen la gnang sbyin tshan chen po mdzad nas dmag gcog dgos pa'i zhal ta dang 'jam 'khrigs mdzad pa'i gsung nan chen po byon na'ang gtan ma nyan pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/

gong du mi 'byon par thag bcad de/ no ga tshe dben khams ma bde bar 'dam du song yod pa rdzong ba la byon dus stag lung du spyan drangs nas thugs bskyed zhus/ bsnyen bkur dang 'bul ba rgya chen po byas/ de dus chos rje pa'i drung du rin po che rad na a ka ras/ bdag rin po che nam mkha' dpal ba'i slob gnyer la 'jog par zhus/ de nas lam g.yang la la mdzad de byon pa'i tshe/ kha ba chen po babs pa dang grang dus yin pas 'khor rnams rang rang gi gos srin ma brtsegs nas bgos kyang lag pa mi thon pa tsam gyi shin tu grang po gyur na'ang / chos rje nyid thang rkyang mdzad de phyag 'khar bsnams nas byon pa na slar rlangs pa thol ba tsam 'dug pa la ngo mtshar bar gyur te zhus pas/ sngar gyi gtum mo'i grub thob rnams ras rkyang gi chog pa yin/ rang res kyang dmigs pa cung zad bzung bas khyad yong bar 'dug gsungs/ de nas grog 'khar du phebs te gser yig pa dang mjal/ gser gyi dam pe che ba gcig gis gtso byas rnga ma dkar nag la sogs pa mang po 'khor dang bcas pa la gnang sbyin dang rdzong phun sum tshogs pa mdzad/ dril bu ba dang tshe dpag med kyi dbang bskur gnang / sman spyad kyi zhal ta mdzad kyang / nad ljis pas 'das pa na/ ngan song sbyong ba'i cho ga dang / bsreg sbyong la sogs pa rjes kyi bya ba'i zhal ta gnang / yul de pa rnams kyis bsnyen bkun dang mar gyi dkar tog rgya cher phul/ so so'i bsam pa dang bag la nyal dang mthun pa'i sems bskyed la sogs pa chos kyi sbyin pa mdzad nas thar pa'i sa bon bzhag ste 'khor mtha' can du mdzad do/ /de nas phyir byon te ras sgang du phyag phebs/ dngul gdung che chung dang jo bo'i thugs dam rnams la 'dam nas byung ba'i mar thams cad phul/ rgya dpe rnams ka gnyis ma'i mdo'i khyams su gdan drangs te/ mchod bstod rgya chen mdzad pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon kha dog sna tshogs pa 'khrigs/

bka' gdam pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi rnam thar la sogs pa'i chos gsung pa'i tshe'ang me tog gi char chen po babs te thams cad ngo mtshar bar gyur to/ /de nas dben pa kho na mdzad par dgongs te/ gsol spyad na bza' byas chas la sogs phyag rdzas rnams stag lung du bskur nas bsnyen bkur 'bul ba rnam bzhag rgya cher mdzad do/ /rwa sgreng na bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun rnams la'ang gnang sbyin phun sum tshogs pa mdzad/ sku 'khor pa phal che la dril bu ba'i dbang bskur gnang zhing / rang rang gi mos pa dang mthun pa'i gtad gnyer dang gnang sbyin rgya chen mdzad nas so sor bkye ste/ chos don du gnyer ba nyi shu tsam dang bcas pa klung shod la mdzad de byon/ bdag gi zhal ta bzhin dgun stag lung du bsdad/ a gro rdzong pa la slob dpon mañdzu shrī pa mngags te/ de nyid kyi 'dod mos bstan 'gyur gyi dpe phal che ba dang bcas pa'i rdzong ba gnang sbyin phun sum tshogs pa mdzad/ de nas 'ol khar phebs pa mo lo dbon pos tshor te/ stag rtser sku bsnyel gso bar zhus nas thog gcig bzhugs te 'khor rnams la lam 'bras gsung / de nas glang lo zla ba dang po la dwags po sman lung du byon nas bzhugs dus/ bdag gis kyang slebs nas sngar gyi sgra'i 'phro'i kun bshad kyi mtshams nas rim gyis dbu btsugs te/ thugs sbyong mdzad cing zla ba drug gi bar du thugs dam la rtse gcig tu bzhugs so/ /de nas sgam por rin po che gong ma'i nang rten gyi rab gnas la gdan drangs te/ ca de yul gyi rong la lam mdzad de byon pas yul de pa nya pa'i grong yin cing / skyes bu dam pa 'di'i byin rlabs kyis nya ra rnams su nya gtan ma byung ba na/ bla ma byon pas nya lo nyes zhes smre bsngags 'don to/ /rgam por phebs nas rten la rab gnas rgya cher mdzad cing dbon po rin po cher bskos pa na/ rgam po ba rnams la phun sum tshogs pa'i yan lag 'phel zhing rgyas pas/

rab gnas legs zhes phyis grags/ de nas rdza ma yul du bla ma ston dar gyis mkhar klung bzangs zhes pa'i dben dgon phul nas phyag phebs/ de'i dus su sgra'i 'phro rdzogs pa dang / snyan ngag me long / dpag bsam 'khri shing / mngon pa mdzod rnams kyi bshad pa/ mdzod kyi 'grel bshad rgyal po sras/ gzhi bsdu ba/ rnam grangs bsdu ba/ rnam par bshad pa'i sgo bsdu ba/ mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa ra wi shrī dang / shong blo gros brtan pas mdzad pa rnams/ bdag gis phul nas thugs su chud par mdzad cing / stag lo tshes nas lo gcig gi bar du sku mtshams dam po bug sgo ma mdzad de su la'ang mjal phrad ma gtang bar thugs dam la rtse gcig tu bzhugs so/ /de nas yos lo la thog mar gdan 'dren la mkhan po shes rdor ba dang / bla ma ya rtse ba dang / slob dpon blo gros seng ge ba dang / mkhan po bkra shis seng ge ba bzhis byon nas/ gdan sar 'byon par zhu phul na'ang ma gnang / der rjes gdan sa chen po'i bla ma shar chen pa/ bla ma khang gsar ba/ bla ma kun spang pa rnams dang / snar thang mkhan chen blo bzang pa chen po dang / rin po che bu ston pa dang / mkhan chen bsod nams bzang po pa rnams gdan 'dren la byon te/ bla ma rnams dang mkhan chen blo bzang ba dbus su bzhugs/ gzhan mkhan chen zhal rnams pa dang / nang pa seng ge dpal dang bcas pa dwags por byon nas gdan sa chen por 'byon pa'i zhu ba mdzad na'ang / gtsang du 'byon pa ni ma gnang ste/ dbus su skor gcig 'byon par gnang nas/ spu gu rdor tshogs 'du mdzad cing / der tsha 'phrang dbon po dang gsol ja ba rgya mtshos gong ma'i gnang sbyin dngul bre gnyis dar khang gcig dang bcas pa sleb/ de dus sne gdong du spyan drangs nas zhabs tog dang 'bul nod phun sum tshogs pa mdzad/ de nas sngar gso rnams kyi zhal ta mdzad pa rnams gzigs pa la bsam yas kyi bar byon/ slar yang dwags por byon pa'i phyag phyir bla chen bsod nams blo gros pa'ang byon pa na/

gdan sa thel pas gdan drangs nas zhabs tog dang 'bul nod rgya cher bsgrubs/ de dus thel shod kyi sku mched gnyis thugs mthun pa'i zhal ta gnang / de nas lam 'ol kha la mdzad de dwags po dkar ngos kyi dgon pa thang thar zhes par zhag 'ga' bzhugs te/ bla chen pa'i bzhed chos rnams gnang ste/ de nyid gdan sar 'byon pa'i chos 'jig rten gyi zhal ta mdzad nas brdzangs/ de nas mkhar klung bzangs su 'byon pa'i lam du yon bdag rnams kyis nas dang mar thud kyi 'bul ba tshan chen po byung ba dang / snga phyir yang dwags po stod smad kyi yon bdag rnams kyis 'bul ba rgya cher byas pa rnams kyi chos don du gnyer ba'i dge 'dun brgya tsam re dus rtag tu 'khyongs pa byung ngo / /de ltar thugs dam dang gdul bya rnams kyi don rgya cher mdzad cing bzhugs pa'i tshe/ ma gcig pa bsnyun nas gdan 'dren byung ba na da res kyi bsnyun pa 'di la skyon mi yong bar 'dug phyis skabs su bab na nged cis kyang slebs pa byed gsung nas ma byon/ ji ltar gsung ba bzhin ma gcig pa yang dngas/ yang skabs zhig na chos rje brag phug pa la ngan pa'i mnal lam gcig byung bas sku rim la dmigs pa yin gsungs nas sku 'khor cho ga shes pa rnams dang bcas pas kyai rdo rje'i sgrub mchod sbyin sreg dang bcas pa brgya tshar btsugs dus/ lam 'bras rgyud pa'i phyag 'tshal dang gsol 'debs mdzad cing 'dug pa na sku rim yin na gsol 'debs 'di'i lugs med pas ci zhig snyam du the tshom du gyur pa na/ sgrub mchod ma grol tsam la brag phug pa chen po zhi bar gshegs pa'i thugs dam la 'dogs par zhu ba'i mi slob dpon ston shag slebs pas/ rgyu mtshan 'di rnams la'ang brten nas mngon shes thogs med mnga' bar yid ches so/ /de nas 'brug lo la sbrum du bzhugs dus/ ma gcig pa bsnyung ste bla ma rdor rgyal ba gdan 'dren la btang byung bas myur ba nyid du yar byon pa'i lam du sne gdong du gdan drangs bsnyen bkur dang 'bul nod rgya cher bsgrubs/

de nas mgyogs par byon te/ chos lung gi thad kar phebs dus da len rin po che bsod nams grags pa la ma mjal na phyis mi mjal ba srid par 'dug gsungs nas/ sku 'khor nyung shas gcig chos lung du byon nas mjal/ 'bul ba mdzad de byang 'khris la byon nas/ bo dong er chags phebs te yum sras mjal sems bskyed dang cho ga gnang / de nas zhag nyer lnga nas yum gshegs/ gshegs rdzong la snar thang yan chad stong skor bzhi dang lha sde gzhung gi dge 'dun rnams bsags nas bsnyen bkur 'bul ba dmar zho phyed re'i 'gyed dang bcas pa dang / sa skya'i tshogs chen por yang bsnyen bkur 'bul ba gser zho phyed re'i 'gyed dang bcas pa dang / drung pa rang gis gtso mdzad/ mkhan chen snar thang pa/ rin po che bu ston pa/ mkhan chen bsod nams bzang po la sogs pa cho ga grwa mang pos zhag bzhi bcu zhe dgu'i bar du mdzad cing / durga te gzungs sngags 'bum ther yang mdzad de/ mtshan ma bzang po yang byung gsungs/ gzhan yang zla mchod lo mchod la sogs pa dang / sa skya'i tshogs chen por yang lo re bzhin gro bzang ba re chos rje nyid zhi bar ma gshegs kyi bar du bsgrubs te/ ma gcig rnams kyi nang nas 'di nyid rang gshegs rdzong bzang bar grags so/ /de rjes bla chen bsod nams blo gros pa la na bza' ta hung ber thul gcig dang / chibs pa 'brong rje gnang / chen po dpal rgyal ba la na bza' thong rings du kha gcig gnang nas chos 'jig rten gyi zhal ta byon cing / khyad par du/ sngar yang ma gcig pa bla ma gong ma'i dus mchod rnams ma chag par sgrub tu bcug pa yin/ da dung yang khyed dpon slob kyis dus mchod 'di rnams sngar bzhin ma chag par sgrubs gsung ba'i zhal ta do dam chen po mdzad nas/ bla ma gong ma'i dus mchod la/ sa skya tshogs su gro lnga lnga gro bar re zla ja sgrub mchod la sogs lo re bzhin/ chos rje nyid zhi bar ma gshegs kyi bar du ma chag par bsgrubs so/

/de'i dpyid mkhan chen rin po che bsod nams grags pa zhi bar gshegs pa'i cho ga la gdan 'dren byung bas byon nas/ cho ga gsol 'debs mdzad/ yar byon pa na zha lur gdan drangs te zhabs tog 'bul ba phun sum tshogs pa bsgrubs/ da dus bsnyen rdzogs zhu ba brgya lhag tsam byung ngo / /de nas bo dong er byon te/ ma gcig pa'i nang rten mi 'khrugs pa'i gser sku chen po khri rgyab yol dang bcas pa dang / rin po che bsod nams grags pa'i nang rten thub pa'i gser sku chen po bzhengs pa'i phyag tshad la sogs pa'i zhal ta mdzad nas/ zla ba brgyad pa la ta dben blo gros rgyal mtshan pa'i bsnyen rdzogs la jo mo nang du gdan drangs te/ chos rje kun mkhyen chen po dang dam pa'i chos kyi 'bel gtam rgya cher mdzad/ de nas bla ma kun spangs pas bzang ldan du gdan drangs shing / ta dben nam mkha' ba dang gnyis pos kyai rdo rje'i dbang bka' zhus nas/ zhabs tog dang 'bul nod rgya cher bsgrubs/ de rjes lha rtser gdan drangs nas ta dben blo gros rgyal mtshan pas cho ga mang po zhus nas phyir 'byon pa'i lam du sag thang sdings su zhag gcig bzhugs nas zhang ston chos 'bar kyi sku bum la phyag dang mchod pa rgya cher mdzad/ slar er phebs te zla ba bcu gcig pa la ma gcig pa'i nang rten gyi rab gnas la rin po che bu ston pa spyan drangs te/ gtsug lag khang rnying par rdo rje rtse mo'i sa chog rgyas pa dang bcas te/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs nas rab tu gnas pa dang dga' ston rgya cher mdzad/ de nas sbrul lo zla ba dang po la gdan sa chen por bla ma dge ba'i bshes bsnyen dge 'dun dang bcas pas bsu ba bkur sti phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas te shing khang bla brang du bzhugs nas/ gdan sa'i dge ba'i bshes bsnyen phal mo ches lam 'bras kyi gzhung bshad rgyas pa khrid dang bcas pa zhus shing / lam 'bras dang 'brel pa'i dbang byin rlabs zhu ba bzhi brgya tsam nyi shu rtsa lngar bcad de cho ga rgyas par mdzad/

gdan sa chen po'i bla brang rnams kyi gtso mdzad pa thams cad kyis dga' spro chen po dang bcas te bsnyen bkur 'bul nod phun sum tshogs pa bsgrubs/ de'i dus su mkhan chen rin po ches lha khang bla brang du gsang 'dus rang nyid kyi ṭīkka'i steng nas bshad pa mdzad pa gsan cing / shing khang du'ang de nyid kyi ṭīkka'i steng nas bde mchog rtsa rgyud dang rdo rje 'byung ba'i bshad pa zhus/ de nas rta lo'i dpyid/ sku zhang ye shes kun dga' pa bzung ba 'don pa la zha lu pas gdan drangs nas dbus su byon te/ gong dkar du ta'i si stu pa la zhal ta mdzad nas sku zhang grol zhing / dpon chen rgyal bzang pa dang phag mo grub pa'i khrims mdzad nas lha sar byon/ jo bo la gser chab gsol zhing dkar me dang mchod bstod rgya cher mdzad/ de dus grom pa ri dang g.yu rtse brags nang pa grags dbang gis bzung zhing / lcags po ri phag mo grub pas bzung ste mi bde ba cher byung ba la/ chos rje'i drung nas thugs brtse ba chen pos phyogs phyogs su zhal ta byon cing 'khrigs mdzad rdzong rnams rang sar bsgyel te/ dbus phyogs kyi sems can rnams bde ba la bkod par mdzad do/ /de'i dbyar nyan por bzhugs te/ phar phyin dang spyod 'jug gi bshad pa dang dbang byin rlabs mang po dang bsnyen par rdzogs pa la sogs pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsis der gnas pa'i skye rgu rnams kyi blo'i lus tshims par mdzad do/ /de'i tshe zhag 'ga'i gong du nyan po'i shar phyogs kyi dgon pa zhig na/ gro sa kun mkhyen ces pa/ sha wa ri dbang phyug dang pha dam pa la sogs grub chen mang po'i zhal gzigs pa'i mkhas grub gcig bzhugs pa'i nyams snang la/ dgon pa de'i nub phyogs na/ ston pa thub pa chen po sher phyin gsung zhing 'dug pa gcig byung ba'i zhag 'ga' na/ chos rje pas nyan por phar phyin gsungs pas/ de yis rang gi 'khor rnams la sngar nga la nyams snang gcig byung ba de/

bla ma dam pas nyan por phar phyin gsung ba'i ltas su 'dug ces gsungs zhes grags so/ /yang de'i tshe dge bshes shes rdor zhes pa gcig gis stod lung nas/ chos rje pa'i drung du phyin pa na/ nyan pa'i chos khri'i steng na chos rje pa bzhugs pa rgyang ring nas mthong ba'i skad cig de'i tshe/ 'jam dbyangs nyid 'od zer dang bcas te bzhugs pa mthong bas yid rang dbang med par dad de/ myur bar myur bar rgyugs nas/ chos rje'i drung du slebs pa na/ maṇḍal gyi rgyan gzhan med pas rang nyid kyi lag pa g.yon pa'i sor mo lnga bcad de rgyan byed par brtsams nas rdos bsnun pas gung mdzub gnyis chad cing / gzhan gnyis chad du nye bar song yang sdug bsngal ma byung ba na/ chos rje nyid tab tab por mdzad de/ phyag phyis kyi dar gyis sor mo rnams bkris shing zhal chab mang po btab ste/ de'i nub mo/ nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs gnang bas/ zhag gcig gnyis nas sor mo rnams ma zha bar bsos so zhes thos so/ /de'i tshe 'bri khung pa'i sgom pa shākya bzang pos zhabs tog dang 'bul nod rgya cher bsgrubs/ de nas dbus kyi chos dpon rnams kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba btab ste snye thang du bzhugs nas/ dbus phyogs kyi mkhan slob dge ba'i bshes bsnyen sde snod 'dzin pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i tshogs dang / gzhan yang chos don du nyer ba'i gdul bya mtha' yas pa 'dus pa'i tshe/ lug lo'i dgun chos la thog mar phar phyin dang / rnam 'grel/ de nas brtag gnyis dang lam 'bras/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho/ sbyor drug dmar khrid/ chos rje khu dbon gyi bka' 'bum dang / dbang bka' mang po dang / so sor thar pa'i sdom pa la sogs pa gang la gang mos kyi chos kyi rnam grangs mang po gsungs nas gdul bya dpag tu med pa smin grol la bkod cing / dus phyis sde snod 'dzin pa'i tshogs 'du de nyid rang che bar grags so/

/bka' bzhi'i rigs grwa dang lung grwa chen po btsugs/ dge 'dun sum stong tsam 'dus/ mang ja re la ja zho sum cu bskol/ chos rje nyid kyis kyang bsnyen bkur dang / chos dpon rnams la na bza' ber thul gyi thog drangs pa'i 'bul ba rnam bzhag dang / dge 'dun so so'i phyag tu dar 'gyed dang bcas pa phun sum tshogs pa gnang / de'i dus si stu dge legs pas zhu ba po mdzad nas/ gur gar rgyas pa dang bcas pa'i gur rigs bsdus kyi dbang bka' rgyas pa mdzad/ de nas sprel lo'i dgun phag mo grur gdan drangs te/ zla ba gsum gyi bar du bzhugs nas/ dus 'khor gyi bshad pa lam 'bras kyi cha lag rdzogs pa/ sbyor drug nā ro chos drug dbang dang byin brlabs mang po gsungs/ spyan snga rin po che tshes bzhi pa dang / ta'i si stu ba gnyis kyi zhabs tog dang 'bul nod phun sum tshogs pa mdzad cing / nang so so so dge 'dun dang bcas pas kyang 'bul nod rgya cher bsgrubs pa rnams dang / sngar nas phyag na phyag rdzas ji snyed yod pa rnams la gzhi mdzad nas/ dpal bsam yas kyi gso rnams chen po mdzad pa la/ dbu rtse rig gsum gyi steng 'og gnyis la g.yu thog dang / lha khang gsar pa gsum g.yu thog gan ji ra dang bcas pa'i nang du shes rab snying po'i gleng gzhi'i thub pa 'khor dang bcas pa dang / thub pa chen po gnas brtan bcu drug gi bskor ba dang / ma hā kā la gtso 'khor gsum dang bcas pa rnams lde gur gsar du bzhengs/ dbu rtse rig gsum gyi steng 'og bar dang khor sa phyi nang gsum dang bcas pa'i sde gu rnying pa rnams gsos/ zhal ba dang ri mo thams cad gsar par mdzad/ mchod rten bzhi'i gdugs chos 'khor gan ji ra dang bcas pa re re la zangs khal nyis brgya re dang bku gser zho nyis brgya re song ste/ mdor na dbu rtse rigs gsum mchod rten bzhi dang bcas pa rgyal blon gyi bzhengs dus bzhin gsar pa kho nar mdzad cing /

de dus chos rje nyid kyis kyang sa rdo khur ba la sogs pa thugs rtsol chen po mdzad pas lo gcig gis khongs su legs par grub cing / de'i dbyar tshul bzhugs mdzad nas/ 'jam dbyangs gu shri pas zhu ba po mdzad de/ phar tshad brtag gnyis gsungs/ gzhan yang lam 'bras kyi gzhung bshad/ khrid dbang / byin rlabs/ sbyor drug dmar khrid/ tshogs chos chen mo la sogs pa'i chos bka' gsungs/ de'i zla ba bcu gnyis pa la nyan por gdan drangs nas zla ba gcig bzhugs shing / chos bka' zhus/ de'i tshe nyan po ba dang gro sa bka' dgon rgyal pa la sogs pa thams cad kyis/ mar gyi dkar tog tshan chen po phul/ de nas 'bri khung bas mkhar ba rir gdan drangs te/ sgom pa shākya bzang pos 'jigs byed kyi dbang bskur zhus shing zhabs tog rgya cher bsgrubs/ mar thud tshan cher phul ba rnams rab gnas la mkho bar byung / de nas bya lo zla ba dang po la rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs nas zhag bcu bdun gyi bar/ rab gnas kyi cho ga mdzad dus ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mo lan gsum mdzad pa'i dang po gar pa nyi shu rtsa bdun gyis rtsed mo nas gsungs pa'i sa chog rgyas pa/ bar ba la mnga' dbul rgyas pa glang chen la sogs pa'i mchod pa nyi shu rtsa gcig pa dang rigs ma bcu drug gi gar/ dngos gzhi'i me tog 'thor dus mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi bkra shis rgyas pa mdzad/ de'i nyin nam mkha' bai ḍūrya ltar dngas pa la 'ja' tshon kha dog sna tshogs pas spras pa las lha'i me tog kha dog sna tshogs pa'i char chen po babs/ mchod rten gyi bar rnams dar rings dang lda ldi dang rgyal mtshan dang 'phan la sogs pa bres te/ khyad par 'phags pa'i bkod pa ltar/ drung pa nyid kyis gtso mdzad rin po che'i zhal rnam pa mkhan slob dge 'dun khri phrag lhag tsam dang / skye bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa 'dus pa la/ chos dang zang zing gi longs spyod bsnyen bkur 'bul nod gral 'gyed dang bcas pa rgya cher bsgrubs te thams cad ngo mtshar bar gyur to/
