/dus de nas bzung ste sa der rims nad mu ge la sogs pa ma byung ba ni/ de'i byin rlabs yin par grags so/ /de dus cho ga rgyas pa mdzad pa la brten nas rdor dbyings kyi cho ga'i phyag srol dar rgyas su gyur pa ni/ chos rdzong / bsam yas/ rtse thang / gung thang / brag nag ri gong / bde lung / bkra shis sgang rnams su'ang ding sang gi bar du rdor dbyings kyi sgrub mchod tshugs so/ /de'i dus phyag dpe rnams kyang dwags po nas ma drangs par slar dwags por 'byon pa'i thugs dgongs su yod pa/ gong ma'i lung gser bre'i gnang sbyin dang bcas pa yod pa/ dpon chen dpal 'bum gyis khyer yong pa bzhin/ ta dben blo gros rgyal mtshan pa dang / ta'i si stu pa/ dpon chen rgyal bzang pa rnams kyis bla ma chos rgyal ba dang / bla ma bsod blo ba gnyis la gdan 'dren yod pas/ thugs gtser mi yong zhes nan gyis zhus shing / gdan sar gdan drangs te byon pa'i tshe gung thang du gdan drangs nas chen po dge blo ba sku mched yab sras kyis rdor dbyings kyi dbang bskur rgyas pa zhus te byon/ 'brog tu bla ma chos rgyal ba gong du 'byon pa'i rdzong pa mdzad/ 'u yug mdar khong pa'i sgar du gdan drangs nas/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang bskur zhus pa'i dkyil 'khor bris tshar ba'i nub zon byas kyang ma thub par dkyil 'khor ku ku rā dzas bsubs pa'i tshe/ chos rje'i gsung gis da song zhig gsungs/ ji lta ba bzhin ma gsung par/ sku rim la 'bad dgos par gda' zhes lung bstan/ phyis gong gi skad cha rnams gsan dus/ rgyud nas gsung pa'i rten 'brel 'di rnams cis kyang bden par 'dug gsungs so/ /de nas byang 'khris la byon te/ bo dong du phebs dus/ zhal ta bzhin chen po dpal rgyal bas bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po dbu rtse la g.yu thog gan ji ra dang bcas pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i gzhal yas khang dang khyams la zhing bkod kyi gang ba legs par tshar ba'i rab gnas la/

rin po che bu ston pa gdan drangs nas dpal mchog rdor sems dang rdor dbyings kyis thog drangs pa'i phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor mang po bzhengs te/ rab gnas kyi sa chog la rtse mo'i gar la sogs pa rnams bsam yas kyi ji lta ba bzhin dang / khyad par du sgrub pa rjes sgrub kyi gar rgyas pa mdzad cing / dga' ston rgya cher bsgrubs te thams cad ngo mtshar bar gyur/ de nas khyi lo la sa skyar byon te/ tshogs su brtag gnyis gsungs/ de'i dpyid bla chen pas stag tshang rdzong khar spyan drangs nas chos bka' mang po zhus/ de nas de'i gzims khang ser por 'dag char dam po la zla bzhi'i bar du thugs dam la rtse gcig tu bzhugs/ de'i skabs zhig na bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa la ngan pa'i mnal lam gcig byung gsungs nas/ sku rim pa la dmigs pa'i sgrub mchod zhag 'ga' mdzad/ dus phyis gshegs pa'i skad thos dus rtsis pa na dus mtshungs par 'dug ces zer/ de nas zla ba dgu pa la bzhi thogs pa lha rtse nas babs nas rin dpungs su 'byon dgos byung ba'i grogs ldan la drung nas byon pa'i tshe/ ri bo bde ldan du mkhan chen gzhon nu mgon po gdan drangs te/ phal po che 'phro zhus/ yar res chos lung du byon dus chos rje kun mkhyen chen po la bka' bsdu bzhi pa'i lung gsan/ de nas gdan sar byon te/ dgun chos gsungs pa'i tshe/ skabs zhig na mnal lam du hor 'ga' zhig gis sgor mo lung med pa phul ba rmis/ mnal sad nas thugs dgongs la hor gyi gdan 'dren gcig yong par 'dug na'ang 'gro mi dgos pa 'dug snyam zhes gsungs so/ /de nas gser yig pa dharmā kīrti dang blo gros grags gnyis slebs pa'i skad gsan nas/ phag lo zla ba dang po'i tshes gsum la sku 'khor bcu bdun dang bcas pas/ kha'u'i phu la byon te lam lho rgyud la mdzad nas lho rong du 'byon chas mdzad pa la shar kha bas tshor te ma thon par/

byang la 'khyogs te/ lcags kyi phu'i g.yu lung zhes par zhag bdun bzhugs nas 'phral chas bsgrubs/ de'i tshe gser yig pa rnams kyis tshong dus su slebs pa na/ thag shin tu nye bas 'khor rnams skrag pa la/ drung gi zhal tas de tsam shes pa'i gdeng gcig yod pas skrag mi dgos gsungs so/ /de nas bco lnga'i mtshams bskyang ste/ sha tsha rab la mdzad nas byang 'khrigs la byon te/ dwags po'i zo la'i rtse mor zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gsum la phebs pa'i nub kha ba shin tu chen po bab pas rdza rong rnams kha bas gang nas lam ma rnyed/ g.yas g.yon la 'khyogs na cong rong 'jigs su rung la 'chor ba'i nyen yod pas 'khor kun rtab rtab por gyur pa la/ chos rje'i gsung gis a'u 'di na sems can gyi rjes gcig 'dug pas de ji ltar song ba'i rjes la sna drongs shig gsungs/ ji skad gsung bzhin byas pas lam ji ltar yod pa la ma 'jol bar byung bas nyi ma phyed tsam la gangs thon te ngo mtshar bar gyur cing de rang chos skyong gi rnam 'phrul gcig cis kyang yin pa 'dra zer/ de ltar zla ba gnyis kyi bar nyin mo bzhugs shing mtshan mo byon pas sku bsnyel ba gso ba'i phyir zo nang gi brag phug gcig tu zhag gsum bzhugs/ de'i tshe chos rje'i gsung gis gdan 'dren 'di yis bdag gzhan thams cad rgyun du sbyangs/ da ni gtser pa mi yong ba'i sa phyogs zhig tu gzhan gang gis kyang ma tshor bar byas te/ dben pa kho na bsten nas dge sbyor la rtse gcig tu 'dril ba gcig byed gsung ba la/ slob dpon mañdzu shrī pas da lan de bzhin mdzad na gser yig pa'i rnam rtog nye 'khor zhig na bzhugs snyam nas/ gzhi pa rnams la 'jur stabs 'chi bas/ 'dir phebs pa ma gsang bar 'byon pa thugs kyi ma longs pa'i zhal ta bskur ba 'thad lags zhes zhus pas/ de'ang bde gsungs nas byon te mkhar klung bzangs su bzhugs/ dpon grags pas zhu ba byung ba la de lugs kyi zhal ta gnang /

de'i tshe dwags po'i bu slob rnams dga' mgu rangs pa'i bsam pa dang bcas te drung du 'dus nas so so'i bsnyen bkur dang 'phral chas kyi 'bul ba bsgrubs shing / khrid bka' la sogs pa'i chos zhus/ der chos rje mkhan chen grags tshul ba 'ja' sa'i zhal bshugs dang gser yig pa'i zhu yig dang bcas te/ gdan 'dren la mngags nas nges par 'byon dgos/ ci ste mi 'byon na dmag sde yong ba yod zer ba byung ba na/ chos rje'i gsung gis hor shin tu bden zhing rang nyid mi bden par yod na'ang / sngar na so gzhon dus 'gro bar rigs pa la blo yis ma longs/ da rgas nas phyin kyang khong rnams la phan chung zhing rang la gnod pa gcig las mi yong / bla ma pher ba'i dbon po mang po yod pas gang 'os pa gdan 'dren pa 'thad/ de la nan brtsir byas kyang nga tshe'i bar chad du 'gro ba ma gtogs/ gzhan phugs gtan mi yong / dmag mi yong ba'i rgyus nga rang la yod gsungs nas mi 'byon pa thag chod pa'i zhal ta bskur/ de nas gser yig pa dam pa'i chos la dad cing / drung pa nyid la'ang mos par dgongs te gser yig pa la mjal kha gtong zhing / drung du'ang gdan 'dren gyis thugs gtser mi yong ba'i chad mdzad nas/ zla ba bdun pa la bla chen po dang / dharma kīrti dang bcas pa ca de yul du mjal 'phrad mdzad cing / bde mchog dril bu ba'i cho ga gnang / rdzong ba mdzad/ de'i tshe bla ma gong ma rnams kyi dus mchod la dmigs te/ sa skya'i tshogs su bzhi zho'i 'gyed 'bul ba/ bsam yas dang brgya grong du dge 'dun skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa la gro'i bsnyen bkur nas kyi khal 'gyed dang / gdan sa thel dang rtse thang zol bu/ gsang phu/ chos 'khor gling rnams su gro ja dang bcas pa dang / dbus gtsang gi dgon sde thams cad du'ang ja skol 'bul ba dang bcas pa sgrub pa'i zhal ta mdzad de/ dpon she ba dang dpon bsang dbang pa mngags/ slar phyir byon nas lo gcig gi bar du sku mtshams mdzad cing /

don du gnyer ba'i gdul bya mang po la lam 'bras dang sbyor drug la sogs pa khrid bka' mang po bug sgo nas gnang / nang du thugs dam dang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i ṭīkka mdzad/ de yang ṭīkka rtsom pa'i grabs mdzad pa'i tshe/ nub gcig gi rmi lam du bud med sngo gsang rgyan dang bcas pa gcig gis snag myug gcig gtad nas/ da bris shig zer ba'i snang ba gcig byung bas/ mgo thom pa gcig 'ong bar 'dug snyam pa byung gsungs/ de nas glang lo zla ba dang po la as bu dben shri la gdan 'dren gdam kha can yod zer ba gsan te/ gzhan su la'ang rgyus med pa mdzad nas/ sku 'khor bzhis brag rings zhes pa'i dben gnas su byon te/ zla ba drug gi bar du thugs dam kho na la rtse gcig tu bzhugs/ sku mtshams mdzad pa zhig la 'di kho na dben par byung bas shin tu mnyes te/ nga 'di bzhin rang byas na dben zhing dge sbyor 'phel bar 'dug gsungs/ de tshe nyin mtshan 'khor yug bsgom khang du ting nge 'dzin nyid la bzhugs pa na/ slob dpon mañdzu shrī pas sku lus cung zad re ma bcags na skyon ma mchis lags zhes zhus pas/ ting nge 'dzin gnad du song na de nyid lus sbyong du'ang 'gro ba yin par 'dug pas khams shin tu bzang bar byung gsungs/ yang de'i skabs zhig na/ slob dpon chen po bsod blo ba gong du 'degs par byas 'dug na'ang / 'di lta bu'i rigs la dus sbyor gnyis ka'i rang bzhin la 'degs dgos pa la g.yo ba'i dus sbyor la bteg 'dug gsung ba la/ slob dpon mañdzu shrīs/ drung gi mnal lam yin gsung yang thugs shes kho nar yong gin gda' ba ci 'dra lags zhus pas/ de snga res dwags por mtshams dam pa'i dus gcig na/ mthong snang gcig la sa skya'i lha khang skor dang khang gsar skor rnams zhig ral du song 'dug pa gcig byung / de rang la nges pa med snyam tsa na/ phyis sa skyar phyin dus de rnams mthong bas sngar gyi de dran nas mthong snang la'ang stong gzugs dang kun rdzob rang bzhin pa mthong ba gnyis yong ba 'dug snyam du yid ches/

de ltar du rigs kyang mngon shes kyi char 'gro bar 'dug gsungs/ rkyen med par tho rangs gsal po byung ba'i rmi lam la'ang / sad pa ni bzang ngan gyi yid ches brtan po byung na/ phal cher bden pa gcig yong gin 'dug gsungs/ de nas zla ba bdun pa la bla chen bsod nams blo gros pa gong du 'byon par byas nas dbus su phebs dus/ dpon dar ma rgyal mtshan mngags te/ drung pa dang ma mjal na gong du mi 'byon gsung ba'i zhu ba byung bas/ mjal phrad mdzad pa'i zhal ta gnang ste/ bla chen pa rdzong ba la mtha' rgyas su byon nas phur pa'i dbang bka' dang drag po'i rjes gnang mdzad/ 'khor dang bcas pa la rdzong ba rgya chen gnang / slar dwags por 'byon chas yod pa la/ ta'i si stu pas zhu ba nan can phul nas/ dbus kyi sa cha'i gang dges par gzim khang gcig brtsigs nas 'bul/ da thugs gtser mi yong bas ci nas bzhugs par zhus pas/ re zhig bzhugs par gnang ste/ skyid smad phyogs la byon zhing rgya grong du phebs/ de nas gzhis ma rnams bye la la btang ste/ drung nas sku 'khor lngas chos rdzong gi sa cha gzigs gzhung ko la byon pa na/ gzhung gi thad ka'i gtsang po kha zheng che sar phebs dus/ glo bur du rlung po che shin tu chen po byung bas/ rba klong gis ko nub la khad byung ba na gzhan rnams dngangs skrag par gyur kyang / drung nas nyams mi mnga' bar/ da lan nyan ci yang mi yong skrag mi dgos gsung nas dbyugs phyung / re zhig nas rlung po zhi ba na 'ja' nyis rim du zug 'dug pa mthong bas slar skrag pa la/ chos rje'i gsung gi 'ja' zug pa nyid rten 'brel legs/ chos rdzong gi gzhi bdag de'i 'tshub gcig yin par 'dug gsungs/ de nas gnod pa ci yang ma byung bar 'phrang por phebs te der zhag 'ga' bzhugs/ de nas slob dpon shākya rin chen pa'i bshad gsar la rtse thang du gdan drangs nas/ bzhi thog pa dang spyan snga grags she ba la sogs thel shol gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen che btsun mang po la 'bul nod rgya cher bsgrubs pa'i gral dbu mdzad/

de nas bsam gtan gling du zla ba gsum tsam bzhugs te/ chos rje rgyal sras pa dang bcas pa sku mtshams mdzad nas thugs dam la bzhugs/ de'i tshe spyan snga grags pa byang chub pa dgung lo drug bzhes pa la/ tshe dpag med/ kyai rdo dril bu ba 'khor chen rnams kyi dbang bka' gnang ba'i tshe/ rjes zlos la sogs brjod pa rnam par dag pas/ chos rje'i zhal nas 'di la chos kyi bag chags 'thug po 'dug pas bstan pa la phan pa gcig yong bar 'dug ces lung bstan no/ /de nas gdan sa thel gyi lha khang gsar pa gser 'bum dang bcas pa'i rab gnas la gdan drangs te/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs nas bsam yas kyi rab gnas la dpe blangs pa mdzad cing / dga' ston dang 'bul nod rgya cher bsgrubs/ slar bsam yas su byon nas bzhugs dus/ bla chen pa la ngan pa'i mnal lam ci byung gsungs nas/ dbus gtsang gi dgon sde thams cad du ja skol 'bul ba dang bcas pa btang / chos rje nyid kyis gtso mdzad/ drung bzhi thog pa dang bcas pa cho ga ba grwa mang pos kyai rdo rje sgrub mchod sbyin sreg dang bcas pa brgya rtsa mdzad dus/ rten 'brel brtags pas/ bla chen pa la sku tshe ring po gcig mi yong bar 'dug gsung ba'i lung yang bstan no/ /de rjes ta'i si stu pa'i sku rim la dmigs pa'i kyai rdo rje'i sgrub mchod sbyin sreg dang bcas pa brgya rtsa gcig mdzad/ de nas stag lo zla ba gnyis pa la chos rdzong du byon te/ 'u lag la sogs ma bskul bar sku 'khor rnams kyis gzim khang ka gnyis ma'i skor brtsigs pa na/ bde ba can pa la sogs pa dgon sde so so'i tshogs pa rnams kyi dad blang mdzad de brtsigs pas mgyogs par tshar te las 'phro bcad pa'i tshe/ ta'i si stu pa mjal phrad la byon dus/ 'di ha cang chung pas rgya chen po gcig brtsigs nas 'bul zhus pas/ rgya chen po so mi sod cing gzhan la'ang gnod gsungs nas ma gnang /

'o na rgyab 'dir mchod khang ka bzhi ma gcig cis kyang brtsigs nas 'bul bar zhu zhes zhus nas brtsigs te phul lo/ /de rnams byas pa don yod par bya ba'i phyir lha mang po'i ri mo khyad par du 'phags pa bzhengs/ de'i bar rnams su drung bzhi thog kun dga' rin chen pas dbang bka' dang byin rlabs mang du gsan pas/ si stu chos rin pas zhu ba po mdzad de/ ṭīkka'i steng nas dus 'khor gyi bshad pa rgyas pa gsungs/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen hrags la mang ba lnga bcu tsam 'dus te/ dka' ba'i gnas rnams su rgal rtags rgya cher mdzad/ gzhan yang khrid dbang byin rlabs mang du mdzad/ yos lo zla ba dang po la sku mtshams mdzad nas thugs dam dang don du gnyer ba'i gdul bya mang po la khrid bka' la sogs gang la gang mos kyi chos mang po gnang / de nas zla ba dgu pa la pakshi gzhon nu dpal gyi gong 'khor te dbus gtsang gi sa cha gang mnyes sar bzhugs nas bstan pa'i bya ba la brtson par mdzod ces pa'i lung dang / yab sras gnyis kas gser bre re res thog drangs pa'i gnang sbyin dang bla chen pas gtso mdzad dpon mo mi dpon pakshi la sogs pas 'bul ba dngul bre chen brgyad dang spyad pa gos dar tshan chen po dang bcas pa slebs/ bla chen pa dpon slob gshegs pa'i skad kyang zur tsam gsan nas/ chen po dpal rgyal ba la zhal ta bskur/ sa skyar brgya tsho'i gsol 'debs cho ga ci lcogs bsgrubs gsung ba mdzad/ zla ba bcu pa la sne gdong du gdan drangs nas dbang bka' 'ga' zhus/ zhabs tog dang 'bul ba rgya cher bsgrubs/ de nas dpal bsam yas su zla ba bcu gcig pa la byon te/ bla chen pa dpon slob kyi gshegs rdzong la bsam yas kyi dge 'dun skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa la bsnyen bkur nas gyi khal 'gyed dang bcas pa dang / snye sbur gyi dge 'dun skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa la ja bur 'bul ba dang bcas pa dang / dbus gtsang gi dgon sde thams cad du ja skol mdzad/

gsol 'debs la drung nas gtso mdzad/ skyi shod chos dpon rnams la dang / brag nag dpal ri la sogs pa'i sngags pa'i bla ma rnams dang / jo gdan tshogs pa bsam yas kyi gzhis pa dang bcas pa cho ga ba nyis brgya lhag tsam gyis cho ga zhag dgu'i bar du phyag len thams cad khrigs gcig la yong ba'i bkod pa mdzad/ zhabs tog 'bul ba rgya chen bsgrubs/ de la brten nas dbus phyogs su'ang phyag len gyi khrigs de dar bar gyur to/ /de nas mtshal pas spyan drangs nas/ chen po ba yab sras kyis chos zhus/ zhag 'ga' bzhugs par gsol ba btab na'ang / rang re la gtser ba gcig yong ba'i rigs su 'dug pas 'dir bsdad na gzhis pa rnams la gnod gsung nas ma gnang zhing 'bul nod rgya cher bsgrubs/ de nas chos rdzong du byon pa'i zhag gsum na glo bur du gser yig pa da ltar dben shris slebs nas lta sgo la byon te rdzong skyar zhag 'ga' bzhugs/ de nas mtshan 'gros mdzad de dam shod la byon pa'i tshe/ rdzong ji ba la zhal ta gnang ste/ sger pa gling du mjal nas 'byon bzhud kyi bka' gros mdzad/ 'phral chas gang dgos phul zhing / spyir yang chos rje nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob pas snga phyir dwags po la sogs pa phyogs gang du bzhugs kyang gsol ja dang na bza' ma chad par phul bas zhabs tog dmigs su 'gro bar byung ngo / /de nas 'brug lo zla ba bcu pa la mkhar lung bzangs su phebs ste/ gsang nas thugs dam la rtse gcig tu bzhugs pa tshe/ chen po dge blo ba byon nas 'dod chos mang po zhus/ de nyid bsnyung gzhi rnying pas skyen byas nas gshegs pa'i 'pho ba'i gsal 'debs dang bsreg sbyong la sogs pa'i phyag len dang cho ga zhag mang po'i bar du mdzad/ der rjes mkhan chen rin po che bu ston dpon po bde bar gshegs par skad byung nas gsol 'debs la/ kyai rdo rje'i cho ga zhag mang po'i bar mdzad/ gdung 'bul dngul bre chen gnyis kyis gtso byas pa'i dngos po mang po bskur nas ston pa blo rgyal btang /

dbus kyi sde dgon phal che bar ja bur 'bul ba dang bcas pa bsgrubs/ de nas zla ba bcu pa la bla chen pa'i chos 'khor gyi zhal ta la nan gyis gdan drangs nas dbur stod la byon/ 'bri khung rin po che si stu dgon pa dang bcas pas mjal 'phrad mdzad/ zhabs tog dang 'bul nod phul du phyin pa bsgrubs/ der chos 'khor du bsus te zhal ta mdzad dus/ ta'i si stu ba zhi bar gshegs nas gdan drangs/ de'i tshe sngon chad sus kyang thos ma myong ba'i mya ngan bsal ba'i gtam sa bcad lung 'dren dang bcas pa mdzad pas mkhas pa rnams kyang ngo mtshar bar gyur cing / cho ga zhag mang po mdzad/ gser bres thog drangs pa'i 'bul ba rgya chen bsgrubs/ gser yig pas thag ma chod pas slar yang phyag phyi la dus 'khor don du gnyer ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po dang bcas pa sbrul lo zla ba brgyad pa la mkhar klung bzangs su byon te/ dus 'khor bshad pa rgyas shing rdzogs pa/ lam 'bras kyi cha lag rdzogs pa/ gzhan yang man ngag mang po dang bcas pa'i chos bka' mang pos gdul bya dpag tu med pa smin grol la bkod do/ /de ltar lo gcig bzhugs nas/ rta lo zla ba brgyad pa la bya ba dpon 'das pa'i dge rtsa'i ser chags kyi gral dbu la dbyar sar spyan drangs pa'i dus su sngar slob dpon shes rab dpal la phyag rdzas kyang bskur/ zhal ta mdzad nas kong po'i nas par dus 'khor thugs dkyil gyi dkyil 'khor blos bslang ma chen mo bzhengs pa tshar ba'i rab gnas dang / chos rje pa la dad pa thob pa'i phrog mi'i gtso rgan gcig gis bu la kha chems bzhag ste/ nga'i dge ba la gzhan mi dgos/ bla ma sa skya pa cis kyang gdan drongs pa gcig gyis zhes pa dang / gzhan yang kong po byin gyis nan gyis gdan drangs pa la brten nas byon te/ kong po ral gsum ka la phyag phebs nas yul sde re rer yang so so'i bsam pa dang bstun nas thugs bskyed rgyas pa re re gsungs/

gson gshin gyi bsngo ba dpag tu med pa mdzad de/ sems can mtha' yas pa la thar pa'i sa bon bzhag rta brgya 'bul lngas thog drangs pa'i 'bul ba tshad med pa byung / de dus gnam tho tshal du gtso bo rnams dang phan tshun sha 'khon zhugs pa'i mi rnams bsags nas/ mdzo rta gsum brgya tsam gyi gnang sbyin mdzad cing gtor dbang bskur nas dam pa bzhag ste/ lo gcig gi bar du jag dang phan tshun rtsod pa mi byed pa'i khrims mdzad/ de nas sbu chung lha khang du zhag 'ga' bzhugs te/ de'i jo bo'i drung du sman bla brgya rtsa gcig mdzad de gsol ba btab/ rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dbu skra'i thal ba dang sku mtshal gyi bris pa'i 'bum nag dang 'bum dmar du grags pa zhal phye zhing / mchod bstod mdzad pa'i tshe me tog gi char dang / dge ba'i ltas du ma byung / de nas dus 'khor gzhal yas khang gi rab gnas la thugs dkyil gyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te rab gnas rgya cher mdzad cing de rnams kyi chas dang dga' ston la tshogs pa'i dge 'dun dang skye bo dpag tu med pa la ston mo dang bcas pa chos rje nyid kyis gnang / lha khang gi zhabs tog gi chos la'ang mdzo rta mang po gnang ngo / /de ltar chos rje'i byin rlabs dang skye bo de rnams kyang chos rje nyid la lhag par dad pa'i mthus/ mthong chos kyi 'bras bu la'ang lo thog la sogs pa'i rtsi bcud rnams sngar las lhag par rgyas shing / lo mang po rims nad dang 'khrugs long rnams kyang rgyun chad/ rang rang gi 'dod mos kyi smon lam btab pa rnams kyang ji lta ba bzhin grub pas yid ches te/ slar ches shin tu dad par gyur cing / sngar thugs bskyed gsungs pa'i chos khri rnams kyang mchod rten lta bur mchod gnas su gyur te/ phyag dang skor ba byas pas 'phral gyi rkyen bzlog pa yod ces thos so/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe/ 'o thang mtsho mo zhes pa'i yul sde chen por/

nyang kong gi gtsang chu lo mang po'i gong nas zug pas yul sde de chus khyer du nye ba la thabs gzhan ci byas kyang ma phan par yul sde thon pa la thug par gyur/ der chos rje la gsol ba btab ste/ gtsang khar byon nas gtor ma btang dmigs pa mdzad bkra shis brjod pas/ de'i lo nas chu legs par 'gyur bas ngo mtshar bar gyur to/ /de nas lug lo zla ba dang po la bod lung la mdzad de bya ber kha'i thub pa rang byon gyi drung du byon nas/ zla ba gcig bzhugs shing kong po nas byung ba'i mar rnams phul te sman bla brgya tshar mdzad/ de'i tshe rtsa ri gsar rnying nas bsnyen rdzogs zhu ba sum brgya lhag tsam byung / gzhan yang thugs bskyed la sogs pa'i chos mang po gsungs so/ /de nas bya pas gdan drangs te/ dmyal smad kyi yang rtser byon nas/ der zla ba gsum tsam sku mtshams mdzad thugs dam la bzhugs so/ /de rjes ta dben kun legs pas gtso mdzad bya ba dang bcas pa la phur pa dang 'jigs byed skyo lugs kyi dbang gnang / slar te rar gdan drangs te bzhugs nas dbyar chos la brtag gnyis dang lam 'bras la sogs chos bka' mang po gnang ngo / /de'i tshe gser phye 'bum pa'i drung du mchod bstod rgya cher mdzad cing / dmyal smad kyi dge 'dun skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa la thugs bskyed gsungs pa'i skabs su bzung du btub pa'i me tog char khyad par can babs/ chos rje'i zhal nas kyang rten ngo mtshar can gcig yin par 'dug gsung / de nas 'jam dbyangs gug shrī pas gdan 'dren rim pas btang bas dbus su byon pa'i lam du/ g.ya' bzangs pa dang jo bo pa la sogs pa'i sde dgon rnams kyis dad pas blangs pa'i 'bul gnod dang bsnyen bkur rgya cher bsgrubs te/ sne gdong du gdan drangs nas/ drung grags rin pa zhi bar gshegs pa'i nang rten thub pa'i gser sku chen po'i rab gnas mdzad pas/ thub pa'i mdzod spur nas kyi rtse mo 'byar ba zhag brgyad kyi bar chags pas/

kun ngo mtshar zhing / de dus drung bsod grags pa rab tu byung ba'i mkhan po mdzad/ dbang bka' bcu bzhi byin brlabs mang po dang bcas pa'ang mdzad dus dga' ldan rtser snga dro tshe dpag med kyi dbang mdzad pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' la rol mo'i sgra du ma grags pa mang pos tshor ba byung zhes gleng zhing / zhabs tog dang gser bre thog drangs pa'i 'bul ba rgya cher bsgrubs/ de nas gdan sa thel du gdan drangs/ zla ba phyed bzhugs nas gsang 'dus la sogs dbang bka' mang rab zhus shing / 'bul ba zhabs tog rgya cher mdzad do/ /de nas sprel lo zla ba dang po la bsam yas dang chos rdzong du bzo rigs pa rnams bsags nas/ lha sa'i jo bo rin po che'i khri rgyab yol gsar du bzhengs/ mdzad pa bcu gnyis 'jigs pa brgyad skyob rnams 'phul/ rgyan sna drug gi glang chen bzhi dang / g.yas g.yon gyi ldem byams pa dang spyan ras gzigs kyi sku lugs ma la rin po che du mas spras pa bzhengs pa'i bsku gser kho na la mgur srang brgyad cu bgrangs pa gsol zhing / de'i nyis 'gyur gyis yon rdzong gnang ste zla ba bcu gnyis pa la gur rigs bsdus dang / dpal mchog rdor sems kyi dkyil 'khor chen po dang / gzhan yang phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor mang po dang / jo gdan sde gnyis kyi sman bla lha dang bcas pa'i cho ga zhag mang po bsam yas kyi rab gnas la dpe blangs pa dang / dge 'dun dpag tu med pa la dga' ston dang / 'bul ba rnam bzhag rgya cher mdzad cing / de'i tshe ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang du byung ngo / /de nas bya lo zla ba gsum pa la dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang pos gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ snye thang du dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bshad pa rgyas pa gsungs/ sde snod 'dzin pa dpag tu med pa tshogs te/ lung rigs kyi 'bel gtam rgya cher mdzad nas gsung rab kyi don mtha' yas pa gtan la phabs ste/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa nyi mor mdzad do/ /dbus phyogs kyi dus 'khor gyi 'chad nyan gcig la de nyid rang sde snod 'dzin pa'i tshogs 'du che bar grags shing /

shong 'gyur/ 'bro 'gyur/ rwa 'gyur la sogs pa'i dpe 'grems brgya lhag tsam byung / gzhan yang sems 'grel gyi skor dang dus 'khor gyi cha lag rdzogs pa'i lung mdzad de/ chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pas gdul bya mang po'i bsam pa tshims par mdzad do/ /de'i dbyar gtsang gi nyang stod du dmag 'khrugs kyi mi bde ba cher byung ba la/ chos rje pa'i drung nas khrigs la byon te/ phyogs phyogs su zhal ta mdzad nas mi bde ba rnams zhi bar mdzad do/ /slar yang phyir byon te/ chos rdzong du phebs nas/ chos rje rgyal sras pa'i gsol 'debs mdzad/ nang rten sman bla'i gser sku chen po bzhengs/ de nas zla ba bcu gcig pa la mtshal pas gdan drangs te/ khu dbon pas gur rigs bsdus dang phur pa'i dbang rgyas pa zhus/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa la rin po che bcu gnyis pa bsnyung bas/ thel du gdan drangs te/ bde dges dang gzungs grwa lnga'i dbang bskur mdzad pas/ sku khams legs par dngas te ngo mtshar bar gyur cing / slar yang nag 'jigs la sogs pa'i dbang bka' mang po dang rtsa dbu ma'i khrid zhus/ zhabs tog 'bul nod rgya chen bsgrubs/ spyan snga rin po che grags pa byang chub rab tu byung ba'i mkhan po mdzad do/ /khyi lo zla ba gnyis pa la sne gdong dga' ldan rtse'i lha khang gi rab gnas la gdan drangs nas/ rtse mo'i rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs te/ sa chog la sogs pa rab gnas kyi cho ga rgyas pa mdzad/ de nas bsam yas su phyag phabs te/ dpon grags pas zhu ba po mdzad nas/ rdo rje phur pa'i cho ga rgyas pa tshar gnyis mdzad/ de rjes bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa dang / drung bsod nams grags pa'i bshad gsar gyi gral dbu la sne gdong du gdan drangs/ de nas nang gi rlung ltas la sku tshe'i bar chad gcig yod par mkhyen nas/ dbye'i chab tshan la bsnyad de/ dgon pa go ra gdong la dben par dgongs nas der sku mtshams dam po mdzad de/

rdo rje'i bzlas pa 'bum khrag gcig lhag tshar ba dang / chos rje'i gsung gis da rlung de sor chud byung bas lo lnga 'tsho bar yod na'ang / mañdzu shrī la bar chad gcig yong ba 'dra bas mgyogs por 'gro dgos gsungs nas byon na'ang / jo bo pas nan gyis gdan drangs pas zhag gcig gis 'gyangs nas zla ba drug pa'i nyer gnyis la slob dpon mañdzu shrī pa gshegs tshar te/ de yang 'di nyid lo brgyad lon pa nas chos rje rin po che'i zhabs la gtugs/ bcu gnyis pa la rab tu byung / sum cu rtsa gcig pa la bsnyen par rdzogs te/ nyes ltung gi dri mas ma gos par/ lo bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi'i bar du chos rje nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs te/ mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan pos zhabs tog tshul bzhin du bsgrubs pa la/ dbang po rab bla ma'i mos gus kyis grol bar gsungs pa'i tshul dang mthun par ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te gshegs/ de'i gshegs rdzong la bsam yas kyi dge 'dun skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa la bsnyen bkur nas kyi khal 'gyed dang bcas pa dang / chos rdzong du bsnyen bkur gyi dge 'dun skye bo'i tshogs dang bcas pa la bsnyen bkur gser gyi gral 'gyed dang / gdan sa chen pos gtso mdzad gtsang gi 'brel yod rnams su tsha dro 'gyed dang bcas pa dang / dbus gtsang gi dgon sde rnams su ja skol 'bul ba dang bcas pa chos rje nyid kyis gnang zhing / cho ga la drung nas gtso mdzad pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor mang po bzhengs te zhag dgu dang / chos rje nyid kyi zhag bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'i bar du cho ga dang / durga ti'i gzungs sngags 'bum ther dang bcas pa mdzad de/ mtshan ma bzang po byung gsungs/ de'i zla ba dgu pa la spyan snga rin po che bcu gnyis pa zhi bar gshegs pa la gdan drangs te/ gsol 'debs kyi cho ga dang sku gdung 'ju ba'i phyag len dang gshegs rdzong gi gral dbu mdzad cing ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma byung ngo /

/de nas phag lo'i dpyid spyan snga rin po che grags pa byang chub pas bsam yas su gdan drangs te/ brtag gnyis kyi bshad pa/ lam 'bras kyi gzhung bshad/ khrid bka'/ de rnams dang 'brel pa'i dbang bka'/ lung bka'/ byin rlabs/ rjes gnang la sogs pa cha lag rdzogs pa dang / bde mchog rim lnga/ nā ro chos drug dmar khrid rnams kyi khrid dang byin rlabs/ phur pa'i dbang bka' rgyas pa/ ye shes le'u'i bshad pa la sogs chos bka' mang po zhus shing / zhabs tog dang 'bul nod rgya cher bsgrubs/ de nas mkhan chen grags rgyal bas zhu ba po mdzad de/ rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang bka' ma lus pa thugs la mdzad/ de rjes zla ba bcu gcig pa la gsang khang rtser gdan drangs te/ 'jam dbyangs gu shrī pa dang / spyan snga rin po che pa/ gur brtag saṃ gsum gyi bshad pa/ sbyor drug gi khrid/ dbang bka' mang po dang bcas pa zhus/ de nas byi lo zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu gnyis la/ jo bo pas yar lungs phu mda' na bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun rnams gdan drangs te/ chos 'khor rgya chen zhag bdun gyi bar mdzad pa'i gral dbu la gdan drangs shing / tshogs chos la dbu ma bshes spring dang thugs bskyed la sogs chos mang du gsung / zhabs tog dang 'bul nod phun sum tshogs pa bsgrubs/ de nas zla ba gnyis pa la bsam yas su chos rje nyid kyi chos 'brel yod pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi dus mchod dang / slob dpon mañdzu shrī pa'i yang dus mchod la dmigs te/ phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor mang po'i sgrub mchod dang / gzhis pa rnams kyis sman bla'i gsol 'debs rnams zhag bdun gyi bar du bsgrubs/ sgrub mchod 'di ji srid 'khor ba ma stong gi bar mi 'chags par sgrub pa'i chas la/ rin chen sding gi dgon gzhis lo re bzhin thog phud nas khal sum brgya tsam re yong ba dang / ru ba sbra kha bzhi la/ phyugs ma gnyis brgya tsam yod pa btsugs te/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs par mdzad do/

/de nas zla ba gsum pa la nyan por gdan drangs nas dbu stod dang 'phan yul gyi dge 'dun grangs med pa 'dus pa rnams la rgyud bla ma'i bshad pa dang / gzhan yang so so'i 'dod chos mang po'i chos kyi bdud rtsis tshim par mdzad do/ /de nas zla ba bzhi pa la/ gdan sa chen por phyag 'tshal ba dang chos 'khor chen po mdzad par dgongs nas gtsang phyogs la byon te/ mkhas grub kyi skyes bu rgyun ma chad par byon pa'i chos grwa chen po bo dong e zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang du phyag phebs/ de'i tshe chos rje'i drung du bdag gis mjal dus/ sngar nas kyang rim par zhus pa bzhin gtsang phyogs 'dir dus 'khor gyi bshad pa rgyas pa gcig gi chos kyi 'khor lo dang / gzhan la thugs skabs ma byung na'ang bdag la gcig ci nas kyang gnang bar zhus/ de nas gdan sa chen pos gtso mdzad/ zha lu yan chad gtsang phyogs kyi sa cha la bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang mkhan slob dge 'dun dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs nas/ dang por gdan phebs pa'i tshe/ 'phan chen po dang / dar rings dang / gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa rol mo'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas te/ chos rje nyid kyis gtso mdzad pa'i gser phreng gi bsu ba dang bkur sti phun sum tshogs pas bsnyun gso ba mdzad nas bla ma rnams kyis gtso mdzad so so'i mkhan slob dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la 'phral chas kyi phogs dang / dge 'dun rnams la rgyags 'gyed mdzad de/ nyi ma lnga'i bar du bzhugs par gsol ba btab nas/ chos rje nyid kyis gtso mdzad pa rnams kyis so sor chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor te/ nyi ma re re zhing dge 'dun rnams la bsnyen bkur 'bul ba rnam gzhag dang bcas pa sbyin bdag dad pa can gzhan rnams kyis kyang bsgrubs shing / de'i tshe sde snod 'dzin pa thams cad kyi gtsug gi rgyan du chos rje pa nyid bzhugs nas/ lung dang rigs pa'i rgal lan rgya cher mdzad/

log par smra ba mtha' dag tshar bcad nas/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che ches cher gsal bar mdzad cing / nyi ma lnga pa'i tshe yul mchog tu gyur pa rnams la 'bul ba rnam gzhag rgya chen po dang / dge 'dun khri phrag bzhi lhag tsam 'dus pa la/ so so'i phyag tu gser zho re re phul te/ gser gyis dngos su ma ldang ba rnams la'ang dngul spyad dang gos dar la sogs pa 'jig rten na phul du byung ba'i dngos po bzang po sha stag bkye zhing / skye bo'i tshogs grangs las 'das pa tshogs pa la ri rab dang mtshungs pa'i nas kyi phung po spungs pa bkye ste/ der 'dus pa thams cad chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pas mnyes pas ches shin tu ngo mtshar bar gyur to/ /de nas gdan sa chen por phyag 'tshal ba la byon pa'i tshe/ gdan sa chen po na bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang dge 'dun rnams kyis bsu ba ser phreng bkur sti phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas te phebs/ bdag gis kyang chos bka' zhu ba'i phyir phyag phyir phyin cing / der bzhugs pa'i bla ma rnams kyis gtso mdzad bstan pa'i rtsa lag dpag tu med pa la/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i chos byung dang mdor bsdus dang po yan chad kyi bshad pa rgyas pa/ dpal brtag pa gnyis pa'i brtag pa dang po'i bshad pa rgyas pa/ gzhan yang dbang bka' byin rlabs dang khrid kyi rim pa mang po dang / dge bsnyen dang / dge tshul dang / dge slong gi sdom pa shin tu mang po gnang zhing / so so'i zhabs tog dang 'bul nod rgya cher bsgrubs/ de'i tshe bla ma gong ma'i sku 'bum 'di rnams la gos snam gcig byed snyam pa snga mo nas yod na'ang / hor gyis gtser bas ma grub/ khyad par chos kyi rgyal po'i nang rten lha chen dpal 'bar 'di mi 'chos kha med du 'dug pas/ gzhir bzhugs rnams kyis do dam bgyis/ dngos po gang lcogs rjes su bskur ba yin gsung ba'i zhal ta dang / der ras skud gser gyi zho brgya phul/ skabs zhig na sku khams cung zad bsnyel ba'i rnam pa byung ba'i tshe/

ston pa thub pa chen po 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug gis bskor ba dngos sum du gzigs te/ de rnams kyis bsnyung gso ba mdzad pa las bsnyung ba dngas so zhes/ chos rje nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa mnga' ba 'jam dbyangs gu shrī ba la gsungs pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen dad mos can 'ga' zhig las rgyud de thos so/ /de nas zla ba bcu gcig pa la slar yang bo dong e'i chos grwa chen por byon te/ gtsang phyogs la bzhugs pa'i mkhas grub/ bdag dang gzhan gyi grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son zhing / sde snod dang rgyud sde'i dbang phyug chen po mkhas pa'i dbang po mang pos thog drangs pa'i sde snod 'dzin pa sha stag dang / bskyed rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin zab mo la brtan pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mang du 'dus pa la/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bshad pa rgyas pa/ lam 'bras kyi gzhung bshad/ khri dbang byin rlabs la sogs pa cha lag rdzogs pa/ sbyor drug gsang 'dus rim lnga/ shin tu spros med la sogs pa'i khrid dbang byin rlabs/ so thar gyi sdom pa la sogs pa gang la gang mos kyi chos kyi rnam grangs mtha' yas pa gsungs/ de'i tshe bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab mtha' yas pa dang / khyad par dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dka' ba'i gnas rnams lung dang rigs pa'i sgo nas rgal rtags dang / dri ba dang lan gyi tshul gyis legs par gtan la phabs te bstan pa rin po che nyin mor mdzad cing / gtsang phyogs kyi dus 'khor gyi 'chad nyan gcig la de nyid rang mkhas grub kyi 'dus pa che bar grags shing / sbyin bdag dad gus can mang pos bsnyen cing bkur pas bsti stangs su byas/ de nas yar lung gi chos 'khor chen po la gdan drangs te/ glang lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bco lnga la bo dong e nas phyag btegs cing / dpal sdings dang chu mig la sogs pa sde dgon lam na gnas pa rnams kyis gdan drangs te zhabs tog rgya cher bsgrubs/

de nas sna thang du spyan drangs nas zhag gsum bzhugs te/ dril bu ba'i cho ga zhus/ dge 'dun rnams la thugs bskyed gsungs/ spyi sgos thams cad kyis zhabs tog dang 'bul gnod rgya cher bsgrubs/ de nas zha lur gdan drangs te thugs bskyed gsungs/ zhabs tog phun sum tshogs pa bsgrubs/ de'i ri phug tu phyag 'tshal ba la byon nas gnas dgon gyi dge 'dun rnams la bsnyen bkur 'bul ba gral 'gyed dang bcas pa gnang / rin po che ba'i dus mchod la gser zho brgya phul/ de dus nyin zhag gcig la bsnyen rdzogs zhu ba drug cu lhag tsam byung / de nas byon/ ti shrīs tshong dus su mjal te/ gong ma'i gnang sbyin gser bres mgo byas phul/ chos bka' gnang / de nas bla ma dbang pa dang / shar kha ba dang shangs pa la sogs pa'i sde pa rnams kyis rnyed pa dang bkur sti phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas te/ zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes dgu la bya sa lha khang du phebs/ tshes bcu'i nyin dbus phyogs kyi dge 'dun phal che la 'dus pa rnams kyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i bsu ba gser phreng dang / gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang 'phan mo che dang dar ring la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang bar byas pa dang bcas pas gdan drangs nas chos khri chen por phebs te/ gling bzhi'i dbus na lhun po ltar/ dge 'dun 'dus pa tshogs lta bu'i dbus na chos rje nyid gzi brjid kyi dpal gyis lhan ne/ lhang nge / lham me mdzes par bzhugs par gyur to/ /de'i tshe chos rje nyid kyis gtso mdzad so so'i mkhan slob rnams la/ 'phral nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad phun sum tshogs pa dang / dge 'dun so so la'ang rgyags 'gyed dang bcas pa bsgrubs nas zhag bcu'i bar du bzhugs par gsol ba btab te/ nyi ma re re zhing yang so so rang rang gi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor zhing / lung rigs pa'i 'bel gtam rgya chen pos chos kyi rnam grangs dpag tu med pa gtan la phabs te/

bsnyen bkur dang 'bul nod rgya cher bsgrubs shing / nyi ma bcu pa la dngos gzhi'i bsnyen cing bkur ba gya nom pa dang / chos rje nyid la gser bres thog drangs pa'i 'bul ba dpag tu med pa dang / chos dpon so so la'ang zho brgya tsa re re'i dngos po dang / gzhan yang gang la gang 'os kyi 'bul ba rnam gzhag dge 'dun so so'i phyag tu gser zho'i 'bul ba dang bcas pa phun sum tshogs pa bsgrubs te/ bstan pa rin po rnyed pa dang bkur sti dang bcas pas ches cher gsal bar mdzad de/ de'i tshe bstan rtsis kyi bstan bcos kyang mdzad do/ /de nas bsam yas su chags phebs te/ bla ma gong ma'i dus mchod nar ma'i sgrub mchod dang / de'i rjes la/ gong ma chen po ā yuḥrda ra shrī pa'i sku'i rim gro la kyai rdo rje'i sgrub mchod sbyin sreg mtshan spel dang bcas shing gtor sgrub dang bcas pa brgya rtsa dang / gdan sa chen pos gtso mdzad dbus gtsang gi dgon sde rnams su bstan pa'i rim gro'i zhal ta dang / don du gnyer ba rnams la chos kyi sbyin pa mdzad/ de'i zla ba bdun pa la jo bo la mjal ba dang / bla chen pa rdzong ba la lha sar byon te/ slar chos rdzong du phebs/ zla gnyis kyi bar du sku mtshams pa mdzad de/ rim gnyis kyi thugs dam zab mo la rtse gcig tu bzhugs pa'i tshe/ sa skya pa'i rtsa ba'i bu slob tu gyur pa'i mtshal mdo rta lta pa dang 'bal ser btsan gsum la sogs pas dad gus drag pos rkyen byas nas spyan drangs te/ byon pa'i lam du kong dgon par rin po ches gtso mdzad pa sum brgya tsam gyis dril bu ba'i bka' dbang zhus pa'i tshe/ nyin zhag re la nyi shu rtsa lnga pa tshan pa bzhi bzhir mdzad pas zhag gsum la tshar zhing / de lta na'ang bla chos gtan ma mdzad par snga dgong gnyis bdag 'jug mdzad cing / dbang rdzas rnams re re nas gnang bas/ rin po ches/ drung nas shin tu 'o rgyal bar gda' bas/ dbang rdzas rnams dkon gnyer bas gnang ba gcig zhus na'ang phyag srol la gnod kyi dogs nas/

sngar nas kyang de 'dra ma byas da lan nus par gda' yi gsungs nas ma gnang / de nas byang rgyab la byon te/ mtha' 'khob kyi sems can dpag tu med pa la brtse ba chen pos thugs bskyed dang bsngo ba la sogs pa chos kyi sbyin pa mdzad nas 'gro ba'i don rgya cher mdzad pa'i dus su/ 'jam dbyangs gu shri pa zhi bar gshegs nas gdan 'dren byung bas myur bar byon te/ cho ga dang gshegs rdzong gi gral dbu mdzad cing / mya ngan bsal ba'i gtam rgya cher mdzad de/ thams cad kyi sems kyi gdung ba zhi bar mdzad/ de nas rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang lo paṇa skye mchog khyad par can rnams kyis bstan pa rin po che dar rgyas su mdzad pa'i sa phyogs/ dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen por phyag phebs te/ dbus phyogs kyi dge 'dun rnams la chos 'khor gyi sku skal mdzad par dgongs nas/ dbus phyogs kyi dge 'dun phal che ba gdan drangs te/ gdan phebs pa'i tshe bsnyen bkur rgyags 'gyed dang bcas pa mdzad nas/ zhag lnga'i bar du bzhugs par gsol btab cing / nyi ma re re zhing yang bsnyen bkur 'bul ba rnam bzhag dang bcas pa sbyin bdag dad pa can so sos kyang bsgrubs nas/ nyi ma lnga pa'i tshe/ dge 'dun khri khrag gnyis la/ na bza' gsol spyad sla yol khyad par can sngar nas phyag na yod pa rnams dang / gser dngul gos dar ja rta la sogs pa rnams la gras pa'i zho re'i 'gyed dang / yul mchog tu gyur pa rnams la 'bul ba rnam gzhag dang bcas pa rgya cher bsgrubs te 'khor gsum dag pa'i sbyin pa mdzad de/ de nas stag lo zla ba dang po la bab pa'i tshe/ 'jam dbyangs pa'i phyi rten dngul gdung gi rab gnas dang / spyan snga rin po che grags pa byang chub pa khri thog tu 'don pa la gdan drangs te/ rab gnas dang zhal ta mdzad/ spyan snga rin po che'i bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mkhan po'ang mdzad do/ /de nas rgyal chos sdings su zla ba gnyis kyi bar du sku mtshams mdzad de khrid ka mang po gnang /

slar chos rdzong du byon te sku mtshams mdzad nas nang du rim gnyis zab mo'i rnal 'byor dang / thun mtshams su'ang gsang 'dus kyi bshad pa rgyas pa dang / lam 'bras kyi gzhung khrid dang / bla ma gong ma'i bka' 'bum gyi lung la sogs pa chos kyi khyad par mtha' yas pas gdul bya rnams tshim par mdzad cing / de dus rang sa skya pa'i chos skor rnams kyi zhal 'dzin che zhes gleng ngo / /gsum pa rig pa'i gnas lnga mthar phyin zhing phar phyin drug gi yon tan ji ltar mnga' ba'i tshul ni/ de ltar khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po chen po 'di yis mtshungs pa'i bla ma mang po nye bar bsten nas chos kyi rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsan cing / de rnams la'ang bla ma gong ma so so'i bzhad tshul sna tshogs yod pa rnams re re nas spyis phyin par mdzad de/ chos rje nyid kyi gsung nas sngon gyi rje btsun sku mched kyi rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyi nang na gsan rgya che bar grags/ ngas kyang de dang cha mthun gcig bya bsam na yang hor gyi gtser nas thabs ma byung gsungs/ spyir yang chos 'brel yod pa'i bla ma rnams la rigs rus kyi dregs pa spangs sangs rgyas dngos kyi mos pa mnga' bas/ bkur sti dang phu dud du mdzad cing / bla ma rnams kyang chos rje nyid la lhag par mos par gyur/ de ltar sbyangs pa phul du byung ba'i mthu dang / skye ba dpag tu med pa nas gom pa'i stobs dang / lhag pa'i lhas byin gyis brlabs pas thugs rab kyi rtsal thogs pa med par gyur pas/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhyen pa rgyas pa'i tshul ni/ sgra rig pa dang 'brel pa la'ang / rin chen byung ldan la sogs pa'i sdeb sbyor dang / 'chi med mdzod la sogs pa'i ming gi mngon brjod dang / klu kum du dga' ba la sogs pa'i zlos gar dang / me long la sogs pa'i tshig rgyan dang / dpag bsam 'khri shing la sogs pa snyan ngag gis bstan bcos rnams la mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rab tu rgyas pas paṇḍi ta chen por gyur te/

rgyan thams cad tshang ba'i thub pa chen po'i bstod pa la sogs pa bstod pa dang / spring yig sna tshogs mkhas pa rnams yid 'phrog par byed pa mdzad cing / khyad par du ming dang byings la sogs pa rang bzhin dang / si sogs dang / ti sogs dang / kṛ ta dang / de phan la sogs pa'i rkyen dang / bsgyur ba dang dbye ba'i rnam 'gyur la sogs pa/ brda sprod pa'i gzhung gi brjod bya ma lus pa ston pa'i sgra mdo chen po ka lā pa zhes pa yongs su rdzogs par mkhyen pas/ tshig gi cha gang la'ang / chags thogs med pa'i ngag gi dbang phyug chen por gyur te/ sgra mdo de nyid kyi 'grel pa chen po mdzad cing / mdor na smra ba po chen po tsant+ra go mi lta bu'o/ /gtan tshigs rig pa la'ang tshad ma kun las btus dang / sde bdun 'grel pa 'grel bshad dang bcas pa la mkhyen pa rgyas pas/ don gyi cha gang la'ang chags thogs med cing / spobs pa phun sum tshogs pas dngos po stobs zhugs dang yid ches pa'i lung la brten pa'i rigs pa rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas phyi nang gi grub mtha' ngan pa mtha' dag sun phyung zhing tshar bcad nas/ yang dag pa'i lam dang lta ba la 'god par mdzad pas rigs pa'i dbang phyug chen por gyur te/ rgyas pa'i bstan bcos rnam 'grel la/ 'grel pa du ma'i bshad srol mdzad pa'i ṭīkka che ba gcig dang / lha shag kho na'i lugs kyi ṭīkka chung ba gcig ste gnyis dang / tshad ma'i don bsdus pa dgag bzhag spang gsum rgyas par phye ba gcig rang lugs rgyas par bkod pa gcig mtshan nyid dbye bsdu dang bcas pa gnyis te bzhi mdzad de/ mdor na phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba chen po dpal chos kyi grags pa lta bu'o/ /bzo rig pa la'ang / sku gzugs dang ri mo la sogs pa'i mtshan dang phyag tshad la sogs pa ston pa'i mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams kun chub pas 'jam dbyangs dang mi 'khrugs pa jo bo'i rgyal yol la sogs pa sngar brjod pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten lugs ma dang 'bur ma dang 'de gu dang ri mo la sogs pa'i phyag tshad dang /

rus chugs la sogs pa'i bkod pa thams cad chos rje nyid kyis mdzad pa la/ bzo rig la sbyangs pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis glags rnyed par ma gyur pas/ bzo rig pa yongs su rdzogs te/ mdor na brgya byin gyi bzo bo chen po bi shwa karma lta bu'o/ /gso ba rig pa la'ang / rlung dang 'khris pa dang bad kan rkyang pa dang ldan pa dang 'dus pa la sogs pa'i rgyu dang ngo bo dang dris pa dang mthong ba dang reg pa'i sgo nas brtag thabs dang / gso ba'i sman dang dpyad kyi bye brag dang / dang po nad mi byung bar bya ba/ byung ba phyir bcos nas slar mi ldog pa'i thabs la sogs rgyas par ston pa'i yan lag brgyad pa la sogs pa'i gso ba rig pa'i bstan bcos rnams yang dag par mkhyen pas/ chos rje nyid kyi na ba rnams kyi rtsar ma byon yang na lugs zhus pa tsam la sman sbyor mdzad nas btang ba na nad rnams zhi bar gyur cing / chos rje rang nyid kyang re 'ga' bsnyun pa na/ sman pa rnams kyis thabs ci byas kyang ma phan pa la/ rang nyid kyis sman spyad pas dngas ba lan 'ga' mthong bas na/ sman pa chen po bla na med par 'gyur te/ sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed gzhon nu lta bu'o/ /nang rig pa la gnyis kyi phyi mtshan nyid la'ang / theg pa che chung gnyis kas bsdus pa'i sde snod gsum po la mkhyen pa phul du phyin pa mnga' bas/ 'du ba 'dzin pa dang / mdo sde 'dzin pa dang / mngon pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu gyur cing / khyad par du byams pa dang 'brel ba'i mdo bstan bcos rnams la mkhyen pa cher rgyas pas/ phar phyin gyi ṭīkka rgyas bsdus gnyis dang / de'i lhan skyes kyi mdo sbyor/ mdo sde rgyan dang rgyud bla gnyis la ṭīkka sa bcad dang bcas pa re re/ dbus mtha' dang chos nyid gnyis la ṭīkka re re rnams mdzad/ dbu ma'i skor rnams legs par thugs su chud pas/ rig pa drug cu pa/ stong nyid bdun cu pa/ rtsod pa zlog pa/

zhib mo rnam 'thag bzhi la ṭīkka sa bcad dang bcas pa re re dang / bshes spring gi ṭīkka'i 'phro dang / smon pa sems bskyed kyi cho ga rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ 'jug pa sems bskyed spyod 'jug gi ṭīkka rnams mdzad/ nang sngags kyi theg pa la'ang / bya ba dang spyod pa dang rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rtsa rgyud bsdus rgyud dang / rgyud phyi ma dang / bshad rgyud dang / rgyud 'grel dang / de rnams nyams su blang pa'i thabs smin par byed pa'i dbang dang / grol bar byed pa'i lam bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim dang / de rnams dang 'brel ba'i cha lag gi rim pa ji snyed yod pa thams cad ma lus par thugs su chud pas sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa chen por gyur te/ dpal brtag pa gnyis pa'i ṭīkka rgyas bsdus gnyis/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor zur 'debs dris lan dang bcas pa/ lam 'bras brgyud pa'i rnam thar/ gzhung bshad/ gzhung ji lta ba dkri ba'i khrid yig rgyas bsdus gnyis/ gnad bcu gcig gi dkri ba/ gnad drug gi dkri ba/ dbang po rab 'bring tha ma gsum du dkri ba/ lam sbas bshad kyi 'khrul 'khor/ kyai rdo rje'i mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa/ lus dkyil kyi tho yig lam dus kyi dbang / gur rigs bsdus kyi sa chog mngon rtogs/ dkyil chog chos skyong gi rjes gnang / chos skyong che ba lcam dral dang / zhal bzhi pa'i bstod pa gsum/ zhal bzhi pa'i bstod bskul/ phud mchod rgyas pa'i yig cha/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel chen po'i ṭīkka/ bsdus don/ chos 'byung dus bzhi stong par 'jug tshul gyi rtsis bzhi/ sbyor drug gi khrid yig sor sdud bsam gtan gyi dris lan/ ngo sprod chen mo sku gsung thugs yongs rdzogs kyi srung 'khor/ mngon rtogs/ dkyil chog thugs dkyil gyi srung 'khor/ mngon rtogs/ rnal 'byor ma sum cu rtsa drug mchod pa'i cho ga thugs rje chen po'i dmar khrid ngo sprod dang bcas pa/

phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi khrid/ bde mchog dril bu pa/ lū hi pa/ gshed dmar lha lnga/ bha ya na rnams kyi mngon rtogs/ phur pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ dkyil chog drag po'i rjes gnang / phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs/ tshogs bdag dmar po'i bstod sgrub dang bstod pa bsdus pa/ sgrol ma dkar mo'i sgrub thabs/ sbyin sreg rjes gnang / sgrol ma maṇḍal bzhi'i cho ga 'od zer can phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs/ sbyin sreg rdor dbyings kyi dkyil chog gi ngag 'don rgyas pa dang / bsnyen pa 'bring po sa chog gi bka' bsgo'i tshig bcad/ dpal mchog rdor sems kyi dkyil chog gi ngag 'don/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi mtshan 'bum phyag 'tshal dang bcas pa drug bla ma'i sman lha'i mtshan 'bum cha gnyis kyis thog drangs pa'i rgyud sde bod du 'gyur ro cog gi gzungs thams cad phyogs gcig tu byas pa la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ rab gnas kyi cho ga bsdus pa rnams te/ mdor na spyan snga rin po che grags pa la byang chub pa'i thugs dam du bzhengs pa'i bka' 'bum la/ po ti yug dod thon nyi shu rtsa lnga byung ste/ de ltar dri ma med pa'i gsung rab mang du mdzad nas/ phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i sgo nas kyang bstan pa ches cher gsal bar mdzad do/ /phar phyin drug gi yon tan ji ltar mnga' ba'i tshul ni/ dang po la'ang zang zing gi sbyin pa la/ chos rje 'di nyid la phyag rdzas kyi dngos po ji snyed byung ba thams cad chags shing zhen pa'i sgo nas bdag nyid kyi ched du cung zad tsam yang mi 'dzin par/ bla ma rnams zhal bzhugs dus gang spus dag pa nas 'bul ba dang / zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshe gshegs rdzongs nang rten phyi rten dus mchod rnams kyi phyogs su gtong ba/ dkon mchog rin po che gsum gyi sku gsung thugs kyi rten dang / gtsug lag khang rnams gsar du bzhengs pa dang / rnying pa gso ba dang /

gsung rab bzhengs pa dang / chos 'khor chen po gnyis kyis thog drangs pa'i dbus gtsang gi dgon sde thams cad bsnyen bkur dang 'bul nod yang yang du sgrub pa dang / bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu 'chad nyan dang sgrub pa brtson pa rnams la mthun rkyen gnang ba dang / dbul zhing phongs pa'i skye bo rnams la sbyin gtong rgya cher mdzad pa dang / 'phral du'ang chos la 'dus pa rnams la mthun rkyen sbyor ba la sogs pa mdzad pas/ zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshe phyag dpe dang 'phral mkho ba'i na bza' gsol spyad skor gcig ma gtogs pa thams cad 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i sgo nas yongs su rdzogs par btang ngo / /chos rje nyid kyi zhal nas kyang / mkhan po mkhas mchog zhi ba lhas/ /bdog pa thams cad 'bras bcas te/ /skye bo kun la btang sems kyis/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin gsungs te/ /zhes pa'i tshul dang mthun par/ lag tu bzung ba'i dngos po sku gsung thugs kyi rten gyi thog drangs/ zhwa lham gyis mtha' rten pa yan chad kyi bdog pa'i dngos po'i ci mchis pa thams cad lhag ma ma lus par gtong pa'i bya ba spong dag la dmigs zhes bsam yas kyi chos 'khor dus su gsungs so/ /chos kyi sbyin pa la/ sgra dang snyan ngag nas brtsams te/ bla na med pa'i rgyud sde'i bar gyi mdo sngags kyi bka' dang bstan bcos rgya bod kyi 'grel pa la sogs pa rang rang so so gang 'dod lung dang / khyad par du bshad pa mdzad pa na/ byung tshad kyis thugs kyi steng nas gsung zhing / thams cad thugs la gsung bar ma nus pa'i dus 'khor gsang 'dus la sogs pa rnams kyang / bla ma gong ma'i phyag srol yan chad kyi mtshams yan chad cis kyang thugs la gsung ba dang / de thams cad la'ang / dgos don/ bsdus don/ tshig don/ mtshams sbyor/ rgal lan dang bcas te/ rgya gar dang bod kyi slob dpon so so'i bzhed pa mi 'dra ba rnams kyang so sor phye nas/ gzhung 'di'i don ni 'di'o zhes nyan pa po rnams kyi rna bar 'jebs shing yid la 'bab par gsung pa'i sgo nas/

thos byung gi shes rab phul du byung ba bskyed pa la mkhas pas/ po ti gang gsung yang chos rje 'di ni sku tshe ril po 'di kho na la sbyang 'dug snyam pa dang / de bzhin du dge tshul dang dge slong la sogs pa'i sdom pa nod pa byung ba'i tshe/ thugs brel gzhan ci yod kyang khyad du gsad nas gcig tu brtson pa mdzad de/ chos rje nyid kyi gsung nas/ nga rang la rab byung byed pa'i phyogs la dka' spyad chen po dgos pa byung bas/ gzhan rab byung byed pa byung ba na ched du gnyer te do dam chen po byas shing / sngon bla ma chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pas dge bsnyen pha ma yan chad kyi sdom pa gnang ba la stong phrag phyed dang gnyis tsam byung 'dug ngas kyang de'i grangs longs pa gcig ci grub byed gsungs nas/ sdom pa nod pa rnams yi ge la btab ste rtsis pas/ de'i grangs brgya grongs du chos 'khor gling pa mang pos sdom pa blangs pa yan chad kyis longs shing / de phyin chad dngos su ma bgrangs kyang bsnyen rdzogs kho na'i sdom pa stong phrag lnga lhag pa gnang ste/ de thams cad la'ang thugs brel ji tsam yod kya bla chos gtan mi mdzad cing / 'dul ba nyid nas ji ltar gsungs pa ltar sdom pa 'bogs pa'i cho ga la mkhas pas 'di kho na la sbyang 'dug snyam pa dang / theg pa chen por thugs bskyed pa gsung ba na/ mdor bsdus pa dang bar ma dang rgyas pa ji ltar 'tshams pa'i sgo nas/ mkhas pa rnams la lung rigs dang bcas te tshig 'bru bzang pa'i sgo nas gsung zhing / blun po rnams la rang rang gi yul skad dang bstun nas go zhing snyan par gsung ba'i sgo nas mchog tu gyur pa'i nges shes bskyed par mkhas pas 'di kho na la sbyangs 'dug snyam pa dang / gsang sngags dang 'brel ba'i dbang byin rlabs rjes gnang rigs gtad ji snyed gcig mdzad pa'i tshe'ang / gzhan gyi mig ltos ngan par song ba'i dogs pas sla chos cung zad kyang mi mdzad cing /

shin tu grang ba'i skabs su sku lus bgres por song yang / na bza' phu dung can gtan mi bsnams par thang rkyang mdzad de/ dam la bzhag pa dang dbang rdzas 'grim pa la sogs pa rnams kyang gang zag re re la re re zhing mdzad la/ rgya bod kyi sgrub dkyil so so'i bzhed pa dang bla ma gong ma'i phyag len rdo rje dril bu 'dzin tshul nang mchod 'bul tshul tshun chad gcig kyang ma 'dres par mdzad cing 'di kho na la sbyang 'dug snyam pa dang / khrid dang man ngag dang ngo sprod la sogs pa de snyed gsung ba na'ang shin tu 'debs mkhas shing / ting nge 'dzin ma skyes pa bskyed cing skyes pa bogs dbyung ba/ drod rtags/ rlung sbyor/ 'khrul 'khor/ bcud len/ dmigs pa/ rten 'brel/ gegs sel la sogs pa gsung ba la chos rje dang mtshungs pa su yang yod pa ma yin pas/ 'di kho na la sbyangs pa 'dra ba mnga' zhing / kha cig mya ngan gyis sems gdungs pa dang / gzhan dag ting nge 'dzin gyi gegs kyis sems myos shing 'khrul pa la/ sman pa rnams dang rnal 'byor man ngag che bar rlom pa du mas sman spyad dang dmigs pa rten 'brel la sogs pa thabs ci byas kyang ma phan par/ chos rje'i drung du gtugs pa na byin rlabs dang gegs sel mdzad pas/ myur du khams sor chud pa mang du mthong ste mang bas 'jigs te ma bris so/ /de ltar dpe mkhyud cung zad kyang mi mnga' bar gang la gang mos kyi chos kyi sbyin pa rgya cher mdzad de/ nyin rang lung bka' dang bshad bka' mdzad/ mtshan rang bsnyen rdzogs dang dbang bskur mdzad kyang bsnyel ba mi mnga' zhing / chos kyi bya ba la ji ltar brtson pa tsam gyis lhag par sku khams bzang zhing gzi mdangs che bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa la'ang / gdul bya mtha' yas pa mtho ris dang thar pa'i lam la bkod nas ngan song dang 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa las bskyab shing / khyad par du stod smad kyi sde pa rnams ma mthun pas/

phan tshun 'thab cing rtsod par brtsams pa na/ so so'i lha sde mi sde dang bcas pa thams cad phan tshun 'jigs shing skrag pa la/ brtse ba chen pos phyogs phyogs su zhal ta dang gnang sbyin rgya cher mdzad nas lan grangs du mar sems can mang po gnod pa las skyabs pa dang / khrims kyi chad pas phog pa'i skye ba sdug bsngal gyis nyen pa rnams so so'i gdung ba las thar bar mdzad pa dang / ri dwags dang nya la sogs pa srog chags kyi rigs mang po ri rgya dang nye 'don la sogs pas srog skyabs pa dang / gzhan yang sne gdong la sogs pa'i gzhis kha rnams su dus bzang rnams la srog mi gcod cing / sha mi 'grim pa'i zhal ta byon nas bca'ab mdzad pa la sogs pa sems can dpag tu med pa la mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa mdzad pa yin no/ /'di nyid kyis sku tshe dpag tu med pa nas kyang mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa mdzad pa'i rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu la'ang / chos rje nyid sku 'khor nyung ngus gsang nas ngo log la sogs pa shin tu 'jigs sa che bar bzhugs kyang / su yis kyang glags brtsam par mi nus shing / 'di yis phrin las la mngags pa'i mi la phyogs gang du'ang gnod pa byung ba'i dpe med do/ /tshul khrims kyi phar phyin gyi sdom pa'i tshul khrims la/ so so thar pa'i sgor zhugs nas bslab pa la mig gi 'bras bu ltar gces par 'dzin pas/ kha na ma tho ba phra rab tsam gyis kyang ma gos pas tshul khrims kyi dri ngad phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa yin te/ zhi bar gshegs dus kyi bka' chem la'ang lo bcu bdun pa la rab tu byung nas de'i bar du tshul khrims gtsang mar bsrung ba 'di nga'i 'phrin las kyi gtso bo yin gsungs/ smon pa dang 'jug pa'i byang chub chen por thugs bskyed nas/ rang don yid la byed pa'i dri ma dang bral te gzhan don la skad cig kyang g.yel bar mi mdzad cing / gsang sngags kyi dam tshig nod nas rtsa ba dang yan lag gi ltung ba dang bral te rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor zab mo rgyun mi chad pas/

de ltar na sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'o/ /de bzhin du phar phyin drug gis bsdus pa'i dge ba'i chos thams cad sdud pas dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims dang / dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas sems can thams cad la 'phral dang yun du phan bde la sbyor bar mdzad pas sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims mnga' ba yin no/ /bzod pa'i phar phyin ni/ gnod pa ji mi snyam pa'i bzod pa la/ skye bo ma rungs pa rnams kyis log sgrub ji snyed byas kyang de la ji mi snyam pas khro ba dang 'khon du 'dzin pa mi mnga' zhing / slar byams pa dang thugs rje 'phel ba'i grogs su 'gyur bar nges pas ches shin tu smad du byung ba yin no/ /dam pa'i chos dang gzhan gyi don gyi phyir dka' spyad dpag tu med pa mdzad pa na sdug bsngal sna tshogs byung yang skyo ba med par bzod cing dang du len pas na sdug bsngal dang du len pa'i bzod pa dang / chos rnams kyi de kho na nyid rtogs pas zab mo stong pa nyid thos pa la skrag pa med pas na chos la nges par sems pa'i bzod pa mnga' ba yin no/ /brtson 'grus kyi phar phyin ni/ go cha'i brtson 'grus la/ bstan pa rin po che rgyas pa dang gdul bya dpag tu med pa smin grol la 'god par go cha chen po bgos te/ sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus la rang nyid bskyed rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin/ gzigs tog rtsom pa/ gzhan la po ti gsung pa/ sdom pa 'bogs pa/ dbang bskur mdzad pa la sogs pa bstan pa dang sems can gyi don kho nas dus 'da' yi/ snyoms las su bzhugs pa sus kyang ma mthong bas na rgyun du dge ba la brtson pas rtag tu sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus dang ldan zhing / 'byor bzhugs drag po mdzad pa'am shin tu bsnyun pa lta bu'i skabs su yang skad cig kyang g.yel ba mi mnga' bar thugs rus shin tu drag pos dge ba la brtson par mdzad na gnas skabs gzhan du lta ci smros/

des na drag tu sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus mnga' 'o/ /dge ba rgya chen po sgrub pa la mi zhum zhing de'i tshe gnod pa dang sdug bsngal ji tsam byung yang des mi ldog cing mi 'khrugs la/ phyi nang gi yon tan tshad med pa mnga' yang de tsam gyis chog par mi 'dzin par slar mchog tu brtson par mdzad pas na ma zhum mi 'khrugs chog par mi 'dzin pa'i brtson 'grus mthar phyin pa la mnga' ba yin no/ /de ltar brtson pa'i stobs kyi rgyun du ma chag par mdzad pa'i thugs dam gyi rim pa ni/ tho rangs kyi cha la bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor zab mo'i ngang nas bzhengs te/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor tshar gsum khug pa'i man ngag dang bcas pa rdzogs par tshar ba'i rjes su/ rdo rje bzlas pa dmigs med gtso cher mdzad cing / dmigs bcas mdzad pa na blo sbyong gi gtong len mdzad gsungs/ de nas bum pa can gyi rlung sbyor gyi rjes su byung tshad kyi lta ba bskyang pa'i nyams len gang grub re byas gsungs/ de nas tsha gong du/ dzaṃ bha la ser nag gi chu sbyin sa skya pa'i dkar gtor cha bzhi/ chab gtor 'jam dpal ma rnams mdzad/ de nas nyin gung gi cha la/ sa skya pa'i bla ma gong ma'i rgyun gtor gyi steng du/ 'od zer can ma nyi shu rtsa gcig sgom bzlas gang mdzad kyi thugs dam rnams la thun gtor gzung gtor cha gsum dang bcas pa/ brgya grong du bsnyung po byung man chad lan chags kyi gtor ma brgya rtsa re mdzad cing / de rnams tshar nas/ mdo sgrub nyer gcig gam bdun gang rung ste/ sgrol ma'i phyag 'tshal nyer gcig sgom bzlas dang bcas pa mdzad/ de nas dgong gi cha la kyai rdo rje'i mngon rtogs rgyas bsdus gang rung la brten nas lam dus kyi dbang rgyas bsdus gang grub re/ de'i rjes su/ aṣṭa/ bde mchog gi yi ge bdun pa/ rnam bcu dbang ldan/ 'jigs byed/ gshed dmar/ phur pa rnams kyi bzlas pa brgya rtsa re cis kyang mdzad cing /

thugs skabs yod dus de bas lhag pa mdzad/ nā ro pa nas/ brag phug pa'i bar du nā ro mkha' spyod kyi byin rlabs dang bsgom bzlas bar ma chad par yod pa de/ drung nas kyang brag phug pa la gsan phyin chad ma chag par mdzad cing / sngon rje btsun pa'ang / nā ro mkha' spyod kyi thugs dam nar mar mdzad pas nub gcig mnal lam du/ ne gsing sngon po'i thang gcig la rdo dkar la 'jam pa gcig 'dug pas/ bud med gcig na re/ 'di la zhabs bzhag na mkha' spyod du 'gro zer ba'i gtam rgyud yod/ nga la'ang nub gcig rmi lam du thang gcig na gdan ka 'dra gcig 'dug pa na/ mi gcig pa na re/ 'di la bsdad na mkha' spyod du 'gro zer ba'i snang ba gcig byung gsungs/ mdor na nyin mtshan thams cad du bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i rnal 'byor dang / chos spyod bcu'i cha mthun re ma chag pa'i mu yin gsung mang du brjod pas ci zhig bya/ bod kha ba can gyi bdag por sku 'khrungs pas 'khor dang longs spyod kyi thugs brel ji snyed gcig byung yang thams cad khyad du gsad nas rtse gcig tu dge ba'i phyogs la brtson par mdzad pa'i tshad sus kyang gzung bar mi nus so/ /chos rje nyid kyi zhal nas kyang dus phyis bod du byung ba gcig la mkhan chen bu ston pa'i brtson 'grus 'dra sus kyang mi do/ de ma gtogs gzhan gcig la nga yang brtson 'grus chung rgyu med par yod ces gsungs so/ /bsam gtan gyi phar phyin ni/ mthong ba'i chos la bde bar gnas pa'i bsam gtan la stong pa nyid dang mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i ting nge 'dzin zab mo spros pa med cing mtha' dbus dang bral ba'i rnal 'byor rgyud mi 'chad par mnga' bas/ rjes thob tu'ang mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i thugs mi mnga' ste/ chos rje nyid kyi gsung nas kyang / gzigs rtog mdzad pa'i gnas skabs kun tu'ang phyag dpe'i steng du rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong gzugs dus rgyun du 'byung gsung /

yon tan mngon par sgrub pa'i bsam gtan la/ ting nge 'dzin la brten pa'i yon tan mthong snang rmi ltas grub rtags mngon shes la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gcig mnga' yang / 'phral ci yang med pa ltar mdzad nas tshogs su gtan mi gsungs/ dad gus can gyi slob ma re re tsam la cung zad gsung ba rnams kyang mtshan lam la bsnyad nas gsung gi ji lta ba bzhin rjen cer du mi gsungs/ sems can gyi don byed pa'i bsam gtan la'ang / chos rje nyid kyis bsam gtan la brten pa'i mngon par shes pa'i stobs kyis gdul bya rnams kyi khams dang bsam pa dang bag la nyal ji lta ba bzhin mkhyen pas/ de dang de la 'phral dang yun du 'phrod par 'gyur ba'i chos ston pa dang / rnal 'byor pa 'ga' zhig rang nyid nyams skyon med dang ldan par rlom yang / chos rje 'di nyid kyis de'i ting nge 'dzin gzugs khams dang gzugs med tsam gyi rgyur 'gyur gyi thar pa'i lam dang bral bar mngon sum du mkhyen te/ brtse ba chen pos de rnams la gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa mdzad nas byang chub chen po'i lam la bkod pa yod do/ /de bzhin du sa phyogs gang du tshul ji lta bus dus ji srid gcig bzhugs/ bstan pa dang sems can la phan bde rgya che zhing rgyun ring bar 'gyur ba'i rgyu mtshan dgongs pas de dang de'i tshul gyi mdzad spyod rnams mdzad pa yin gyi/ byung rgyal du bab col mdzad pa ni ma yin no/ /sher phyin gyi phar phyin ni/ ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i shes rab kyi chos rnams kyi rang dang spyi'i mtshan nyid so sor ma 'dres par phyin ci ma log par mkhyen pas/ lta ba dang bsgom pa dang spyod pa rnams 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyur 'gyur ba dang mi 'gyur ba'i tshul yang dag par mkhyen pa'i sgo nas blang dor tshul bzhin du mdzad do/ /de lta na'ang mngon zhen can gyi gang zag gzhan gyis sdig rkyen du 'gyur ba'i dogs pas/

dngos su phyogs 'dzin dang dgag sgrub ci'ang mi mdzad par sems can gyi sems bsrung bar mdzad do/ /ji lta ba bzhin mkhyen pa'i shes rab kyis bdag gzhan mnyam nyid du rtogs pas dngos 'dzin gyi 'khrul pa zhig pa'i sgo nas 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi dri mas ma gos pa yin te/ de yang lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyis phyag bya ba'i 'os dang / bsod nams kyi zhing dam par gyur pas/ gong ma chen pos gtso mdzad pa rnams kyis nor dang yo byed bsam gyis mi khyab pa phul te mchod cing bstod/ snyan par brjod nas 'jig rten gyi phul du byung ba'i zhabs tog bsgrubs kyang / de rnams kyi ro 'phral mnyes mnyes ston pa tsam du zad kyi/ rjes su chags pa'i sgo nas dges pa dang yid bde ba dang / thugs dga' bar ya ya por mi 'gyur gyi/ slar sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du dgongs te/ zag bcas kyi bde ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin zer ba de shin tu bden par 'dug ces yang yang gsungs/ de bzhin du gser dang dngul la sogs pa phul ba na 'phral phyag chags mdzad pa ltar snang yang gar bzhugs pa'am/ gzims par bor ba zhabs drung pa rnams kyis sdud dgos kyi/ chos rje nyid la 'dzin pa mi mnga' bas 'di'i dus su 'di 'dra'i dngos po gcig byung ba de ga na yod ces gsung ba zhabs drung du gnas pa sus kyang tshor ba med la/ yang chos rje 'di nyid la nyes pa cung zad kyang mi mnga' bzhin du'ang / phyogs 'dzin gyis slad pa'i skye bo rnams kyis chags sdang dang phrag dog gis brgyal te/ 'di'i mnga' ris dang longs spyod la gnod 'tshe byas shing 'di nyid la smad cing mi snyan par brjod la/ de rnams kyi tshig tsam thos pa la yid mi rton par byas te/ shin tu blun pa'i skye bo gzhan rnams kyis rgyu mtshan med bzhin du sgro btags shing bkur pa btab kyang / khong khro ba'i sgo nas kun nas mnar sems dang mi bzod pa dang thugs mi ches pa dang /

thugs mi mnyes par mi 'gyur zhing / 'khor rnams kyis ma bzod par zhus na'ang / a'u rtsi de nyid ka bzod par byas pas byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur bas legs pa yin gsung ste 'khon du 'dzin pa'i 'tshigs pa gang yang mi mnga' ba yin no/ /de lta na'ang gsung rab rnams su byams pa dang nyon mongs pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug dang / rgyun zhugs dang dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu las langs pa dang / sangs rgyas la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun la bsam sbyor drag pos phan gnod byas na 'bras bu 'phral la smin par gsung pa bzhin/ chos rje nyid la chags khro mi mnga' yang yul shin tu gnyan zhing mchog tu gyur pas na/ dad cing gus pas zhabs tog tshul bzhin du bsgrubs pa rnams la bsod nams 'phel te dge legs dang 'dod dgu char bzhin 'bab cing / bsam sbyor ngan pas log par sgrub pa rnams la bsod nams ma yin pa 'phel te mi shis pa'i ltas dang yid la mi 'dod pa thams cad thog tu 'bab pa'i nges pa yod pas/ de'i phyir rtse gcig tu dad par bya ba yin te/ chos rje nyid kyis kyang dmar khrid kyi khrid du/ bdag kyang srog phyir dam chos mi gtong la/ /sna tshogs mdo rgyud don shes man ngag ldan/ /gzhan la gnod spangs gcig tu phan brtson yang / /sngon gyi las dang smon lam dbang gis na/ /ser ba'i skyon bkon lo thog smod pa bzhin/ /rang gi nyes pa'ang gzhan gyi skyon bsgyur nas/ /bdag la smod cing gnod pa byed pa yi/ /skye bo de dag mchog tu skal ba dman/ /bdag gi rang bzhin mkha' ltar dri med sems/ /da dung mkha' la rgyu ba'i sgra gcan bzhin/ /ma rungs skye bo'i tshogs kyis mi mthong yang / /phyi ma'i dus na rim gyis gsal bar 'gyur/ /'di skad bdag gis smras bzhin bden mi bden/ /rgyal ba rgyal sras thugs rje ring gzigs pa/ /sgrib med spyan can mkhyen pa dag pa'i tshogs/

/lha dang mngon shes ldan rnams gzigs su gsol/ /bden par gyur na brtse bas legs bzung ste/ /lam gyi bar chad ma lus bsal ba dang / /brdzun par gyur na 'di dang phyi mar yang / /ji ltar 'os pas chad pas bcad du gsol/ /ces gsungs pa yin no/ /gzhan yang chos rje 'di nyid la sku che ba'i yon tan ni/ sku'i cha shas mtha' dag yongs su rdzogs shing lta bas mchog mi shes la mthong na mi mthun pa med pas mthong ma thag tu skyes bu chen po nyid du yid ches shing / dge 'dun dang skye bo la sogs pa'i 'dus pa ji ltar che ba tsam gyis/ chos rje nyid sku bongs dang gzi mdangs lhag par che bar mngon zhing / skye bo grangs med pa dang lhan gcig gla gos rkyang pa bsnams te 'byon bzhud mdzad pa'i tshe'ang skye bo gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'i 'od dang 'od zer gyi gzi 'od shin tu dngas shing gsal bas rgyang ring po na gnas pa'i gang zag rnams kyis kyang ngo shes par 'gyur ba yin cing / 'di'i sku lus la srin bu la sogs pa sems can gyi rigs cung zad kyang mi 'byung la/ zhabs gnyis la 'khor lo'i mtshan gsal po yod par mngon du gyur pa yin no/ /'di'i gsung gi yon tan ni/ 'jam shing ran par smra ba dang / snyan par brjod cing gsong por smra ba dang / tshangs pa'i dbyangs su smra ba ste/ de yang 'khor 'dus pa chen po dang bar ma dang chung ngu la 'di'i dbyangs kyang de dang mthun par 'byung ba'i sgo nas/ dge 'dun dang skye bo dpag tu med pa 'dus pa la thugs bskyed dam bsngo ba smon lam gsung ba'i tshe thag ring po na gnas pa dang drung na 'khod pa la gsal mi gsal med par ji lta ba bzhin rang rang gi yid la 'bab cing snyan par thos zhing / yang skye bo gcig nyid la man ngag la sogs pa gsung ba na de nyid kyis thos pa tsam du snyan cing yid la 'bab par gsung ba yin no/ /'di'i thugs kyi yon tan ni/ rang bzhin gyis dge zhing bzod pa dang nges pa'i ngang tshul can du gyur pas/

rigs rus cho 'brang phun sum tshogs shing / 'jig rten kun gyis bkur ba la shes bya ma lus pa la mkhyen pa'i dkyil rgyas kyang dregs pa dang khengs pa cung zad kyang mi mnga' bar/ thugs shin tu gcam pa'i sgo nas 'bangs phal pa rnams dang mnyam 'grogs mdzad cing / bstan pa la lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i thugs kyis gang zag gzhan gyi mig 'dren bzang por gyur bar bya ba'i phyir bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnams la/ rnyed pa dang bkur sti phyag len la sogs pa phul du byung ba mdzad pa yin no/ /mang du brjod pas ci zhig bya/ mkhas par rlom pa'i dge bshes gzhan gyi yon tan thams cad phyogs gcig tu sdom kyang 'di nyid kyis nyin zhag gcig la bsnyen bkur ji snyed cig sgrub pa byung ba rnams la gtam lan dang bsngo ba'i rnam grangs mi gcig pa de snyed mdzad pa'i cha la bskrun par mi nus shing / mdzad spyod kyi bye brag phra mo re res kyang bstan pa ches gsal bar mdzad pa yin no/ /de ltar thos pa dang bsam pa dang bsgom pa dang 'chad pa rtsod pa dang rtsom pa'i sgo nas bshad rgyud sgrub rgyud kyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs mtha' dag tu rgyas par mdzad cing / bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi'i sgo nas/ rgya gar/ kha che/ bal yul/ mnga' ris bskor gsum/ dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ mdo stod smad/ mi nyag hor/ sog po/ yu gur la sogs pa'i skye rgu dpag tu med pa dngos dang brgyud pas skal ba ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su ma smin pa rnams smin pa dang / smin pa rnam par grol ba la bkod pa mdzad do/ /bzhi pa mthar yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba chen po bstan pa'i tshul ni/ stag lo zla ba dgu pa la 'tshal pas ra ga brag tu spyan drangs te 'dod chos 'ga' zhus/ de'i skabs kyi tho rangs kyi cha gcig la/ dga' ldan nas yongs zer ba'i lha'i bu rgyan dang bcas pa mang pos rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas te/

rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba rgyan dpag tu med pas spras pa gcig khyer yong nas dga' ldan du gdan 'dren pa yin zer ba'i snang ba gcig byung / des rkyen byas te byams mgon la mos pa drag po gcig skyes pas mjal spro ba'i 'dun pa'i khas blangs pa 'dra ba gcig byung gsungs/ de nas chos rdzong du 'byon pa'i lam du slob dpon yon tan rgya mtsho bsnyun pa'i spong dag gi gral dbu la gsang phur gdan drangs pa'i dus su/ cha pa'i sku 'bum dang mjal nas/ da lan khong gi bos pa 'dis go bcad/ de min na cha pa'i sku 'bum la mi mjal bar 'dug gsung nas mnyes tshor chen po mdzad/ de nas chos rdzong du phebs pa'i tshe bla ma gzhon rgyal bas mjal ba la byon pas/ chos rje'i zhal nas bla ma pa la zhag 'ga' bzhugs mdzod/ gsung gleng 'dra yang yod cing yang yang e phrad mi shes gsungs te zla gcig tsam bzhugs pa'i skabs su mnyes mnyes kyi gsung gleng mang po mdzad/ khyad par du chos rje'i zhal nas/ bde ba can na sa chen yab sras kyang bzhugs pas rang res kyang snga phyi thams cad du bde ba can du skye bar smon lam btab pa yin na'ang / byams chos 'di rnams la thos bsam 'dra byas pa'i mthu yin nam/ kha sang ra ga brag tu ltas 'di lta bu byung zhes rgyu mtshan dang bcas nas gsung zhing / de nas blo 'gyur ba bzhin byas nas nges 'byung cher song bas bskul te dge sbyor yang 'phel bar byung / rmi lam du zhing khams sbyong ba la sogs pa sngar re 'thad yod pa la/ bar skabs su byed pa ma byung yang kha sang nas rtsol med du sngar las gsal ba tsam byung / nga'ang yun ring mi sdod pas/ na ning dgos zer ba'i kyai rdor ne gling ma'ang da lan byas pa 'thad gsung nas gnang / bla ma gong ma'i dus mchod kyi sgrub mchod de nga rang yod pa la da lan 'dir byed rtsis su yod pas khyed kyang bzhugs gsungs/ der bla ma pa thugs shin tu ma bde nas/

chos rje nyid da dung bstan pa dang sems la dgongs nas yun ring du bzhugs pa'i sku rim dang rten 'brel thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhus pas/ lo yang mang du song rim gro yang gang yod btang zin/ sa skya'i bla ma gong ma'i sku 'bum de rnams la zhig gsos gcig byed snyam pa yod na'ang ma grub/ de ma gtogs gzhan blo'i lhag ma lus pa med gsungs/ de zla ba bcu gcig pa la mdzangs kyi gtsug lag khang du bla ma gong ma'i dus mchod la drung nas gtso mdzad pa rnams kyis dus 'khor yongs rdzogs/ gur rigs bsdus/ rdor dbyings/ chos dbyings gsung dbang / kye rdor/ lo nag la sogs pa'i chog grwa bcu gcig gis zhag dgu'i bar du bsgrubs te/ zhabs tog dang 'bul nod phun sum tshogs pa gnang / de nas thugs shin tu dges te/ 'o des rang res bya ba thams cad rdzogs par grub pa yin gsungs/ de nas yos lo zla ba gsum pa la bab pa na/ chos rje nyid la dad pa thob pa'i dbon grags pas zhu ba po mdzad de/ dus 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi dbang gnang bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i skabs su/ phyis cho ga byed pa mi yong / da lan phyogs gcig tu byed gsungs nas/ sngar gsol ba btab pa'i phyogs phyogs kyi dge bshes rnams la bka' shog gnang ste/ dbus gtsang gi sdom brtson sde snod 'dzin pa chen po sha stag 'dus pa'i nyi shu rtsa lnga pa tshan pa gsum la/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo sku gsung yongs rdzogs rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen po'i dbang dang bcas pa gnang ba'i tshe/ chos rje nyid kyi zhal nas/ 'o yang yang cho ga byed pa mi yong bas khyed rnams la skad byas pa yin pas/ rgya gar gyi dkyil chog so so dang bod kyi rwa 'bro la sogs pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bzhed srol so so'ang tshang bar byas nas dus 'khor gyi dbang bka' thams cad thob par byas yod pas/ rang gzhan gyi don rgya cher bsgrub mdzod gsung ba'i zhal ta gnang /

de ltar cho ga mdzad pa'i tshe nam mkha' la me tog gi char babs/ nyi shu rtsa lnga pa tshan pa gnyis song ba'i rjes tsam nas sku khams cung zad bsnyel te gsol mi gda' zhing sku shed med par gyur kyang cho ga rnams la sla chos ye ma mdzad par dbang rjes bstod pa la sogs pa re re nas mdzad do/ /de'i tshes bcu dgu la phyag bteg ste/ 'dzangs su bzhugs pa'i nub mo mnal lam du mi ma yin gyi gzugs mang po gcig sku 'dun du gral ka 'dra gcig byas nas/ nged rnams la zhu rgyu gcig yod zer zhing / de'i nang gi bud med gcig la khyod kyis zhu ba gyis la 'di nas gzhan du mi 'byon par gsol ba thob ces zer zhing 'dug pa'i snang ba gcig byung / bud med de rang chos rdzong gi gzhi bdag mo de yin pa'i rigs su 'dug ces gsung / chen po dge slong bas de lta na da dung 'byon pa mi 'thad lags zhus pas/ phyin pa dang bsdad pa khyed med gsungs/ de nas snye thang du jo bo rje'i sku 'bum la mjal te phyag dang mchod pa rgya cher mdzad de/ smon lam mang po btab/ de'i tshe sngar dge bshes gnyis kyis phar phyin gyi ṭīkka'i lung dgos zer de da lan byed pas bos shog gsungs/ zhabs drung pa rnams kyis da lan rang sku khams kyis mi lcogs par gda' bas sting la gnang ba 'thad zhus pas/ sting la byed pa mi yong gsungs nas phyag phyir khrid de/ rnam rgyal sgang du zhag gcig rdo rar zhag gnyis bzhugs te sku khams kyis mi lcogs bzhin du ṭīkka'i lung dang dka' gnas rnams la bshad pa rgyas pa dang bcas pa mdzad/ de'i tshe lam du 'u shang rdo'i gtsug lag khang gzigs sar phyag dang smon lam mang po mdzad/ lam rang so bsod cing dge sbyor 'phel bar 'dug gsung nas chos rdzong nas bsam yas kyi bar la zhag bcu gcig mdzad de/ 'byon bzhugs thams cad kyi tshe'ang thugs dam gyi ngang la rtse gcig tu brtan par bzhugs shing / gnam gang la bsam yas su phebs te/

de'i phyi nyin nas/ mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho'i dbu thod gzims khang du gdan drangs nas/ de la nyin re bzhin sku khams kyis mi lcogs bzhin du'ang / thugs rtsol chen pos mchod pa rgya chen po dang phyag rgya rtsa re mdzad nas/ nyid kyi dbu thog tu blangs te smon lam mang po mdzad/ de'i tshe zhabs drung na gnas pa rnams kyis ma bzod par phyag gi grangs la brdzun yang byas nas phyag 'di tsam mi mdzad par zhus na'ang / da lta phyag 'tshal ba'i nus pa yod ring la mi 'tshal na/ de nas rang 'tshal ba'i nus pa ma byung ba'i nyen yod gsung nas gsan du ma 'dod par/ phyis sku shed ye med par dngos su phyag 'tshal ba'i nus pa med pa na'ang / dbu 'dud pa'i phyag dang smon lam rnams nyin re bzhin ji srid zhi bar ma gshegs kyi bar du ma chag par mdzad do/ /zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes nyi shu'i skor gcig la chos rje'i gsung nas dge bshes rgyal bzang la mdang lha'i cha byed mang po gdugs dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa mchod pa'i bye brag mang po dang bcas te rin po che'i khri gcig khyer yong nas/ dga' ldan du gdan 'dren pa yin zer nas yus che che ltar 'dug pa'i snang ba gcig byung gsungs/ kha sing yang de 'dra ba gcig byung ba la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par/ rol mo'i sgra bsam gyis mi khyabacing yid 'phrog par byed pa/ bal po'i rol mos kyang brgya yi char yang mi phod pa gcig 'dug cing / de da dung lhang lhang 'dug gsungs/ der dge bshes rgyal bzang gi rnam rtog la de rang bzang rgyu med snyam du blo ma bde nas/ kha sang nas sku skyed du mngon pa'ang ye ma byung / lha rje mkhas pa gcig bos te gsol sman 'dra zhu ba dang / sku rim ma chung tsam gcig sgrub pa'i zhal ta gnang bar zhu zhus pas/ dang kha mi bde bas shed chung tsam ma gtogs lus la na tsha med cing sems lhag par bde/ dge sbyor yang 'phel bar byung bas shin tu skyid par byung /

kha sing du 'dun pa btang tshar zhing khas blangs ka 'dra gcig byas pa de'ang rten 'brel du song ba yin par 'dug pas/ sman spyad rim 'gro byas kyang mi phan/ khyod cung blo 'thug pas lab pa yin gzhan la ma lab/ so bsod pa rang dge sbyor 'phel bar 'dug pas sus kyang mi tshor ba'i sa 'gol ba gcig tu rang re gsum tsam phyin te/ ma tshor bar bsdad na rang 'thad par 'dug ste mi nyan yong gsungs/ der dge bshes pas de bzhin mdzad na bdag cag rnams la kha cag chen po mchis bas/ cis kyang gsol sman dang sku rim thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhus/ spyir yang lo 'di nyid la/ phyogs kun gyi mo dang rtsis dang ltas mkhan dang rmi ltas dang / pra la sogs pa thams cad la/ bod thams cad kyi gtsug rgyan du gyur pa'i sa skya 'khon gyi gdung rgyud dri ma med pa gcig la da lo dog cha shin tu che drung chos rje pa yin nam min nam zhes the tshom du gyur te cung zad yid mi bde zhing / la las yin par nges kyang gsal po smra mi nus shing mya ngan gyis sems gzir la g.yas ru byang gi dpyid mtsho skya mo'i mtsho sgo skya bo kha gdangs la zug pa dang / mang mkhar gyi lung pa na yod pa'i sku 'bum gcig gi drung du ma ṇi'i sgrub pa byas pa na mchod rten gyi ba thag la sha chen babs na/ 'khon gyi gdung rgyud rtsod med re grongs pa yin pa la/ mtsho sgo yang zug cing sha chen yang babs pas/ gdung brgyud gcig la ngan zhes gleng ngo / /zla ba lnga pa'i nyi shu skor gcig la spyan snga ba dbon zhang pas/ bsnyun gso ba la byon dus gsol sman dang sku rim mdzad par zhus te/ lha rje rgyal mtshan skyabs bos nas gsol sman zhus shing / phyogs mtha' dag tu sku rim yang rgya cher bsgrubs pas sku skyed du mngon tsam yang byung / de'i skabs zhig na/ chos rje'i gsung nas da nangs tho rangs/ mkhan chen bu ston pa dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma byon nas mkhan chen pas 'di rang mkha' spyod yin no zhes gsung ba'i snang ba gcig byung gsung /

chen po dge slong bas gzigs snang gcig rgyun du yod pa'i rnam pa gcig gda' ba/ ci 'dra gda' lags zhus pas/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ phyag gi sor tshigs tshad mdzad nas 'di tsam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs mang pos zhing 'di thams cad gang 'dug gsung / de rnams thugs dam lha tshogs lags sam zhus pas/ min khong pa tsho khar sing nas byon tshar/ rang res blo khel na/ dkon mchog gis mi bslu nges par 'dug gsungs/ de nas zla ba drug pa'i tshes bco brgyad kyi nyin/ lo tsā ba nam mkha' bzang pos mjal nas phyag rtsa zhus shing gsung glo la phan pa'i sman yang zhus te/ zhag gnyis tsam song ba'i tshe/ nyin mtshan phal cher lta stangs la bzhugs 'dug pa mthong ba na/ sngar nas thugs dam la rtse gcig tu bzhugs pa rgyus med pas/ mnal du song ba rang yin nam snyam ste/ drung nas mnal du song ba ma lags sam zhes zhus pas/ gnyid du song ba ma yin dag pa'i snang ba 'dra la 'byams pa yin gsungs/ de rnams ji tsam nas byung lags zhus pas/ phyag g.yon pa bteg mdzad nas kha ning snga mo nas byung gsung ba'i brda gcig mdzad/ gsung 'byon pa dka' mo 'dug pas gzhan ye zhu ma nus/ zhus na mang rab gsung ba'i rigs su 'dug pas zer/ gzhan yang bsnyun pa'i tshul bstan pa'i skabs su/ bla ma dang yi dam rnams la mjal ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams mang po gzigs pa la sogs pa gzigs snang dpag tu med pa byung ba'i re re tsam gsung bar rtsom pa na/ drung na gnas pa rnams kyi yid mya ngan dang mig mchi mas brlan pas ji lta ba bzhin ma gsung par gzhan du bsgyur ba'i tshig gi zol gyis dbugs dbyung ba kho na mdzad pa yin no/ /nyi shu gnyis kyi snga dro dge bshes rgyal bzang gis zhu ba byas nas/ da rang gsol ba mi thebs pa 'dra lags pas zhal ta'i bka' chems gcig thugs la 'dogs par zhus pas/ de thams cad 'khrul snang yin dgos pa med gsung nas ma gnang /
