bka' chems gcig ston rgyu ma byung na/ drung na yod pa kun 'du shes chung bar 'gro bas cis kyang gcig gnang bar zhus pas/ 'o na'ang dgos pa gcig 'dug pas bris shig gsungs nas/ de'i nyin bka' chems mdzad cing / de'i thugs dgongs kyi dngos gzhi gdan sa chen por bla ma gong ma'i dus mchod sgrub dgos rnams ma chag par bsgrubs gsungs ba yin no/ /nyer gsum gyi snga dro'i dus su gsol ja ba bsod nams 'phel gyis gsol tshod zhus pa'i tshe/ sku nyams chung ngur song ba mthong bas da rang do re tsam las mi bzhugs pas 'dra snyam du sems khong du chud de/ zhal ras la cung zad gcig bltas pas/ chos rje'i thugs kyis mkhyen nas da dung zhag gsum mi skyon pa yod gsungs/ nyi shu lnga'i nyin gsol tshod zhus pas/ 'o de ring ye mi za/ sang nas khyad gang zer ba zos pas chog gi gsung nas nan ji tsam zhus kyang gtan ma gsan/ de nas nyi shu lnga'i snga dro sa chen po 'di rab tu g.yos par 'jig rten thams cad kyi mngon sum du gyur/ dgong ja tsam la nam mkha' yongs su dag pa la sgra chen po byung ste/ lhag par skyid smad phyogs na gnas pa rnams kyi mthun snang du grub par bsam yas kyi thad ka tsam du yid gdung bar byed pa'i sgra chen po de gsal bar thos pas/ skyes bu chen po de mi bzhugs pa'i ltas yin par nges te/ mya ngan gyi zug rngus shin tu gzir bar gyur to/ /gzhan yang de'i nyin sngon chad sus kyang tshor ma myong ba'i dri phun sum tshogs pa drung na gnas pa kun gyi mthun snang du grub par byung / de'i dgong phyogs chos rje'i zhal nas/ mchod pa dang gtor ma rgyas pa gcig gshom gsung nas bsham pa'i tshe/ phyag thal mo sbyar zhing dbu dud pa re dang / mchod pa rnams 'bul ba'i stangs ka lan mang po mdzad cing / mdun gyi bar snang la gzigs te mos gus kyi rnam 'gyur du ma mdzad/ de nas dge bshes rgyal bzang phreng ba'i sne mo dang grangs 'dzin du bcug nas rgyun gyi bsnyen pa'i rim pa thams cad tshang bar mdzad de/

de yang yi dam re re'i bsnyen pa tshar ba'i rjes su dbu dud pa re mdzad/ de'i rjes la mchod gtor rgyas pa mdzad/ de ltar rgyun gyi thugs dam gyi rim pa yongs su rdzogs grub pa'i tshe/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ mal 'di'i g.yas g.yon skyor la 'dir sdod mi dgos pas/ khyed rang rnams rang sar nyol cig nga yang do dgongs bde ba gcig yong ba yod pas gnyid skyid po gcig byed pa yin gsungs nas yang drung du sdod du ma gnang na'ang / chen po dge slong pas ma tshor dogs nas gur gyi phyi rol du gnyid spangs te nyan pas/ srod yol ba'i dus su rlung sbyor gcig dang thugs bskyed gcig mdzad cing 'dug pa dang / sku mdun du dge bshes dang gnyi gas phyin tsa na/ zhi bar gshegs pa'i tshul bstan te/ de ltar dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi phrin las gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid mtshungs pa med pa'i chos kyi rje rin chen 'di nyid kyis bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don rgya cher mdzad nas/ sku tshe 'di'i mdzad pa rdzogs par dgongs te/ le lo can rnams brtson 'grus la bskul ba dang / rtag 'dzin can rnams nges 'byung bskyed pa'i phyir du smon lam dang gdul bya'i dbang gis/ shing mo yos kyi lo zla ba drug pa'i nyi shu lnga'i srod yol ba'i dus su/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma dang bcas te/ gzugs kyi sprul pa'i sku 'di nyid bsdu ba mdzad nas/ bcom ldan 'das mgon po byams pa'i drung du lha'i tshogs dpag tu med pa'i bsu ba dang bcas te dga' ldan du gshegs pa yin no/ /de'i rgyu mtshan gyis bka' chems la'ang nang rten che ba bcom ldan mgon po byams pa'i skur bzhengs la sa skyar bzhugs su gsol/ bsam yas dang chos rdzong du'ang / mgon po byams pa'i sku re bzhengs gsungs ba'i zhal ta nges pa can mdzad do/ /zhi ba'i dbyings su gshegs pa nas bzung ste sngar gyi bzhugs sa thams cad du'ang me tog che chung dang kha dog sna tshogs pa'i char chen po babs/

de nas nyer bdun nas gsol 'debs tshugs shing / zla ba bdun pa'i tshes lnga la sku gdung zhugs la zhen pa'i tshe/ chos rje nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob pa rdzong ji chen po byon nas/ sku gdung mchod pa'i rdzas a ka ru nag po dang tsandan dkar po dang chon hang la sogs pa dri phun sum tshogs pa'i spos kyi bye brag mang po dang dar zab sna tshogs dang mar dkar la sogs pa'i mchod pa dpag tu med pa phul te/ bla chen pa dang bla ma gzhon rgyal bas gtso mdzad rnams kyis rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab cing / de'i tshe der 'dus pa thams cad yid rab tu dang shing phul du byung ba'i dad pa dang / ting nge 'dzin rang shugs kyis skye ba la sogs pa'i yon tan du ma thob/ nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon kha dog sna tshogs pa 'khrigs shing me tog gi char babs/ lhag par yang mkhan chen grags pa bshes gnyen pa dpon slob kyis rgyud dang chags gsum pa'i mdo dbyangs mdzad pa'i tshe me tog gi char kha ba chen po'i 'bab stangs tsam babs pas/ ches shin tu ngo mtshar bar gyur/ tshes bcu gsum la gdung khang zhal phye dus kyang / nam mkha' la ngo mtshar ba'i 'ja' tshon kha dog dang bkod pa'i bye brag dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa 'khrigs/ dbu thod ril po ma nyams pa zhal sgo tshang ba dang bcas pa byon cing / sku gdung rnams la so sos gsol ba btab pa na/ rang rang gi mos pa dang mthun pa'i ring bsrel kha dog sna tshogs pa byon/ zhal skos gtso mdzad pa'i sku gdung / dbon zhang pa'i rten skal rnams mchod rdzas du ma dang bcas te/ nyer lnga'i nyin ko gzhung la gdan drangs pa'i nam mkha' la'ang khyad par can gyi ltas du ma dang / khyad par spyan snga nas dbon zhang pas gtso mdzad rnams kyis byas nas bsus shing / yar lungs nas dbyar gnas la bzhugs pa'i jo gdan tshogs pa sde bzhi'i dge 'dun snam sbyar gsol ba bzhi brgya dang drug cu rtsa brgyad kyis mchod rdzas dpag tu med pa dang bcas te bkod pa khyad par du 'phags pa bstar ba'i ser phreng gis bsus nas/

sne gdong rtse'i gtsug lag khang du bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i yo byad sbyar te gsol ba btab cing / dge 'dun rnams la zla mchod kyi ja bur 'bul nod rgya cher mdzad/ de'i tshe me tog gi char dpag tu med pa babs/ de nas bzung ste zla ba re re zhing phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor mang po'i sgrub mchod dang dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur la sogs pa'i zla mchod dang / lo dus kyi mchod pa la bsam yas sgrub mchod pa rnams kyi zhabs tog dang / dge 'dun rnams la gro ja dang bcas pa gral 'gyed phun sum tshogs pa dang sku 'bum dang sku lder gyi na bza' rnams kyi gtso byas pa'i gang 'os kyi 'bul ba rnam bzhag dang bcas pa dang / dbus phyogs kyi dgon sde rnams su ja skol 'bul ba dang bcas pa rgya chen bsgrubs nas/ dus rgyun gyi zla mchod ma chag par sgrub pa'i dam bca' mdzad cing / gzhan yang chos rje'i sku'i rten 'jam dbyangs kyi gser sku chen po dang / gsung gi rten nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bka' 'bum tshang ma dang / thugs kyi rten dngul gyi mchod rten rin po che'i 'phra du mas spras pa khyad par du 'phags pa bzhengs su gsol ba yin no/ /dbu thod kyis gtso mdzad pa'i sku gdung rnams gdan sa chen por gdan drangs shing / gang phebs sar dbon grags pas dkar me'i phreng ba re re'i tshad la'ang shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam du 'bar ba dang / bla ma gzhon rgyal bas gtso mdzad rnams kyis sgrub mchod gsol 'debs dang bcas pa dang / lam gyi sde dgon rnams kyis mchod pa rgya chen po rnams phul zhing / khyad par zha lur bsu ba bkur sti phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas te mchod rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa sbyar nas/ tshogs pa thams cad kyis sman bla'i cho ga mgrin gcig tu mdzad cing gsol ba btab pa'i tshe me tog gi char chen po babs/ snar thang pa'i tshogs pas lam du byon nas mchod bstod rgya chen po dang bcas te rtse gcig gsol ba btab/

dpal sdings su spyan drangs te/ bsu ba dang mchod bstod phun sum tshogs pa mdzad/ de nas zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bcu gnyis la gdan sa chen po'i bla ma dge 'dun rnams kyis rol mo'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa spos phor thogs pa stong phrag lhag tsam dang bcas pa'i bsu ba ser phreng gis gdan drangs te/ shing khang bla brang du bzhugs su gsol nas/ mar me la sogs pa'i mchod pa dpag tu med pas mchod de gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/ nam mkha' las me tog kha dog sna tshogs pa rgya lag mthil tsam pa yu ba phra mo dang bcas pa'i char chen po zhag mang po'i bar du babs pas ches shin tu ngo mtshar ba gyur te/ mdor na sku gdung gi sgo nas kyang sems can gyi don rgya cher mdzad pa yin no/ /gsol ba 'debs pa'i cho ga yang / bsam yas su mkhan chen grags pa bshes gnyen pa dang / skyid smad kyi chos dpon rnams kyis gtso mdzad pa'i gsol 'debs pa grwa nyi shu rtsa lngas zhag bcu gcig bar gsol ba btab/ chos rdzong du'ang grwa pa nyi shu rtsa lnga tsam gyis zhag mang por gsol ba btab cing / khyad par gdan sa chen por drung bzhi thog pas gtso mdzad bla ma rnams dang brgya tsho so so la sogs pa'i grwa mang pos gsol ba btab/ gzhan yang bo dong la sogs pa'i dbus gtsang gi sde dgon/ gzhis kha gong 'og dang 'brel yod kyi bu slob thams cad kyis rang rang so sor rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab ste/ skyes bu chen po de nyid dang 'brel ba'i gdul bya thams cad bde ba la sbyar te tshogs gnyis rgya cher 'phel bar mdzad do/ /chos rje 'di nyid kyi phyag rdzas chos kyi bsgrubs pa phyag tu ji snyed byung ba rnams 'phral du btang zhing khyad par chos 'khor gnyis kyi dus su 'khor gsum yongs dag tu mdzad nas/ de'i mod la'ang phyis kyi gshegs rdzong sgrub dgos la'ang dmigs gsung ba mdzad kyang / sbyin pa'i phar phyin rdzogs pa'i stobs kyis slar yang zad mi shes pa'i dngos po byung ste/

de yang phag mo grub pas gdung 'bul gser bre gnyis dang gan ja sigs nyis brgya/ mtshal pa/ yar 'brog pa/ zha lur ba/ shar kha ba/ bzhi thog pa/ dbang pa/ shangs pa la sogs pa dbus gtsang gi bu slob rnams dang / gon jo la sogs pa mdo stod smad/ dwags kong la sogs pa sa mtha'i bu slob rnams kyis gdung 'bul dpag tu med pa phul ba dang / dpon bsod dbang pa chen po dge slong ba dpon bsod rgyal ba dang gsum gyis sgos kyi dngos po gang yod dang skyin 'khrul la gzhi blangs te/ zho stong phrag gnyis gnyis ston pa la brten nas gshegs rdzongs dang / nang rten bsgrubs pa la/ sa skya'i tshogs chen por dge 'dun khri tsho lhag tsam la gser zho re lhag tsam dang / skye bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa la bzhi zho dang / chos rdzong bsam yas rnams su dge 'dun rnams la mar zho phyed re dang / skye bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa la bzhi zho dang / snar thang zha lu la sogs pa'i 'brel che ba rnams su gro dang / gzhan dbus gtsang gi dgon sde thams cad du ja skol dang 'bul ba rnam gzhag rgya cher bsgrubs shing / bo dong du dge 'dun rnams la mar zho re dang / skye bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa la bzhi zho'i 'gyed dang bcas pa bsgrubs so/ /chos rje nyid kyi sku tshab nang rten che ba khri rgyab yol 'phul ma dang bcas pa ngo mtshar gyi gzi 'od 'bar ba bo dong er bzhengs te sa skyar gdan drangs nas bzhugs su gsol/ /bo dong du bzhugs rgyu'i gser sku mi tshad ma ngo mtshar ba bzhengs shing / chos rdzong dang bsam yas su'ang ngo mtshar ba'i gser sku bzhengs te thams cad kyang bka' chems bzhin bcom ldan 'das mgon po byams pa'i skur bzhengs so/ /phyi rten la snye thang 'or gyi sku 'bum thang du/ byang chub chen po'i mchod rten gyi gser 'bum chen po gdugs chos 'khor rnams zangs las grub pa tsha gser can/ de'i lha khang khyams dang bcas pa la zhing bkod kyi rim khyad par can/

steng la g.yu thog dang bcas pa bzhengs shing / bsam yas su sku gdung bzhu ba'i gdung khang ma nyams pa la mchod rten sgo mangs kyi rnam par bzhengs/ de'i dang 'dos dang bsku gser zho nyi shu lhag dang bcas pa yar lung pa bla ma seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis phul zhing / de thams cad kyi rab gnas la phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor mang po'i sgrub mchod dang dga' ston gyi bsnyen bkur gral 'gyed 'bul ba rnam gzhag dang bcas pa rgya cher bsgrubs shing / gzhan yang zla mchod lo mchod la sogs pa/ gdan sas gtso mdzad rnams su ma chag par bsgrubs shing sgrub par gyur ba yin no/ /gzhan yang dad gus can gyi bu slob so sos kyang ji ltar 'byor ba'i nang rten phyi rten zla mchod dus mchod la sogs pa bsgrubs pa ni mtha' yas la/ lhag par yang bka' chems bzhin/ rdzong ji bas thugs khur chen po bzhes te/ chos rje nyid zhi bar gshegs phyin chad kyi bsgrub dgos thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i bya ba thams cad kyi zhal ta/ nye gnas so sos sgrub bde ba dang / dngos po gang dang gang dgos pa gtong ba/ gsol 'debs so so'i mchod spyod/ nang rten phyi rten gyi bsku gser/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi dus mchod sngar nas rgyun du sgrub dgos rnams dang / chos rje nyid kyi dus mchod rnams/ nye gnas so sos rgyun du sgrub pa'i zhal ta do dam chen po mdzad do/ /de ltar khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po chen po 'di nyid kyi rgya che zhing rgyun mi 'chad pa'i phrin las phul du byung ba la brten nas/ gang la gang gis 'dul ba'i thabs tshul dpag tu med pas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde ma lus pa gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa mdzad pa yin no/ /mtshungs med chos rje'i rnam thar bsam mi khyab/ /tshu rol mthong bas rtogs pa ga la nus/ /'khos med sbrang bu'i gshog brgyangs bstar ba yis/ /gling bzhi yud kyis bskor bar bzod dam ci/

/de lta na yang ku sha'i rtse mo yis/ /chu gter chen po'i thigs pa gcig blangs bzhin/ /cha shas tsam zhig brjod la nongs mchis na/ /bla ma lhar bcas rnams la bzod par gsol/ /dge ba gang des skye rgu thams cad kyis/ /mtshungs med chos rje'i yon tan rin po che/ /phun sum tshogs pa mthong thos legs rtogs te/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i go 'phang myur thob shog /mtshungs med chos rje rin po che'i phrin las thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba'i rnam par thar pa 'di ni legs byas dpag tu med pa bskrun pa las/ gdan sa phag mo gru'i rin po che lnga phrag gnyis par byon zhing / ngang tshul bzang zhing nges pa dang dad pa dang thugs rjes brlan pas/ gcig tu dge ba'i thugs rgyud dang ldan pa'i sgo nas phul du byung yon tan du mas mngon par mtho ba/ spyan snga rin po che grags pa byang chub dpal bzang po pa'i bkas bskul zhing / chos rje nyid la lhag par dad cing rgyud sde 'dzin pa chen po bla ma yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan dang / khyad par du chos rje nyid kyi zhabs pad yun ring du bsten pa las yon tan rin po che du mas spras pa rnams bla ma nyi ma bzang pos ched gnyer chen po mdzad de zhib cha rnams gsos ba btab nas/ snyan mngags spangs te kun gyis go sla ba gcig gyis zhes bskul ba'i ngor chos rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i dben gnas bsam gtan gling du/ chos kyi rje rin po che la gsol ba btab nas/ lo tsā bar grags pa rtse mos bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni grags pa rgyal mtshan no/ /'dis 'gro ba dpag tu med pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po myur du bskam par gyur cig dge legs 'phel bar shog/ //shu bhaṃ he/ rnam thar 'di nyid dpe rgyun dkon pa nas bo dong gi dpe rnying pa shin tu dag pa zhig la ma phyi byas pa yin kyang yi ge pa'i skyon gyis brda sogs cung ma dag 'dug na'ang /
